literature.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 开始使用巴瑞替尼(4 mg/天),一种Janus激酶抑制剂,导致显著的临床和实验室改善,包括疾病活动评分下降、C反应蛋白恢复正常以及晨僵症状的缓解。 [10.1093/mrcr/rxag098]
通过比较全基因组系统发育分析和选择压力分析(RELAX/BUSTED/Contrast-FEL),我们发现ECSA-2.1在结构蛋白基因上表现出增强的选择压力,并积累了此前与Aedes aegypti相关的替代,这解释了其在美洲迅速取代亚洲基因型的现象。 [10.1371/journal.ppat.1014677]
与模拟感染的细胞相比,对富集磷蛋白的分析发现了 2,096 个改变的蛋白质,其中 212 个蛋白质受到差异调节,包括 140 个上调蛋白质和 72 个下调蛋白质(倍数变化 ≥ 2,第 17 页)。 [10.1038/s41598-026-71623-x]
同质模型要么高估了最终的血清流行率(80% vs 38% 观察到的),要么需要在干预措施实施后将基本再生数减少约50%,这在现实中是不可行的。 [10.1016/j.lanplh.2026.101522]
研究发现,也门荷台达省的疑似发热患者中出现了登革热、基孔肯雅热和西尼罗河病毒的混合感染。 [10.66977/xsci.2610.000k]

Using comparative phylogenomic analyses of complete CHIKV genomes and selection pressure analyses (RELAX/BUSTED/Contrast-FEL), we found that ECSA-2.1 showed intensified selection on structural-protein genes and accumulated substitutions previously associated with Aedes aegypti , explaining its rapid displacement of the Asian genotype across the Americas. Baricitinib (4 mg/day), a Janus kinase inhibitor, was initiated, resulting in marked clinical and laboratory improvement, including a decrease in disease activity score, normalisation of C-reactive protein, and resolution of morning stiffness. Using comparative phylogenomic analyses of complete CHIKV genomes and selection pressure analyses (RELAX/BUSTED/Contrast-FEL), we found that ECSA-2.1 showed intensified selection on structural-protein genes and accumulated substitutions previously associated with Aedes aegypti , explaining its rapid displacement of the Asian genotype across the Americas. Analysis of enriched phosphoproteins identified 2,096 altered proteins compared with mock-infected cells, of which 212 were differentially regulated, including 140 upregulated and 72 downregulated proteins (fold change ≥ 2, p. Homogeneity models either overestimated final seroprevalence (80% vs 38% observed) or required a reduction of approximately 50% in the basic reproduction number following interventions, which is implausible.

news.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 索菲亚·戈奇亚已从基孔肯雅热和细小病毒B19中康复,但她仍经历关节痛、乏力和极度疲劳等后遗症。该报告是戈奇亚本人的陈述。 [news-44e2419b14e6373a]
在留尼汪岛和巴拉圭开展了一项数学建模研究,以评估蚊虫暴露异质性对基孔肯雅热暴发的影响。该研究比较了同质和异质暴露模型,以预测暴发动态。 [news-13537e0a6a5b2a1f]
香港卫生防护中心(CHP)报告了一例输入性基孔肯雅热(CF)病例,涉及一名62岁的女性,她在潜伏期内曾到访广东省。该病例被归类为输入性病例,患者目前病情稳定,其两名无症状的家庭接触者正在接受医疗监测。 [news-f2a2cfd906dfe5c6]
基孔肯雅热在孟加拉国再度爆发,2026年1月1日至5月28日期间报告了337例疑似病例。孟加拉国疾病控制与研究中心(IEDCR)通过RT-PCR检测确认了其中153例病例。此次再度爆发与气候变化和蚊虫活动增加有关,公共卫生专家警告未来可能引发大流行的风险。 [news-0f52d7f34a9a5c1c]
索菲亚·戈奇亚感染了基孔肯雅病毒(基孔肯雅病毒)并随后感染了副黏病毒B19,导致她显著虚弱,无法规划即将到来的赛季训练计划。该事件由ski-nordique.net报道。 [news-76da293bb1b2da87]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Chikungunya virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Sofia Goggia has recovered from chikungunya and parvovirus B19, but she still experiences after-effects such as joint pain, weakness, and exhaustion. The report is a statement from Goggia herself. [news-44e2419b14e6373a]

A mathematical modeling study was conducted to assess the impact of mosquito exposure heterogeneity on chikungunya outbreaks in Reunion Island and Paraguay. The study compared homogeneous and heterogeneous exposure models to predict outbreak dynamics. [news-13537e0a6a5b2a1f]

The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) of Hong Kong reported one imported case of chikungunya fever (CF) involving a 62-year-old female who had visited Guangdong Province during the incubation period. [news-f2a2cfd906dfe5c6]

Chikungunya has resurged in Bangladesh, with 337 suspected cases reported from January 1 to May 28, 2026. The Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR) confirmed 153 cases through RT-PCR tests. [news-0f52d7f34a9a5c1c]

Sofia Goggia contracted the chikungunya virus and later the parvovirus B19, which caused her to be significantly weakened and unable to plan her training schedule for the upcoming season. The event was reported by ski-nordique.net. [news-76da293bb1b2da87]

papers.title: Differentiated mosquito adaptive strategies underlie regional dominance of three ECSA sub-lineages in chikungunya virus
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) has emerged as a rapidly expanding global health threat and has been reported in 119 countries and territories, with recent outbreaks across Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The East/Central/South African (ECSA) genotype has increasingly predominated in multiple regions, yet the molecular basis of its competitive advantage remains unresolved. Here, we demonstrate that three ECSA sub-lineages—ECSA-IOL, ECSA-2.1, and ECSA-2.2—have independently evolved distinct vector-associated evolutionary patterns that underlie their divergent geographic dominance. Using comparative phylogenomic analyses of complete CHIKV genomes and selection pressure analyses (RELAX/BUSTED/Contrast-FEL), we found that ECSA-2.1 showed intensified selection on structural-protein genes and accumulated substitutions previously associated with Aedes aegypti , explaining its rapid displacement of the Asian genotype across the Americas. In contrast, ECSA-IOL underwent adaptation strategy switching from Aedes albopictus to Ae. aegypti , maintaining its dominance across South and Southeast Asia, while ECSA-2.2 convergently acquired Ae. albopictus adaptation with additional envelope protein mutations, suggesting enhanced adaptive potential. Genome-wide analysis revealed lineage-characteristic and convergent substitutions, providing molecular signatures associated with ECSA competitive advantage. These findings suggest vector niche partitioning as an important driver of CHIKV global expansion dynamics, with potential implications for outbreak forecasting, vector control prioritization, and the design of broadly protective vaccines.

papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)已成为迅速扩展的全球健康威胁,并已在119个国家和地区报告,近期在亚洲、欧洲和美洲出现了暴发。东/中/南部非洲(ECSA)基因型在多个地区日益占据主导地位,但其竞争优势的分子基础仍未明确。在这里,我们证明了三种ECSA亚谱系——ECSA-IOL、ECSA-2.1和ECSA-2.2——已独立进化出与媒介相关的不同进化模式,这些模式解释了它们在地理上的不同优势。通过比较全基因组系统发育分析和选择压力分析(RELAX/BUSTED/Contrast-FEL),我们发现ECSA-2.1在结构蛋白基因上表现出增强的选择压力,并积累了此前与Aedes aegypti相关的替代,这解释了其在美洲迅速取代亚洲基因型的现象。相比之下,ECSA-IOL从Aedes albopictus向Ae. aegypti切换了适应策略,维持了其在南亚和东南亚的优势,而ECSA-2.2则通过获得Ae. albopictus适应性以及额外的包膜蛋白突变,表现出趋同的适应性获得,表明其具有增强的适应潜力。对基因组的全基因组分析揭示了谱系特异性及趋同的替代,提供了与ECSA竞争优势相关的分子特征。这些发现表明,媒介的生态位分化是CHIKV全球扩展动态的重要驱动因素,可能对暴发的预测、媒介的控制优先级以及设计广泛保护性的疫苗具有潜在影响。

papers.title: Nanopore Sequencing for Chikungunya Virus: Principles and Application.
papers.abstract: Nanopore sequencing is transforming viral genomics through real-time, portable, long-read analysis of RNA and DNA. Unlike traditional short-read platforms, it detects nucleotide sequences by measuring ionic current changes as nucleic acids pass through nanoscale pores, enabling direct single-molecule sequencing and base modification detection. Its simplicity, flexibility, and capacity for ultra-long reads make it ideal for resolving complex genomic regions, structural variants, and full viral genomes. These advantages have accelerated its use in pathogen surveillance and outbreak response, especially in resource-limited settings. For chikungunya virus (CHIKV), nanopore sequencing allows rapid, culture-independent recovery of complete genomes from clinical and vector samples, enabling real-time tracking of viral diversity, evolution, and spread. Experiences from Ebola, Zika, and COVID-19 have demonstrated the power of portable sequencing, now applied to CHIKV monitoring. Advances in tools such as Guppy, Dorado, Minimap2, and Medaka enhance read quality, consensus accuracy, and downstream analyses. Despite challenges in basecalling and error correction, robust quality control pipelines ensure reliable results. Ongoing improvements in chemistry, flow cell design, and machine learning will further enhance fidelity and throughput, establishing nanopore sequencing as a cornerstone of CHIKV genomic surveillance and epidemic preparedness.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于纳米孔测序在基孔肯雅病毒中的原理与应用,考察其在临床和环境样本中用于恢复完整病毒基因组和监测病毒传播的使用情况。
elements_zh.methods: 纳米孔测序通过测量核酸穿过纳米级孔时的离子电流变化,直接对RNA和DNA进行测序,从而实现对基孔肯雅病毒基因组的实时、单分子分析,无需依赖培养。
elements_zh.main_results: 该方法展示了从临床和环境样本中快速恢复完整病毒基因组的能力,有助于在疫情期间实时追踪病毒多样性、传播及扩散。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为病原体监测领域的重要进展,特别是在资源有限的环境中,纳米孔测序提供了一种灵活且强大的工具,用于基孔肯雅病毒的监测。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为基孔肯雅病毒的更有效监测策略的制定提供依据,从而增强疫情响应和疫情应对能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究承认在碱基调用和错误校正方面存在挑战,但强调了稳健的质量控制流程,确保了可靠的结果,支持了中等程度的证据可信度。

papers.title: Accounting for heterogeneity in mosquito exposure to forecast chikungunya outbreaks in Reunion Island and Paraguay: a mathematical modelling study
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Heterogeneity in mosquito exposure at a fine spatial scale is well documented but often neglected in mathematical models of arbovirus transmission, particularly for real-time forecasting. We aimed to assess whether accounting for heterogeneity in mosquito exposure improves the ability of transmission models to reproduce past chikungunya outbreaks and to forecast an ongoing outbreak in real time. METHODS: We extended an existing transmission model, originally developed to forecast dengue outbreaks in Reunion Island and incorporating seasonality, to include heterogeneity in mosquito exposure. We compared this model to versions assuming homogeneous exposure, evaluating their ability to reproduce the 2005-06 Reunion Island outbreak and the 2023 Paraguay Metropolitana subregion outbreak. We then used the heterogeneity model to forecast the 2025 Reunion Island outbreak in real time. FINDINGS: Accounting for heterogeneity in mosquito exposure at a fine spatial scale was crucial to accurately reproduce Reunion Island's 2005-06 outbreak. Homogeneity models either overestimated final seroprevalence (80% vs 38% observed) or required a reduction of approximately 50% in the basic reproduction number following interventions, which is implausible. The heterogeneity level estimated from this outbreak transferred successfully to the Metropolitana outbreak, accurately forecasting epidemic trajectory and final seroprevalence (∼40% vs ∼75% for the homogeneity model). Under the same assumption, the heterogeneity model successfully forecasted the peak of the 2025 Reunion Island outbreak (∼400 emergency room visits per week) and timing (April), nearly two months ahead. A post-outbreak serosurvey indicated that the heterogeneity model underestimated final seroprevalence (46·1% vs 61·6% observed), whereas the homogeneity model overestimated final seroprevalence (78·5%), suggesting that heterogeneity in 2025 might have been lower than that in 2005-06. INTERPRETATION: These results highlight how incorporating heterogeneity in mosquito exposure can improve chikungunya outbreaks forecasting. Our approach showed strong predictive performance in settings with climatic seasonality and holds promise for forecasting future chikungunya and other arbovirus outbreaks. FUNDING: EU; Laboratoire d'Excellence Integrative Biology of Emerging Infectious Diseases programme; Agence Nationale de Recherches Sur le Sida, les Hépatites Virales et les Maladies Infectieuses Émergentes; Agence Nationale de la Recherche.

papers.title_zh: 考虑蚊虫暴露异质性以预测留尼汪岛和巴拉圭的基孔肯雅热暴发:一项数学建模研究
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Heterogeneity in mosquito exposure at a fine spatial scale is well documented but often neglected in mathematical models of arbovirus transmission, particularly for real-time forecasting. We aimed to assess whether accounting for heterogeneity in mosquito exposure improves the ability of transmission models to reproduce past chikungunya outbreaks and to forecast an ongoing outbreak in real time. METHODS: We extended an existing transmission model, originally developed to forecast dengue outbreaks in Reunion Island and incorporating seasonality, to include heterogeneity in mosquito exposure. We compared this model to versions assuming homogeneous exposure, evaluating their ability to reproduce the 2005-06 Reunion Island outbreak and the 2023 Paraguay Metropolitana subregion outbreak. We then used the heterogeneity model to forecast the 2025 Reunion Island outbreak in real time. FINDINGS: Accounting for heterogeneity in mosquito exposure at a fine spatial scale was crucial to accurately reproduce Reunion Island's 2005-06 outbreak. Homogeneity models either overestimated final seroprevalence (80% vs 38% observed) or required a reduction of approximately 50% in the basic reproduction number following interventions, which is implausible. The heterogeneity level estimated from this outbreak transferred successfully to the Metropolitana outbreak, accurately forecasting epidemic trajectory and final seroprevalence (∼40% vs ∼75% for the homogeneity model). Under the same assumption, the heterogeneity model successfully forecasted the peak of the 2025 Reunion Island outbreak (∼400 emergency room visits per week) and timing (April), nearly two months ahead. A post-outbreak serosurvey indicated that the heterogeneity model underestimated final seroprevalence (46·1% vs 61·6% observed), whereas the homogeneity model overestimated final seroprevalence (78·5%), suggesting that heterogeneity in 2025 might have been lower than that in 2005-06. INTERPRETATION: These results highlight how incorporating heterogeneity in mosquito exposure can improve chikungunya outbreaks forecasting. Our approach showed strong predictive performance in settings with climatic seasonality and holds promise for forecasting future chikungunya and other arbovirus outbreaks. FUNDING: EU; Laboratoire d'Excellence Integrative Biology of Emerging Infectious Diseases programme; Agence Nationale de Recherches Sur le Sida, les Hépatites Virales et les Maladies Infectieuses Émergentes; Agence Nationale de la Recherche.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:在细尺度空间上蚊虫暴露的异质性已被充分记录,但在基孔肯雅病毒的数学模型中往往被忽视,尤其是在实时预测方面。我们旨在评估是否考虑蚊虫暴露的异质性能够提高模型再现过去基孔肯雅热暴发的能力,并改善对当前暴发的实时预测。方法:我们扩展了一个现有的数学模型,该模型最初用于预测留尼汪岛的登革热暴发,并包含季节性因素,以纳入蚊虫暴露的异质性。我们将此模型与假设蚊虫暴露同质性的模型版本进行比较,评估其再现2005-06年留尼汪岛基孔肯雅热暴发和2023年巴拉圭Metropolitana子区域基孔肯雅热暴发的能力。随后,我们使用异质性模型对2025年留尼汪岛的基孔肯雅热暴发进行实时预测。结果:在细尺度空间上考虑蚊虫暴露的异质性对于准确再现2005-06年留尼汪岛的基孔肯雅热暴发至关重要。同质性模型要么高估了最终病例数(80% vs 观察到的38%),要么在干预后需要将基本再生数减少约50%,这在现实中是不合理的。从此次基孔肯雅热暴发中估计的异质性水平成功地转移到了Metropolitana子区域的暴发中,准确预测了疫情轨迹和最终病例数(异质性模型为约40%,同质性模型为约75%)。在相同假设下,异质性模型成功预测了2025年留尼汪岛基孔肯雅热暴发的峰值(约每周400次急诊就诊)和时间(4月),提前近两个月。暴发后的血清学调查显示,异质性模型低估了最终病例数(46·1% vs 观察到的61·6%),而同质性模型则高估了最终病例数(78·5%),这表明2025年的异质性可能低于2005-06年。解释与创新性:这些结果突显了在蚊虫暴露中考虑异质性如何提高基孔肯雅热暴发的预测能力。我们的方法在具有气候季节性的环境中表现出强大的预测性能,并为未来基孔肯雅热及其他蚊媒病毒的预测提供了前景。资助:欧盟;新兴传染病整合生物学卓越实验室计划;国家艾滋病、病毒性肝炎和新兴传染病研究所;国家研究署。局限性与证据强度:暴发后的血清学调查显示,异质性模型低估了最终病例数(46·1% vs 观察到的61·6%),而同质性模型则高估了最终病例数(78·5%),这表明2025年的异质性可能低于2005-06年。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 我们旨在评估在蚊虫暴露异质性方面进行调整是否能提高传播模型再现过去基孔肯雅热暴发的能力,并实时预测当前暴发暴发的能力。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们扩展了一个现有的传播模型,该模型最初开发用于预测留尼汪岛的登革热暴发,并结合了季节性因素,以纳入蚊虫暴露的异质性。
analysis_zh.methods: 我们将该模型与假设同质暴露的版本进行了比较,评估其再现2005-06年留尼汪岛暴发和2023年巴拉圭大都会区子区域暴发的能力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 同质模型要么高估了最终的血清流行率(80% vs 38% 观察到的),要么需要在干预措施实施后将基本再生数减少约50%,这在现实中是不可行的。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些结果突显了在蚊虫暴露中纳入异质性如何提高基孔肯雅热暴发的预测能力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 资助:欧盟;新兴传染病整合生物学卓越实验室计划;国家艾滋病、病毒性肝炎和新兴传染病研究局;法国国家研究局。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 一项关于暴发的血清学调查表明,异质性模型低估了最终的血清流行率(46·1% vs 观察到的61·6%),而同质性模型则高估了最终的血清流行率(78·5%),这表明2025年的异质性可能比2005-06年更低。

papers.title: Overview of Chikungunya Virus Epidemiology, Biology, and Pathogenesis.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an arthropod-borne alphavirus within the Togaviridae family, is transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. The virus causes an acute febrile illness characterized by severe, often bilateral polyarthralgia, with potential progression to chronic musculoskeletal pain and rare systemic complications involving cardiovascular and neurological systems. CHIKV exhibits a spherical, enveloped virion (~70 nm) with T = 4 icosahedral symmetry, incorporating E1/E2 glycoprotein heterodimers that mediate receptor binding and membrane fusion. Its positive-sense RNA genome (~11.8 kb) encodes nonstructural proteins for replication and structural proteins for virion assembly. Replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving synthesis of genomic and subgenomic RNAs, followed by glycoprotein maturation and budding at the plasma membrane. Epidemiologically, CHIKV has expanded beyond Africa and Asia, with major outbreaks driven by adaptive mutations enhancing transmission via A. Since introduction to the Americas in 2013, the global incidence remains high, with >180,000 confirmed cases reported in 2025. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination; VLP-based vaccines (e.g., Vimkunya) show promise, while live-attenuated formulations face safety concerns. No licensed antivirals exist; current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development.

It describes the virus as an arthropod-borne alphavirus transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, causing acute febrile illness with severe polyarthralgia and potential chronic complications. The virus has a spherical, enveloped virion with T = 4 icosahedral symmetry and a positive-sense RNA genome encoding replication and structural proteins. CHIKV replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving genomic and subgenomic RNA synthesis, glycoprotein maturation, and budding at the plasma membrane. The study highlights the expansion of CHIKV beyond Africa and Asia, driven by adaptive mutations that enhance transmission. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination, with VLP-based vaccines showing promise and live-attenuated formulations facing safety concerns. No licensed antivirals exist, and current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),一种属于Togaviridae科的虫媒α病毒,主要通过埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)和白纹伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)传播。该病毒引起一种急性发热性疾病,特征为严重的、常为双侧性关节痛,可能进展为慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛,并偶有涉及心血管和神经系统系统的全身并发症。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究概述了基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的结构、生物学及系统发育。研究内容包括病毒的结构、复制机制及其全球传播情况。分析涵盖了CHIKV谱系及其相关疾病。
elements_zh.methods: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)具有球形、包膜的病毒颗粒(约70 nm),呈T = 4二十面体对称结构,包含介导受体结合和膜融合的E1/E2糖蛋白异二聚体。其正链RNA基因组(约11.8 kb)编码用于复制的非结构蛋白和用于病毒颗粒组装的结构蛋白。病毒复制发生在细胞质囊泡中,涉及基因组和亚基因组RNA的合成,随后是糖蛋白成熟和在细胞膜上出芽。
elements_zh.main_results: 自2013年引入美洲以来,全球发病率仍保持较高水平,2025年报告了超过180,000例确诊病例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 从流行病学角度看,CHIKV已扩展至非洲和亚洲以外的地区,其主要传播模式由适应性进化增强其传播能力。预防策略依赖于媒介控制和疫苗接种;基于病毒样颗粒(VLP)的疫苗(如Vimkunya)显示出前景,而减毒活疫苗则面临安全性问题。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 目前尚无获批的抗病毒药物;现有管理措施为支持性治疗,但针对病毒复制和免疫调节的试验性疗法正在研发中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告局限性或证据强度。

papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),一种属于Togaviridae科的虫媒α病毒,主要通过埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)和白纹伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)传播。该病毒引起一种急性发热性疾病,特征为严重的、常为双侧性关节痛,可能进展为慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛,并偶有涉及心血管和神经系统系统的全身并发症。CHIKV具有球形、包膜的病毒颗粒(约70 nm),呈T = 4二十面体对称结构,包含介导受体结合和膜融合的E1/E2糖蛋白异二聚体。其正链RNA基因组(约11.8 kb)编码用于复制的非结构蛋白和用于病毒颗粒组装的结构蛋白。病毒复制发生在细胞质囊泡中,涉及基因组和亚基因组RNA的合成,随后是糖蛋白成熟和在细胞膜上出芽。从流行病学角度看,CHIKV已扩展至非洲和亚洲以外的地区,其主要传播模式由适应性进化增强其传播能力。自2013年引入美洲以来,全球发病率仍保持较高水平,2025年报告了超过180,000例确诊病例。预防策略依赖于媒介控制和疫苗接种;基于病毒样颗粒(VLP)的疫苗(如Vimkunya)显示出前景,而减毒活疫苗则面临安全性问题。目前尚无获批的抗病毒药物;现有管理措施为支持性治疗,但针对病毒复制和免疫调节的试验性疗法正在研发中。

papers.title: Successful use of a Janus-kinase (JAK) inhibitor in chronic chikungunya arthritis refractory to conventional synthetic DMARDs: a case report
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic chikungunya arthritis is a debilitating post-viral inflammatory condition that clinically mimics rheumatoid arthritis and often requires long-term treatment with disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs. Treatment options are limited when conventional synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs are not tolerated or lose efficacy. We report the case of a 50-year-old Brazilian woman with serologically confirmed chikungunya virus infection who developed chronic chikungunya arthritis with a rheumatoid arthritis–like phenotype. Following an acute febrile illness accompanied by rash and negative dengue serology, she was initially managed with symptomatic analgesics, followed by prednisone and hydroxychloroquine. Despite this treatment, the disease activity score in 28 joints calculated with C-reactive protein was elevated at 6.78. Methotrexate was introduced but was discontinued after three weeks due to drug-induced pneumonitis. She later failed leflunomide therapy after 12 months, with a score of 4.33. Baricitinib (4 mg/day), a Janus kinase 1 and 2 inhibitor, was then initiated, resulting in marked clinical and laboratory improvement: the disease activity score decreased to 1.90 over one year, C-reactive protein normalised and the erythrocyte sedimentation rate declined progressively, and morning stiffness resolved, with no infectious complications. This case suggests that Janus kinase inhibition may be a therapeutic option for selected patients with chronic chikungunya arthritis refractory to conventional treatment.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 慢性基孔肯雅热关节炎是一种 debilitating 的病毒后炎症性疾病,临床表现类似类风湿性关节炎,通常需要长期使用疾病修饰抗风湿药物进行治疗。当传统合成疾病修饰抗风湿药物无法耐受或失去疗效时,治疗选择有限。我们报告了一例50岁巴西女性的病例,其血清学确诊感染了基孔肯雅病毒,随后发展为具有类风湿性关节炎表型的慢性基孔肯雅热关节炎。在急性发热性疾病伴随皮疹和阴性登革热检测后,她最初接受了对症止痛药治疗,随后使用泼尼松和羟氯喹。尽管如此,使用C反应蛋白计算的28关节疾病活动评分仍升高至6.78。甲氨蝶呤被引入治疗,但因药物引起的肺炎在三周后停用。12个月后,她对来氟米特治疗无效,评分仍为4.33。随后开始使用巴瑞替尼(4 mg/天),一种Janus激酶1和2抑制剂,导致显著的临床和实验室改善:疾病活动评分在一年内降至1.90,C反应蛋白恢复正常,红细胞沉降率逐渐下降,晨僵症状消失,且无感染并发症。该病例表明,Janus激酶抑制可能为对传统治疗无效的慢性基孔肯雅热关节炎患者提供一种治疗选择。

papers.title: Protocol for Detecting and Sequencing Chikungunya Virus from Field-Collected Mosquitoes.
papers.abstract: Arboviral diseases represent a major public health challenge, especially in tropical regions where environmental conditions may favor the proliferation and spread of mosquito vectors. Thus, early and accurate detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in mosquito populations can be a valuable tool for effective surveillance of circulating variants and for identifying new viral introductions. Given the challenges of detecting arboviruses in field-captured mosquitoes, we describe an integrated workflow for CHIKV molecular detection and whole-genome sequencing. This protocol includes mosquito homogenization using a bead-based mechanical disruptor, RNA extraction using TRIzol reagent with minor modifications, molecular screening using CHIKV-specific RT-qPCR, and whole-genome amplification followed by sequencing on Illumina platforms. Despite the protocol being optimized for individual mosquitoes, it results in high-quality RNA suitable for both entomological surveillance and genomic analysis. As this protocol allows recovery of complete CHIKV genomes from mosquito specimens, it can serve as a basis for genomic epidemiology studies, enabling monitoring of viral diversity and lineage dynamics, and facilitating early detection of emerging variants to support timely and targeted public health interventions in endemic and at-risk regions.

analysis.summary_en: This protocol outlines a comprehensive workflow for detecting and sequencing chikungunya virus (CHIKV) from field-collected mosquitoes, addressing the public health need for early surveillance of arboviral threats in tropical regions. The authors describe a bead-based mechanical disruption for mosquito homogenization, followed by TRIzol-based RNA extraction with minor modifications. CHIKV-specific RT-qPCR is employed for molecular screening, and positive samples undergo whole-genome amplification and Illumina sequencing to recover complete viral genomes. Although the protocol is optimized for individual mosquitoes and yields high-quality RNA suitable for both entomological surveillance and genomic analysis, the study does not provide empirical results, interpretations, or assessments of limitations. Consequently, the evidence base remains limited to methodological description, underscoring the need for future validation studies to confirm the protocol’s effectiveness and applicability in diverse field settings.

papers.title_zh: 从野外采集的蚊虫中检测和测序基孔肯雅病毒的方案。
papers.source_body_en: Arboviral diseases represent a major public health challenge, especially in tropical regions where environmental conditions may favor the proliferation and spread of mosquito vectors. Thus, early and accurate detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in mosquito populations can be a valuable tool for effective surveillance of circulating variants and for identifying new viral introductions. Given the challenges of detecting arboviruses in field-captured mosquitoes, we describe an integrated workflow for CHIKV molecular detection and whole-genome sequencing. This protocol includes mosquito homogenization using a bead-based mechanical disruptor, RNA extraction using TRIzol reagent with minor modifications, molecular screening using CHIKV-specific RT-qPCR, and whole-genome amplification followed by sequencing on Illumina platforms. Despite the protocol being optimized for individual mosquitoes, it results in high-quality RNA suitable for both entomological surveillance and genomic analysis. As this protocol allows recovery of complete CHIKV genomes from mosquito specimens, it can serve as a basis for genomic epidemiology studies, enabling monitoring of viral diversity and lineage dynamics, and facilitating early detection of emerging variants to support timely and targeted public health interventions in endemic and at-risk regions.
papers.abstract_zh: 蚊媒疾病是公共卫生领域的重要挑战,尤其是在热带地区,环境条件可能有利于蚊虫媒介的繁殖和传播。因此,对蚊虫种群中基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)进行早期和准确的检测,可以成为有效监测流行变异株和识别新病毒引入的宝贵工具。鉴于在野外捕获的蚊虫中检测蚊媒病毒的挑战,我们描述了一种集成的工作流程,用于CHIKV的分子检测和全基因组测序。该方案包括使用基于珠子的机械破碎仪对蚊虫进行匀浆,使用TRIzol试剂进行RNA提取(略有修改),使用CHIKV特异性RT-qPCR进行分子筛选,以及全基因组扩增后在Illumina平台上进行测序。尽管该方案针对单个蚊虫进行了优化,但仍能获得高质量的RNA,适用于虫媒监测和基因组分析。由于该方案能够从蚊虫样本中回收完整的CHIKV 基因组,因此可以作为基因组流行病学研究的基础,实现对病毒多样性及谱系动态的监测,并有助于早期发现新兴变异株,从而支持在流行和高风险地区及时、有针对性的公共卫生干预措施。

papers.title: Global patterns of genetic diversity and evolution in chikungunya virus E2 glycoprotein
papers.abstract: The E2 glycoprotein of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) mediates host-cell attachment and entry and contains key antigenic determinants targeted by host immune responses. Variation in E2 can influence host interaction, immune recognition, lineage diversification, and epidemic fitness, it represents a biologically relevant target for assessing evolutionary pressures and epidemic dynamics. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of E2 genetic diversity using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods. Diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotypes network analysis were applied to characterize evolutionary pressures acting on E2 glycoprotein. To assess the influence of geography, host, and time on viral population structure, we performed spatial–temporal stratification and analysis to assess clustering patterns across lineages and regions using Fixation index test (Fst). Nucleotide diversity varied considerably across time, with the pre-expansion period (pre-2004) showing the highest diversity (Pi = 0.085), while more recent outbreak periods exhibited comparatively reduced diversity (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests revealed signatures of both purifying and positive selection across the three CKIKV E2 lineages (negatively statistically significant Tajima D, Fu and Li’s D, and Fu and Li’s F tests, p -values < 0.05) supported by codon‐based analyses showing pervasive purifying constraint across the E2 gene but recurrent diversifying signals at lineage‐specific sites, notably codon 146 in the West African lineage, codons 220, 245, 247, and 254 in the Asian lineage, and codons 54, 56, 102, 145, 163, 177, and 350 in the East/Central/South/African lineage. Population structure analyses using Fst indicated significant genetic differentiation between regional populations, reflecting restricted gene flow and localized evolutionary trajectories. Haplotype network analysis highlighted distinct clustering patterns shaped by geography and epidemic waves, reflecting the persistence of lineage-specific signatures across regions. At the same time, reduced connectivity among recent outbreak strains point to more discrete intercontinental movement events, likely driven by human-mediated vector dispersal or travel-associated introductions. Collectively, these findings underscore the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein and its implications for viral adaptation and immune evasion.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 中 E2 糖蛋白的遗传多样性和 进化,重点关注其在 宿主 细胞附着、免疫识别和谱系多样化中的作用。E2 糖蛋白是影响病毒 进化 和流行动态的关键抗原决定簇。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用跨地区、宿主 和流行时期收集的序列数据集对 E2 遗传多样性进行了全面分析。使用 Fst 进行的种群结构分析表明,区域种群之间存在显着的遗传分化,反映了有限的基因流动和局部进化轨迹。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究应用多样性指数、中性测试和单倍型网络分析来表征作用于 E2 糖蛋白的进化压力。为了评估地理、宿主 和时间对病毒种群结构的影响,使用固定指数检验(Fst)进行时空分层和分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 核苷酸多样性随时间变化很大,扩张前时期(2004 年之前)显示出最高的多样性(Pi = 0.085),而最近的 暴发 时期则表现出相对较低的多样性(Pi = 0.012)。中性测试揭示了三个 CHIKV E2 谱系的纯化和正选择特征,并得到基于密码子的分析的支持,显示普遍的纯化限制,但在谱系特异性位点反复出现多样化信号。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了 CHIKV E2 糖蛋白的时空 进化,强调了其在病毒适应和免疫逃避中的作用。这些结果为塑造 CHIKV 谱系的进化压力及其对免疫识别和流行病动态的影响提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究的结果可以通过强调可能影响病毒适应和免疫逃避的遗传多样性模式和进化压力,为 CHIKV 的 监测 策略提供信息。这些知识对于了解免疫逃逸的潜力和制定有针对性的干预措施至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据基于综合数据集,但遗传多样性和进化压力的分析受到序列可用性以及地理和时间偏差的可能性的限制。由于依赖现有序列数据且缺乏直接实验验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Tactical Paralysis: The Interplay Between Chikungunya Virus and Host Mitochondrial Dynamics in Immune Evasion and Metabolic Remodeling
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an expanding alphavirus causing acute febrile illness, yet its most debilitating signature remains the refractory chronic arthralgia persisting for months or years. While traditional paradigms focused on viral-mediated host shutoff, emerging evidence points to a more insidious orchestrated sabotage within the joint niche. This review deconstructs the tactical paralysis of host mitochondrial dynamics driven by CHIKV. We delineate how specific viral components (nsP2, TF, and 6K) act as molecular wedges or post-translational modifiers that hijack host fission/fusion machinery (Drp1/Mfn2), driving the mitochondrial network into compulsive fragmentation. Crucially, this morphological collapse operates as a double-edged sword: in the acute phase, it disrupts the MAVS signalosome to mute the type I interferon response; in the chronic phase, it cascades into a profound immunometabolic rewiring within the synovial microenvironment. In synovial macrophages, mitochondrial fragmentation ruptures the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle, causing succinate accumulation that epigenetically locks cells into a persistent, pro-inflammatory M1 phenotype, establishing a destructive "metabolic memory." Concurrently, in fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS), retrograde signaling from mitochondrial ROS and cytosolic mtDNA leakage prompts a pseudo-malignant transformation, accelerating extracellular matrix degradation via MMP-13 and RANKL hyperactivation. By integrating these dimensions, we provide a unified framework for CHIKV chronicity and propose targeted mitochondrial quality control as a high-value therapeutic frontier to break post-viral arthropathy.
papers.journal: International Journal of Biology and Health

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in causing chronic arthralgia through its manipulation of host mitochondrial dynamics. The study highlights how viral components such as nsP2, TF, and 6K interfere with mitochondrial fission and fusion processes, leading to fragmentation. This fragmentation serves dual purposes: it suppresses the type I interferon response during the acute phase and initiates immunometabolic rewiring in the chronic phase. The review emphasizes the need for further research into these mechanisms to develop effective interventions.

papers.title: Workflow for Long-Read Amplicon Sequencing of Chikungunya Virus Using Oxford Nanopore Technology.
papers.abstract: This protocol provides a comprehensive, step-by-step workflow for whole-genome sequencing of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) using an amplicon-based strategy optimized for Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) platforms. The procedure includes detailed instructions for sample handling, viral RNA extraction, quality control, cDNA synthesis, multiplex PCR amplification, library preparation, sequencing, and primary bioinformatic processing. The protocol is designed to maximize reproducibility across laboratories and is suitable for genomic surveillance applications, including outbreak investigation and molecular epidemiology, even when working with low-to-moderate viral loads.

papers.title: Optimized Amplicon Strategy for Long-Read Sequencing of the Chikungunya Virus Genome.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense RNA alphavirus transmitted to humans primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Its global circulation and significant public health impact underscore the need to better understand the molecular mechanisms driving CHIKV pathogenesis and transmission. Although robust molecular biology methods exist for CHIKV genome sequencing, a major limitation for surveillance and research is the inability to determine whether two nucleotide variations co-occur within the same viral genome when they are separated beyond the span of typical short-read designs. Here, we describe an optimized approach for processing CHIKV RNA samples that generates large amplicons suitable for long-read nanopore sequencing. This protocol enables amplification of the complete CHIKV genome in only two or three amplicons and facilitates detection of co-occurring nucleotide variations across 4-7.5 kb within the same molecule, thereby simplifying sequencing workflows and improving resolution in studies of viral evolution.

papers.title_zh: 用于 基孔肯雅病毒 基因组 长读长测序的优化扩增子策略。
papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense RNA alphavirus transmitted to humans primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Its global circulation and significant public health impact underscore the need to better understand the molecular mechanisms driving CHIKV pathogenesis and transmission. Although robust molecular biology methods exist for CHIKV genome sequencing, a major limitation for surveillance and research is the inability to determine whether two nucleotide variations co-occur within the same viral genome when they are separated beyond the span of typical short-read designs. Here, we describe an optimized approach for processing CHIKV RNA samples that generates large amplicons suitable for long-read nanopore sequencing. This protocol enables amplification of the complete CHIKV genome in only two or three amplicons and facilitates detection of co-occurring nucleotide variations across 4-7.5 kb within the same molecule, thereby simplifying sequencing workflows and improving resolution in studies of viral evolution.

papers.title: Assessing the Vector Competence for Chikungunya Virus in Mosquitoes.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a human pathogenic, mosquito-borne virus (arbovirus), which is causing epidemic outbreaks among human populations in Africa, Asia, Europe, and South- and Central America including the Caribbean. The development of novel approaches to prevent mosquito transmission of the virus in the field requires a detailed study of CHIKV interactions with its mosquito vectors in the laboratory. In this chapter, we describe how to prepare Aedes aegypti mosquitoes for the infection with freshly cultivated CHIKV. We also describe quantitative and qualitative viral detection assays in mosquitoes based on plaque assays and the amplification of saliva samples in cell culture.

The chapter describes laboratory methods for infecting Aedes aegypti mosquitoes with freshly cultured CHIKV and for assessing viral presence using plaque assays and saliva amplification in cell culture. While the authors emphasize that detailed vector‐virus interaction studies are essential for developing novel transmission‐blocking strategies, the provided excerpt contains no information on study design, participant or mosquito cohorts, experimental results, or public‐health implications. Consequently, the evidence base is limited to methodological outlines without reported outcomes or identified limitations, yielding a low confidence assessment of the overall findings.

papers.title_zh: 评估 媒介 在蚊子中的 媒介 能力。
papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a human pathogenic, mosquito-borne virus (arbovirus), which is causing epidemic outbreaks among human populations in Africa, Asia, Europe, and South- and Central America including the Caribbean. The development of novel approaches to prevent mosquito transmission of the virus in the field requires a detailed study of CHIKV interactions with its mosquito vectors in the laboratory. In this chapter, we describe how to prepare Aedes aegypti mosquitoes for the infection with freshly cultivated CHIKV. We also describe quantitative and qualitative viral detection assays in mosquitoes based on plaque assays and the amplification of saliva samples in cell culture.
papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 是一种人类致病性蚊媒病毒(虫媒病毒),正在非洲、亚洲、欧洲、南美洲和中美洲(包括加勒比地区)人群中引起 暴发 流行。在现场开发预防蚊子 传播 病毒的新方法需要在实验室中详细研究 CHIKV 与其蚊子 媒介 的相互作用。在本章中,我们将介绍如何让埃及伊蚊做好感染新鲜培养的 CHIKV 的准备。我们还描述了基于噬菌斑测定和细胞培养中唾液样本扩增的蚊子的定量和定性病毒检测测定。

papers.title: Chikungunya Virus Infection of Monocytes Generates a Persistent Macrophage Reservoir That Promotes IFN-π/IL-27–STAT1- and NF-κB–Driven Chronic Arthritis
papers.abstract: Abstract Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection causes acute febrile illness that frequently progresses to chronic arthralgia. Although monocytes are CHIKV targets, whether viral exposure drives their differentiation into macrophages to sustain persistent inflammation remains incompletely understood. To address this, we integrated transcriptomic profiling of pediatric CHIKV patients during acute and convalescent phases, in vitro differentiation of primary human monocytes into macrophages under CHIKV infection, and single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) of joint-associated macrophages from an immunocompetent mouse model of chronic CHIKV arthritis at 28 days post-infection. In acute patients, we observed a marked upregulation of monocyte/macrophage markers alongside robust, IFN-dependent JAK-STAT signaling. In vitro , CHIKV-infected monocytes differentiated into persistently infected macrophages (MDM-CHIKV) that closely aligned with an M1-polarized transcriptional profile. These cells exhibited STAT1/NF-κB-dependent inflammation, ISG induction, and enhanced antigen presentation capacity. Remarkably, MDM-CHIKV uniquely produced IFN-π/IL-27, revealing an alternative non-canonical axis where JAK-STAT activation persists despite the absence of classical type I IFNs. Functionally, MDM-CHIKV displayed an enhanced respiratory burst upon immune complex uptake, pointing to FcγR-mediated pathology, as well as complement activation and T-cell stimulatory capacity. However, upon TLR4 challenge, these cells retained partial regulatory responses via IL-10 and TGF-β; this hybrid immunophenotype offers a potential mechanistic explanation for relapsing arthralgia. Additionally, scRNA-seq of murine joints confirmed that persistent CHIKV replication was restricted to a distinct macrophage subset that resembles MDM-CHIKV, establishing these cells as the primary in vivo viral reservoir. Mirroring our human findings, joint-associated murine macrophage subsets exhibited elevated IFN-π / IL-27 expression alongside robust NF-κB/STAT1-dependent inflammatory signatures ( Tnf , Il1β , Il6, Ccl2 , Ccl5 , Cxcl9 , Cxcl10 , Cxcl1–3, and/or Ptgs2 ), underscoring their critical role in sustaining chronic arthritis. Collectively, our findings demonstrate that CHIKV actively drives monocyte-to-macrophage differentiation into a persistently infected, M1-skewed hybrid phenotype that serves as a viral reservoir and fuels pro-arthritic inflammation. Consequently, macrophage reprogramming, the non-canonical IFN-π/IL-27–STAT1 axis, FcγR-mediated phagocytosis, and complement activation emerge as central pathogenic nodes and promising therapeutic targets for mitigating chronic post-CHIKV arthropathy. Author Summary Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a mosquito-borne pathogen that causes acute fever and, in a substantial proportion of patients, progresses to chronic, debilitating joint pain that can last for months or even years. The mechanisms by which the virus establishes this persistent arthritic disease remain poorly understood, and effective treatments for chronic CHIKV arthritis are lacking. In this study, we investigated whether CHIKV infection of monocytes, immune cells that circulate in the blood, actively drives their transformation into macrophages, a cell type that resides in tissues and plays a central role in inflammation. By analyzing blood samples from children with acute and convalescent CHIKV disease, we found strong signs that monocyte-to-macrophage differentiation is actively occurring during natural infection. Using an in vitro model, we showed that CHIKV-infected monocytes differentiate into macrophages that become persistently infected, carrying the virus for extended periods. These virus-exposed macrophages adopt a mixed activation state, combining features of classical pro-inflammatory (M1) and regulatory (M2) macrophages. Notably, they produce a cytokine called IFN-π/IL-27, which drives chronic inflammation through a specific signaling pathway, while also showing enhanced capacity to activate T cells, trigger complement cascades, and mount strong oxidative responses upon encountering immune complexes, features that may explain the waxing and waning joint symptoms seen in patients. To confirm these findings in a living system, we analyzed joint tissues from a mouse model of chronic CHIKV arthritis using single-cell technology. We discovered that a specific subset of joint-resident macrophages serves as the primary viral reservoir, actively replicating the virus and producing IFN-π/IL-27 and other inflammatory molecules that perpetuate joint inflammation and damage. Collectively, our work reveals that CHIKV hijacks the normal differentiation process of monocytes to create a long-lived, virus-harboring macrophage population that fuels chronic joint inflammation. We identify the IFN-π/IL-27 signaling pathway, complement activation, and antibody-driven macrophage responses as key drivers of disease. These findings open new avenues for therapeutic intervention, suggesting that targeting these pathways could alleviate chronic arthritis in patients suffering from long-term CHIKV disease.

By analyzing blood samples from children with acute and convalescent CHIKV disease, we found strong signs that monocyte-to-macrophage differentiation is actively occurring during natural infection. Using an in vitro model, we showed that CHIKV-infected monocytes differentiate into macrophages that become persistently infected, carrying the virus for extended periods. These virus-exposed macrophages adopt a mixed activation state, combining features of classical pro-inflammatory (M1) and regulatory (M2) macrophages. Notably, they produce a cytokine called IFN-π/IL-27, which drives chronic inflammation through a specific signaling pathway, while also showing enhanced capacity to activate T cells, trigger complement cascades, and mount strong oxidative responses upon encountering immune complexes, features that may explain the waxing and waning joint symptoms seen in patients. To confirm these findings in a living system, we analyzed joint tissues from a mouse model of chronic CHIKV arthritis using single-cell technology. We discovered that a specific subset of joint-resident macrophages serves as the primary viral reservoir, actively replicating the virus and producing IFN-π/IL-27 and other inflammatory molecules that perpetuate joint inflammation and damage. Collectively, our work reveals that CHIKV hijacks the normal differentiation process of monocytes to create a long-lived, virus-harboring macrophage population that fuels chronic joint inflammation. We identify the IFN-π/IL-27 signaling pathway, complement activation, and antibody-driven macrophage responses as key drivers of disease. These findings open new avenues for therapeutic intervention, suggesting that targeting these pathways could alleviate chronic arthritis in patients suffering from long-term CHIKV disease.

papers.title_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 单核细胞感染产生持久性巨噬细胞 储存宿主,促进 IFN-π/IL-27–STAT1 和 NF-κB 驱动的慢性关节炎
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection causes acute febrile illness that frequently progresses to chronic arthralgia. Although monocytes are CHIKV targets, whether viral exposure drives their differentiation into macrophages to sustain persistent inflammation remains incompletely understood. To address this, we integrated transcriptomic profiling of pediatric CHIKV patients during acute and convalescent phases, in vitro differentiation of primary human monocytes into macrophages under CHIKV infection, and single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) of joint-associated macrophages from an immunocompetent mouse model of chronic CHIKV arthritis at 28 days post-infection. In acute patients, we observed a marked upregulation of monocyte/macrophage markers alongside robust, IFN-dependent JAK-STAT signaling. In vitro , CHIKV-infected monocytes differentiated into persistently infected macrophages (MDM-CHIKV) that closely aligned with an M1-polarized transcriptional profile. These cells exhibited STAT1/NF-κB-dependent inflammation, ISG induction, and enhanced antigen presentation capacity. Remarkably, MDM-CHIKV uniquely produced IFN-π/IL-27, revealing an alternative non-canonical axis where JAK-STAT activation persists despite the absence of classical type I IFNs. Functionally, MDM-CHIKV displayed an enhanced respiratory burst upon immune complex uptake, pointing to FcγR-mediated pathology, as well as complement activation and T-cell stimulatory capacity. However, upon TLR4 challenge, these cells retained partial regulatory responses via IL-10 and TGF-β; this hybrid immunophenotype offers a potential mechanistic explanation for relapsing arthralgia. Additionally, scRNA-seq of murine joints confirmed that persistent CHIKV replication was restricted to a distinct macrophage subset that resembles MDM-CHIKV, establishing these cells as the primary in vivo viral reservoir. Mirroring our human findings, joint-associated murine macrophage subsets exhibited elevated IFN-π / IL-27 expression alongside robust NF-κB/STAT1-dependent inflammatory signatures ( Tnf , Il1β , Il6, Ccl2 , Ccl5 , Cxcl9 , Cxcl10 , Cxcl1–3, and/or Ptgs2 ), underscoring their critical role in sustaining chronic arthritis. Collectively, our findings demonstrate that CHIKV actively drives monocyte-to-macrophage differentiation into a persistently infected, M1-skewed hybrid phenotype that serves as a viral reservoir and fuels pro-arthritic inflammation. Consequently, macrophage reprogramming, the non-canonical IFN-π/IL-27–STAT1 axis, FcγR-mediated phagocytosis, and complement activation emerge as central pathogenic nodes and promising therapeutic targets for mitigating chronic post-CHIKV arthropathy. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 感染会导致急性发热性疾病,并经常进展为慢性 关节痛。尽管单核细胞是 CHIKV 的靶标,但病毒暴露是否会促使其分化为巨噬细胞以维持持续的炎症仍不完全清楚。为了解决这个问题,我们整合了儿科 CHIKV 患者在急性期和恢复期的转录组学分析、CHIKV 感染下原代人单核细胞体外分化为巨噬细胞,以及感染后 28 天对慢性 CHIKV 关节炎免疫活性小鼠模型的关节相关巨噬细胞的单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq)。在急性患者中,我们观察到单核细胞/巨噬细胞标记物显着上调,同时存在强健的 IFN 依赖性 JAK-STAT 信号传导。在体外,CHIKV 感染的单核细胞分化为持续感染的巨噬细胞 (MDM-CHIKV),其与 M1 极化转录谱密切相关。这些细胞表现出 STAT1/NF-κB 依赖性炎症、ISG 诱导和增强的抗原呈递能力。值得注意的是,MDM-CHIKV 独特地产生 IFN-π/IL-27,揭示了一个替代的非规范轴,其中尽管不存在经典的 I 型 IFN,JAK-STAT 激活仍然持续存在。从功能上讲,MDM-CHIKV 在吸收免疫复合物后表现出增强的呼吸爆发,这表明 FcγR 介导的病理学以及补体激活和 T 细胞刺激能力。然而,在 TLR4 攻击后,这些细胞通过 IL-10 和 TGF-β 保留了部分调节反应;这种混合免疫表型为复发性 关节痛 提供了潜在的机制解释。此外,小鼠关节的 scRNA-seq 证实,持续的 CHIKV 复制仅限于类似于 MDM-CHIKV 的独特巨噬细胞子集,从而将这些细胞确定为主要的体内病毒 储存宿主。与我们的人类研究结果相似,关节相关的小鼠巨噬细胞亚群表现出 IFN-π / IL-27 表达升高以及强大的 NF-κB/STAT1 依赖性炎症特征(Tnf、Il1β、Il6、Ccl2、Ccl5、Cxcl9、Cxcl10、Cxcl1–3 和/或 Ptgs2),强调了它们在维持慢性关节炎中的关键作用。总的来说,我们的研究结果表明,CHIKV 主动驱动单核细胞向巨噬细胞分化为持续感染的、M1 偏向的混合表型,充当病毒 储存宿主 并加剧促关节炎炎症。因此,巨噬细胞重编程、非经典 IFN-π/IL-27-STAT1 轴、FcγR 介导的吞噬作用和补体激活成为中心致病节点和缓解慢性 CHIKV 后关节病的有希望的治疗靶点。作者摘要 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 是一种由蚊子传播的病原体,会引起急性发烧,并且在相当一部分患者中会发展为慢性、衰弱性关节疼痛,可持续数月甚至数年。该病毒引起这种持续性关节炎疾病的机制仍知之甚少,并且缺乏治疗慢性 CHIKV 关节炎的有效 治疗。在这项研究中,我们研究了单核细胞(血液中循环的免疫细胞)的 CHIKV 感染是否会主动驱动其转化为巨噬细胞(一种驻留在组织中并在炎症中发挥核心作用的细胞类型)。通过分析患有急性和恢复期 CHIKV 疾病的儿童的血液样本,我们发现了强烈的迹象,表明自然感染期间单核细胞向巨噬细胞的分化正在活跃发生。使用体外模型,我们发现 CHIKV 感染的单核细胞分化为巨噬细胞,巨噬细胞会持续感染,并长时间携带病毒。这些暴露于病毒的巨噬细胞采用混合激活状态,结合了经典促炎性(M1)和调节性(M2)巨噬细胞的特征。值得注意的是,它们产生一种名为 IFN-π/IL-27 的细胞因子,通过特定的信号通路驱动慢性炎症,同时还表现出增强的激活 T 细胞、触发补体级联反应以及在遇到免疫复合物时产生强烈氧化反应的能力,这些特征可以解释患者所见的关节症状的变化。为了在生命系统中证实这些发现,我们使用单细胞技术分析了慢性 CHIKV 关节炎小鼠模型的关节组织。我们发现关节驻留巨噬细胞的特定子集充当主要病毒 储存宿主,积极复制病毒并产生 IFN-π/IL-27 和其他炎症分子,使关节炎症和损伤永久化。总的来说,我们的工作表明,CHIKV 劫持了单核细胞的正常分化过程,以产生长寿的、携带病毒的巨噬细胞群,从而加剧慢性关节炎症。我们确定 IFN-π/IL-27 信号通路、补体激活和抗体驱动的巨噬细胞反应是疾病的关键驱动因素。这些发现为治疗干预开辟了新途径,表明针对这些途径可以缓解患有长期 CHIKV 疾病的患者的慢性关节炎。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解单核细胞的 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 感染是否会促使其分化为巨噬细胞,从而维持慢性炎症和关节炎。这解决了了解慢性 CHIKV 关节炎背后机制的知识差距,这是一个重大的公共卫生问题。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究结合了儿科 CHIKV 患者样本、原代人单核细胞的体外分化,以及来自慢性 CHIKV 关节炎免疫功能正常小鼠模型的关节相关巨噬细胞的单细胞 RNA 测序。
analysis_zh.methods: 从 CHIKV 患者中分离单核细胞并在体外感染以分化为巨噬细胞。进行转录组分析和单细胞 RNA 测序来分析基因表达模式并确定关键信号通路。
analysis_zh.main_results: CHIKV 感染的单核细胞分化为持续感染的巨噬细胞 (MDM-CHIKV),其表现出混合的 M1/M2 激活状态、强大的 JAK-STAT 信号传导和增强的抗原呈递能力。单细胞 RNA 测序证实,小鼠模型中的关节巨噬细胞也表现出 IFN-π/IL-27 表达升高和其他炎症特征。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究表明,CHIKV 感染会驱动单核细胞向巨噬细胞分化为持续感染的、M1 偏向的混合表型,该表型充当病毒 储存宿主,并通过 IFN-π/IL-27 信号传导和增强的 免疫应答 加剧慢性关节炎。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了靶向 IFN-π/IL-27 信号通路、补体激活和抗体驱动的巨噬细胞反应对于慢性 CHIKV 关节炎治疗干预的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于使用动物模型且缺乏直接的人类干预试验而受到限制。由于该研究的观察性质以及需要在人类受试者中进一步验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Surface Plasmon Resonance-Based Analysis of Ligand Binding Kinetics in Chikungunya Virus Drug Discovery.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an emerging arbovirus lacking widely effective antiviral therapies, highlighting the need to characterize molecular interactions essential for its replication and pathogenesis. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) is a sensitive, label-free technique that enables real-time analysis of biomolecular interactions by detecting refractive index changes at a sensor surface. SPR provides precise kinetic and affinity measurements for protein-protein, protein-RNA, and protein-ligand interactions using minimal sample quantities and supporting high-throughput screening. In CHIKV research, it has been applied to evaluate antiviral compounds, antibodies, receptor binding, and viral protein complexes. This chapter outlines key methodological considerations, including ligand preparation, immobilization strategies, assay optimization, and kinetic analysis.

papers.title: RT-RPA-Assisted CRISPR/Cas12a-Based Isothermal Detection of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is transmitted through the bite of Aedes mosquitoes, specifically A. CHIKV belongs to the alphavirus with a positive-sense ssRNA genome of 11-12 kb size. The virus has been reported from various geographical regions across the globe. Chikungunya fever is an acute febrile illness, which, if left untreated, may develop into chronic arthralgia that may persist for several months or acute encephalitis syndrome. Therefore, early diagnosis of CHIKV is crucial to initiate prompt supportive treatment. Laboratory diagnosis of CHIKV typically relies on serological tests such as IgM antigen capture ELISA and molecular methods including RT-PCR or qRT-PCR. However, both these methods are not viable in peripheral settings. This chapter highlights recent advancements in molecular detection techniques for CHIKV, specifically isothermal detection methods that eliminate the requirement for complex instruments. The detection is facilitated by RT-RPA and CRISPR/Cas12a endonuclease. The assay offers advantages over existing methods such as rapid and early detection, and eliminates cross-over contamination, ultra-sensitivity, high specificity, and ease of result interpretation.

papers.title: Production of Viral Particles from a Chikungunya Virus Infectious Clone.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense single-stranded RNA virus, which poses challenges for its study and genetic manipulation. Because direct mutagenesis of viral RNA genomes is technically impractical, reverse genetics systems are essential tools for investigating viral biology. To enable such approaches, infectious clones containing a full-length cDNA copy of the viral genome are constructed. The cDNA is positioned under the control of a bacteriophage RNA polymerase promoter, allowing commercial RNA polymerases to use the linearized plasmid as a template for the in vitro transcription of full-length viral genomic RNA (gRNA). Importantly, positive-sense viral genomes serve as mRNAs for the translation of viral proteins in a cellular environment, meaning that these transcripts contain all the information required to initiate viral replication. Following transfection into permissive cultured cells, viral proteins are expressed, enabling genome replication and, ultimately, the recovery of infectious particles from the cell supernatant. Here, we describe a detailed procedure for generating CHIKV particles through plasmid linearization, in vitro transcription, and subsequent RNA transfection.

papers.title: Naked-Eye Visual Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification Method for the Rapid Detection of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) represents a significant global health threat due to its recent resurgence. This protocol highlights the use of capillary-modified visual loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) technology for the rapid detection of CHIKV. papers.title: Plaque Reduction Neutralization Test Against Chikungunya Virus Using Liver Homogenate.
papers.abstract: We adapted the plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT) to detect chikungunya virus (CHIKV) neutralizing antibodies in liver homogenates instead of serum. This approach enables serological investigation using tissues collected from animal carcasses as nonhuman primate ones, during arbovirus surveillance, expanding opportunities for CHIKV monitoring and strengthening epidemiological surveillance efforts.

The modified PRNT was applied to CHIKV lineages and demonstrated feasibility for monitoring the virus. The approach expands opportunities for CHIKV surveillance and strengthens epidemiological efforts. However, the evidence is based solely on abstract-level reporting, and the study lacks detailed statistical analysis, limiting the confidence in the findings to a moderate level.

papers.title: In Silico Drug Design of Chikungunya Antivirals: Using Consensus Methods for Virtual Screening.
papers.abstract: Structure-based virtual screening is an attractive strategy in drug design. It enables the selection of potential binders to target biomolecules with known molecular structures, providing a rational framework for studying their mechanisms of action and guiding further optimization. However, accurately predicting the free energy of binding remains an extremely challenging task, and the available tools only provide approximate estimates. In this context, one strategy to improve the predictive power of virtual screening and increase the probability of identifying true binders is to employ multiple docking algorithms and combine their results using a consensus method. In this chapter, we will describe a step-by-step methodology to perform this task. We will conduct a virtual screening using AutoDock Vina, AutoDock4, and LeDock, and then combine their results employing the Exponential Consensus Ranking algorithm. Finally, we will discuss possible extensions of this strategy, such as incorporating Molecular Dynamics simulations as an additional filter in the virtual screening or integrating the novel Artificial Intelligence-based methodologies into the consensus framework.

papers.title: Expression and Purification of nsP2 Protease of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: The nonstructural protein 2 (nsP2) of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an essential cysteine protease involved in viral polyprotein processing and replication complex regulation. Biochemical and structural studies of nsP2 require the availability of highly pure and enzymatically active protein. In this chapter, we describe a straightforward protocol for the heterologous expression and purification of CHIKV nsP2 protease domain (nsP2pro) in Escherichia coli. The protein is expressed at low temperature as a His-tagged construct and purified under native conditions by immobilized metal ion affinity chromatography, followed by dialysis for buffer exchange. The procedure typically yields milligram quantities of highly pure (>95%) and active nsP2pro, and has been successfully applied to wild-type and mutant variants for enzymatic assays and inhibitor screening.

papers.title: Chikungunya Virus Infection in Paraffin-Embedded Tissue: Analysis of Histological Alterations and Viral Detection by Immunohistochemistry.
papers.abstract: Histopathological analysis of tissues infected with Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), including biopsy and autopsy specimens, can provide valuable insights into the pathogenesis of atypical and fatal cases. By examining tissue architecture and cellular alterations under the microscope, it is possible to identify patterns of injury, inflammation, and cellular degeneration. These morphological findings provide evidence of how the pathogen interacts with host cells and tissues. Moreover, immunohistochemistry may be performed in tissue sections for the detection of viral antigens. Importantly, this technique allows the characterization of diverse biologically relevant targets in tissue samples, such as distinct immune cell subsets, cytokines, and additional molecular markers. This is accomplished by the use of antibodies selected for their specificity toward the antigen of interest. In this chapter, we present a concise overview of how histological analysis and immunohistochemical approaches can enhance the understanding of CHIKV-associated pathological mechanisms.

papers.title_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 石蜡包埋组织中的感染:通过免疫组织化学分析组织学改变和病毒检测。
papers.source_body_en: Histopathological analysis of tissues infected with Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), including biopsy and autopsy specimens, can provide valuable insights into the pathogenesis of atypical and fatal cases. By examining tissue architecture and cellular alterations under the microscope, it is possible to identify patterns of injury, inflammation, and cellular degeneration. These morphological findings provide evidence of how the pathogen interacts with host cells and tissues. Moreover, immunohistochemistry may be performed in tissue sections for the detection of viral antigens. Importantly, this technique allows the characterization of diverse biologically relevant targets in tissue samples, such as distinct immune cell subsets, cytokines, and additional molecular markers. This is accomplished by the use of antibodies selected for their specificity toward the antigen of interest. In this chapter, we present a concise overview of how histological analysis and immunohistochemical approaches can enhance the understanding of CHIKV-associated pathological mechanisms.

papers.title: Assessing Chikungunya Virus Protease Activity and Pharmacological Inhibition Using the acc-CHIK 15 -dnp Fluorogenic Peptide Substrate.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus, a mosquito-borne alphavirus, poses a significant global health threat due to its rapid spread and lack of approved antiviral therapies. The viral nonstructural protein 2 protease (nsP2p) plays a critical role in processing the viral polyprotein to produce key viral enzymes, making it an attractive target for drug development. In this study, we describe the expression and purification of recombinant CHIKV nsP2 protease and establish a robust fluorogenic assay to measure its enzymatic activity using the acc-CHIK 15 -dnp peptide substrate. The assay enables real-time monitoring of proteolytic cleavage and provides a platform for evaluating small-molecule inhibitors. We present optimized conditions for protein expression in E. coli, affinity purification, and tag removal, achieving high-purity nsP2 protease suitable for biochemical characterization. Using this system, we also provide a robust protocol for determining IC50 values for candidate inhibitors. This work provides a reproducible methodology for high-throughput screening of CHIKV protease inhibitors, facilitating the discovery of potential antiviral compounds against chikungunya virus.

analysis_zh.methods: 在本研究中,我们描述了重组 CHIKV nsP2 蛋白酶的表达和纯化,并建立了强大的荧光测定法,使用 acc-CHIK 15 -dnp 肽底物测量其酶活性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 使用该系统,我们还提供了一个强大的方案来确定候选抑制剂的 IC50 值。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项工作为 CHIKV 蛋白酶抑制剂的高通量筛选提供了一种可重复的方法,有助于发现针对 基孔肯雅病毒 的潜在 抗病毒药物 化合物。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为 基孔肯雅病毒 疗法的开发提供信息,从而有可能减轻全球健康负担。

papers.title: Quantification of Chikungunya Virus RNA by Real-Time RT-PCR Assay.
papers.abstract: RT-qPCR is characterized by‌ high sensitivity, strong specificity, excellent reproducibility, and operational simplicity, ‌enabling‌ rapid quantification of viral RNA within a short timeframe. The real-time PCR system relies upon the measurement of a fluorescent reporter during PCR, in which the amount of emitted fluorescence is directly proportional to the amount of the PCR product in a reaction. Here, we describe the use of TaqMan® probe-based one-tube Real-time reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) for the detection and quantification of the Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) RNA.

papers.title: Determination of Chikungunya Virus Infectious Titer Using Plaque Assays.
papers.abstract: The plaque-forming assay is the gold-standard method for measuring infectious viral particles. In this technique, lytic viruses infect and destroy host cells, but their spread is restricted by a viscous overlay medium. As a result, new viral particles can only infect neighboring cells, leading to localized clear areas known as plaques, which become visible after staining the remaining living cells. The number of plaques reflects the number of infectious viral particles initially present in the sample and is reported as plaque-forming units (PFU) per sample volume. In this protocol, we describe step by step how to perform a plaque-forming assay to determine the concentration of chikungunya virus in a cell culture supernatant.

papers.source_body_en: The plaque-forming assay is the gold-standard method for measuring infectious viral particles. In this technique, lytic viruses infect and destroy host cells, but their spread is restricted by a viscous overlay medium. As a result, new viral particles can only infect neighboring cells, leading to localized clear areas known as plaques, which become visible after staining the remaining living cells. The number of plaques reflects the number of infectious viral particles initially present in the sample and is reported as plaque-forming units (PFU) per sample volume. In this protocol, we describe step by step how to perform a plaque-forming assay to determine the concentration of chikungunya virus in a cell culture supernatant.

papers.title: Automated Counting of Chikungunya Virus-Formed Plaques.
papers.abstract: The cytopathic effect (CPE) is a key to understanding the pathogenicity of the chikungunya virus (CHIKV) and is useful for evaluating viral infectivity in vitro. The plaque assay, based on the CPE induced by viral infection, provides an infectious virus titer for test samples. Additionally, the assay is simple, quantitative, and cost-effective. Thus, the plaque assay remains the gold standard for determining the infectivity of CHIKV. However, manually counting of virus-induced plaques with the naked eye or under the microscope is often time-consuming and labor-intensive. Therefore, automated plaque-counting software would improve the consistency and efficiency of plaque counting. We recently developed plaQuest, a stand-alone Windows software that enables rapid, reliable plaque counting for CHIKV. In this chapter, we describe the basic procedure for detecting and counting the CHIKV-formed plaques in a 24-well plate.

papers.title: A-083 Rapid screening for acute chikungunya virus infection using an interpretable machine learning model based on routine complete blood count parameters.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The 2025 Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) outbreak in Foshan, China, highlighted an urgent need for rapid screening tools. Molecular diagnostics are constrained by time, cost, and availability. This study aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine learning model using routine complete blood count (CBC) parameters to identify patients at high risk of CHIKV infection. Methods A retrospective cohort study was conducted on 1,537 suspected CHIKV patients from two medical centers in Foshan. CBC and cell population data (CPD) were obtained using Mindray BC-7500 analyzers. CHIKV infection was confirmed by reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). After rigorous data preprocessing and feature selection using LASSO regression, four models Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), and LightGBM (LGBM) were developed on a training set (n=1,132 from Center A) and evaluated on an internal test set (n=192) and an independent external test set (n=213 from Center B). Model performance was assessed by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), sensitivity, specificity, and net benefit. Results In the external validation set, the LR model demonstrated superior and robust performance (AUC = 0.807, sensitivity = 88.0%, specificity = 65.0%, NPV = 93.0%), significantly outperforming the tree-based models. Decision curve analysis confirmed its clinical utility across a wide range of risk thresholds. SHAP analysis revealed that lower white blood cell count (WBC_N), lower lymphocyte percentage (Lym%), and increased neutrophil morphological heterogeneity (D_Neu_SSC_CV) were the strongest predictors, aligning with the established pathophysiology of CHIKV infection. Conclusion We developed an interpretable LR model based on CBC parameters that can effectively screen for acute CHIKV infection with high sensitivity and NPV. This model serves as a reliable, rapid, and cost-effective tool for patient triage during outbreaks, especially in resource-limited settings awaiting confirmatory PCR testing.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2025 年在中国佛山举行的 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 暴发 凸显了对快速筛查工具的迫切需求。分子诊断受到时间、成本和可用性的限制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对佛山两个医疗中心的 1,537 名疑似 CHIKV 患者进行了 队列研究 回顾性研究。通过逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR)证实了 CHIKV 感染。
elements_zh.methods: 使用迈瑞BC-7500分析仪获取全血细胞计数(CBC)和细胞群体数据(CPD)。在进行严格的数据预处理和使用LASSO回归进行特征选择后,基于训练集(来自中心A的n=1,132例)开发了四个模型:逻辑回归(LR)、支持向量机(SVM)、随机森林(RF)和LightGBM(LGBM),并在内部测试集(n=192)和独立的外部测试集(来自中心B的n=213例)上进行评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 在外部验证集中,LR模型表现出优越且稳健的性能(AUC = 0.807,敏感性= 88.0%,特异性= 65.0%,NPV = 93.0%),显着优于基于树的模型。决策曲线分析证实了其在各种风险阈值中的临床实用性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: SHAP 分析显示,较低的白细胞计数 (WBC_N)、较低的淋巴细胞百分比 (Lym%) 和增加的中性粒细胞形态异质性 (D_Neu_SSC_CV) 是最强的预测因子,与已建立的 CHIKV 感染病理生理学相一致。该模型可作为 暴发 期间患者分诊的可靠、快速且经济高效的工具,特别是在等待确认性 PCR 检测的资源有限的环境中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,LR模型可用于快速筛查急性CHIKV感染,这对于及时诊断和暴发期间的管理至关重要。这可以改善资源有限环境中的患者分类和资源分配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于回顾性数据,可能会引入偏差。由于结果的普遍性有限且缺乏前瞻性验证,证据是中等的。

papers.title_zh: A-083 使用基于常规全血细胞计数参数的可解释机器学习模型快速筛查急性 基孔肯雅病毒 感染。
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background The 2025 Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) outbreak in Foshan, China, highlighted an urgent need for rapid screening tools. Molecular diagnostics are constrained by time, cost, and availability. This study aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine learning model using routine complete blood count (CBC) parameters to identify patients at high risk of CHIKV infection. Methods A retrospective cohort study was conducted on 1,537 suspected CHIKV patients from two medical centers in Foshan. CBC and cell population data (CPD) were obtained using Mindray BC-7500 analyzers. CHIKV infection was confirmed by reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). After rigorous data preprocessing and feature selection using LASSO regression, four models Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), and LightGBM (LGBM) were developed on a training set (n=1,132 from Center A) and evaluated on an internal test set (n=192) and an independent external test set (n=213 from Center B). Model performance was assessed by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), sensitivity, specificity, and net benefit. Results In the external validation set, the LR model demonstrated superior and robust performance (AUC = 0.807, sensitivity = 88.0%, specificity = 65.0%, NPV = 93.0%), significantly outperforming the tree-based models. Decision curve analysis confirmed its clinical utility across a wide range of risk thresholds. SHAP analysis revealed that lower white blood cell count (WBC_N), lower lymphocyte percentage (Lym%), and increased neutrophil morphological heterogeneity (D_Neu_SSC_CV) were the strongest predictors, aligning with the established pathophysiology of CHIKV infection. Conclusion We developed an interpretable LR model based on CBC parameters that can effectively screen for acute CHIKV infection with high sensitivity and NPV. This model serves as a reliable, rapid, and cost-effective tool for patient triage during outbreaks, especially in resource-limited settings awaiting confirmatory PCR testing.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 2025年在中国佛山发生的基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)疫情凸显了快速筛查工具的迫切需求。分子诊断方法受到时间、成本和可获得性的限制。本研究旨在利用常规的全血细胞计数(CBC)参数开发并验证一种可解释的机器学习模型,以识别CHIKV感染的高风险患者。方法 本研究回顾性分析了来自佛山两家医疗机构的1,537例疑似CHIKV患者的资料。使用迈瑞BC-7500分析仪获取全血细胞计数(CBC)和细胞群体数据(CPD)。通过逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR)确认CHIKV感染。在进行严格的数据预处理和使用LASSO回归进行特征选择后,基于训练集(来自中心A的n=1,132例)开发了四个模型:逻辑回归(LR)、支持向量机(SVM)、随机森林(RF)和LightGBM(LGBM),并在内部测试集(n=192)和独立的外部测试集(来自中心B的n=213例)上进行评估。模型性能通过接收者操作特征曲线下的面积(AUC)、灵敏度、特异性和净效益进行评估。结果 在外部验证集中,LR模型表现出优越且稳定的性能(AUC = 0.807,灵敏度 = 88.0%,特异度 = 65.0%,阴性预测值 = 93.0%),显著优于基于树的模型。决策曲线分析证实了其在广泛风险阈值范围内的临床实用性。SHAP分析显示,较低的白细胞计数(WBC_N)、较低的淋巴细胞百分比(Lym%)以及增加的中性粒细胞形态异质性(D_Neu_SSC_CV)是最重要的预测因子,这与CHIKV感染的已知发病机制一致。结论 我们开发了一种基于CBC参数的可解释LR模型,能够有效筛查急性CHIKV感染,具有高灵敏度和阴性预测值。该模型可作为患者分诊的可靠、快速且经济的工具,特别是在等待确认性PCR检测的资源有限环境中。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对佛山两个医疗中心的 1,537 名疑似 CHIKV 患者进行了 队列研究 回顾性研究。通过逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR)证实了 CHIKV 感染。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用迈瑞BC-7500分析仪获取全血细胞计数(CBC)和细胞群体数据(CPD)。在进行严格的数据预处理和使用LASSO回归进行特征选择后,基于训练集(来自中心A的n=1,132例)开发了四个模型:逻辑回归(LR)、支持向量机(SVM)、随机森林(RF)和LightGBM(LGBM),并在内部测试集(n=192)和独立的外部测试集(来自中心B的n=213例)上进行评估。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于回顾性数据,可能会引入偏差。由于结果的普遍性有限且缺乏前瞻性验证,证据是中等的。

papers.title: Surgery as a Management Option for Post-Chikungunya Chronic Synovitis Presenting as a Dorsal Wrist Mass
papers.abstract: Introduction: Chikungunya fever is a mosquito-borne viral illness that commonly causes acute febrile disease followed by persistent musculoskeletal manifestations. Localised mass-like synovial lesions of the wrist following Chikungunya infection are rarely reported. Case presentation: We report a 40-year-old female who developed a progressively enlarging dorsal wrist mass following serologically confirmed Chikungunya infection. Despite conservative treatment, she developed significant functional limitations. Imaging demonstrated inflammatory synovitis and extensor tenosynovitis. Surgical excision was performed, and histopathology confirmed chronic inflammatory synovitis. Discussion: Post-Chikungunya chronic synovitis is thought to result from persistent immune-mediated inflammation. While medical management remains first-line, surgery may be indicated in selected cases with Localised disease and functional impairment. Conclusion: This case highlights surgery as a valuable management option for Localised post-Chikungunya chronic synovitis presenting as a dorsal wrist mass.
authors: A. A. Y. S. Adikari Adikari
papers.journal: Asian journal of Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery

papers.title_zh: 手术作为治疗基孔肯雅热后慢性滑膜炎(表现为手腕背侧肿块)的一种治疗选择
papers.source_body_en: Introduction: Chikungunya fever is a mosquito-borne viral illness that commonly causes acute febrile disease followed by persistent musculoskeletal manifestations. Localised mass-like synovial lesions of the wrist following Chikungunya infection are rarely reported. Case presentation: We report a 40-year-old female who developed a progressively enlarging dorsal wrist mass following serologically confirmed Chikungunya infection. Despite conservative treatment, she developed significant functional limitations. Imaging demonstrated inflammatory synovitis and extensor tenosynovitis. Surgical excision was performed, and histopathology confirmed chronic inflammatory synovitis. Discussion: Post-Chikungunya chronic synovitis is thought to result from persistent immune-mediated inflammation. While medical management remains first-line, surgery may be indicated in selected cases with Localised disease and functional impairment. Conclusion: This case highlights surgery as a valuable management option for Localised post-Chikungunya chronic synovitis presenting as a dorsal wrist mass.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:基孔肯雅热 是一种蚊媒病毒性疾病,通常会导致急性发热性疾病,随后出现持续的肌肉骨骼症状。基孔肯雅热感染后手腕局部肿块样滑膜病变的报道很少。病例介绍:我们报道了一名 40 岁女性,在血清学确诊的基孔肯雅热感染后出现了逐渐增大的手腕背侧肿块。尽管 治疗 比较保守,她还是出现了明显的功能限制。影像学显示炎症性滑膜炎和伸肌腱鞘炎。进行手术切除,组织病理学证实为慢性炎症性滑膜炎。讨论:基孔肯雅热后慢性滑膜炎被认为是由持续性免疫介导的炎症引起的。虽然医疗管理仍然是一线治疗,但对于某些患有局部疾病和功能障碍的病例可能需要手术治疗。结论:该病例强调手术是治疗表现为手腕背侧肿块的局限性基孔肯雅热后慢性滑膜炎的一种有价值的治疗选择。

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to identify host factors that support Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) replication in macrophages, as CHIKV infection is associated with acute illness and ongoing inflammatory symptoms. The researchers used mass spectrometry-based phosphoprotein enrichment to analyze CHIKV-infected RAW264.7 macrophages and compared them with mock-infected cells. The analysis revealed 2,096 altered proteins, with 212 differentially regulated, including 140 upregulated and 72 downregulated proteins. The findings suggest that heat shock cognate 71 protein is a host factor that supports CHIKV replication, offering novel insights into the molecular mechanisms of CHIKV infection. This may have implications for developing targeted antiviral therapies. However, the study is limited to an abstract-only analysis, which may restrict the depth of interpretation, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of detailed experimental outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在确定支持 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 在巨噬细胞中复制的 宿主 因子,因为 CHIKV 感染会诱发急性疾病和持续的炎症症状,而巨噬细胞被认为发挥着重要但尚未完全了解的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用基于质谱的磷蛋白富集对 CHIKV 感染的 RAW264.7 巨噬细胞进行蛋白质组学分析,以表征与 CHIKV 感染相关的 宿主 细胞反应。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员进行了基于质谱的磷蛋白富集来分析 CHIKV 感染的 RAW264.7 巨噬细胞,并将结果与​​模拟感染的细胞进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: 与模拟感染的细胞相比,对富集磷蛋白的分析发现了 2,096 个改变的蛋白质,其中 212 个蛋白质受到差异调节,包括 140 个上调蛋白质和 72 个下调蛋白质(倍数变化 ≥ 2,第 17 页)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,热休克同源 71 蛋白是一种支持 CHIKV 在巨噬细胞中复制的 宿主 因子,为 CHIKV 感染的分子机制提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: HSC71 被鉴定为支持 CHIKV 复制的 宿主 因子,可以为靶向 抗病毒药物 疗法的开发提供信息,并提高对巨噬细胞中 CHIKV 发病机制 的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象分析,这可能会限制解释的深度,并且由于缺乏详细的实验结果,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用基于质谱的磷蛋白富集对 CHIKV 感染的 RAW264.7 巨噬细胞进行蛋白质组学分析,以表征与 CHIKV 感染相关的 宿主 细胞反应。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员进行了基于质谱的磷蛋白富集来分析 CHIKV 感染的 RAW264.7 巨噬细胞,并将结果与​​模拟感染的细胞进行比较。
analysis_zh.main_results: 与模拟感染的细胞相比,对富集磷蛋白的分析发现了 2,096 个改变的蛋白质,其中 212 个蛋白质受到差异调节,包括 140 个上调蛋白质和 72 个下调蛋白质(倍数变化 ≥ 2,第 17 页)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,热休克同源 71 蛋白是一种支持 CHIKV 在巨噬细胞中复制的 宿主 因子,为 CHIKV 感染的分子机制提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: HSC71 被鉴定为支持 CHIKV 复制的 宿主 因子,可以为靶向 抗病毒药物 疗法的开发提供信息,并提高对巨噬细胞中 CHIKV 发病机制 的理解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象分析,这可能会限制解释的深度,并且由于缺乏详细的实验结果,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract: Arboviral infections have emerged as a significant public health challenge worldwide, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions where environmental conditions support the establishment and expansion of competent mosquito vectors (1). Among the most important mosquito-borne arboviruses affecting human populations are dengue virus (DENV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and West Nile virus (WNV), which continue to cause substantial morbidity due to their expanding geographic distribution, recurrent outbreaks, and potential for co-circulation in endemic regions.
