analysis.research_question_and_background: Arboviral infections have emerged as a significant public health challenge worldwide, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions where environmental conditions support the establishment and expansion of competent mosquito vectors.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective laboratory-based study investigated co-infections of dengue, chikungunya, and West Nile viruses among suspected febrile patients in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen.
analysis.methods: The study utilized laboratory-based testing to identify viral infections in suspected febrile patients, focusing on the detection of dengue virus (DENV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and West Nile virus (WNV) through molecular and serological assays.
analysis.main_results: The study found that co-infections of dengue, chikungunya, and West Nile viruses occurred among suspected febrile patients in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the potential for co-circulation of these arboviruses in the region, which may complicate surveillance and diagnosis efforts.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results underscore the importance of integrated surveillance systems to detect and manage co-infections, which can have significant implications for public health strategies in endemic areas.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is retrospective and based on laboratory data, which may limit its ability to establish causal relationships or provide real-time insights, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective laboratory-based study in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen, investigated co-infections of dengue, chikungunya, and West Nile viruses among suspected febrile patients. The research highlights the growing public health challenge posed by arboviruses, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions where mosquito vectors are prevalent. The study used molecular and serological assays to detect viral infections, revealing instances of co-infection among patients. These findings suggest the potential for co-circulation of these viruses in the region, which may complicate surveillance and diagnosis. The study's retrospective nature and reliance on laboratory data limit its ability to establish causal relationships, resulting in moderate confidence in the results. The results have important implications for public health strategies, emphasizing the need for integrated surveillance systems to address the complexities of arbovirus co-infections. The evidence is based on laboratory testing and does not include detailed statistical analyses or long-term follow-up.

papers.title: Manifestaciones clínico-dermatológicas de la chikungunya: puntos clave para el internista, lecciones del brote en Cuba
papers.abstract: Se realizó una revisión narrativa sobre las manifestaciones clínico-dermatológicas de la fiebre chikungunya, con especial atención a los hallazgos de utilidad para el internista, a partir del brote epidémico ocurrido en Cuba durante 2025. Se consultaron artículos publicados entre 2008 y 2026 en PubMed/MEDLINE, SciELO y repositorios oficiales de la OPS/OMS, priorizándose revisiones sistemáticas, guías clínicas y series de casos. La chikungunya cursó con tres fases clínicas. En la fase aguda predominaron la fiebre elevada, las poliartralgias severas simétricas y el exantema maculopapular. Se identificaron manifestaciones cutáneo-mucosas distintivas como la hiperpigmentación centrofacial, las úlceras genitales, las lesiones vesículo-ampollosas en niños y la exacerbación de dermatosis preexistentes. Hasta el 60% de los casos evoluciona a la cronicidad, caracterizada por artritis inflamatoria persistente. La integración del binomio clínico-dermatológico constituye una herramienta fundamental para el diagnóstico diferencial frente a otras arbovirosis y para la identificación de pacientes con riesgo de cronicidad articular.
papers.journal: Revista de la Sociedad Peruana de Medicina Interna

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a narrative review of the clinical and dermatological manifestations of chikungunya, focusing on key findings relevant to internists, based on the 2025 epidemic in Cuba. The review analyzed articles published between 2008 and 2026 from PubMed/MEDLINE, SciELO, and official repositories of the WHO. The chikungunya virus was reported to progress through three clinical phases, with acute symptoms including high fever, severe symmetric polyarthritis, and maculopapular rash. Distinct cutaneous and mucosal manifestations were identified, such as centrofacial hyperpigmentation, genital ulcers, vesiculopustular lesions in children, and exacerbation of pre-existing dermatoses. The study highlights that up to 60% of cases evolve into chronicity, characterized by persistent inflammatory arthritis. The integration of clinical and dermatological features is emphasized as a critical tool for differential diagnosis and identifying patients at risk for chronic joint complications. The evidence is based on a comprehensive literature search, but the study does not provide detailed statistical analyses or experimental data, limiting the strength of the conclusions.

papers.title: Insecticide resistance in Aedes aegypti across sub-Saharan Africa: An overview and perspectives for effective arbovirus control.
papers.abstract: Arboviruses transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, including Zika, yellow fever and especially dengue and chikungunya, represent a growing public health concern in Africa. Insecticide-based strategies remain essential for the prevention and control of arboviral outbreaks. However, insecticide resistance in Ae. aegypti is globally widespread and appears to be rising in sub-Saharan Africa. Here, we reviewed the distribution and phenotypic and molecular evidence of insecticide resistance in Ae. aegypti across sub-Saharan Africa and summarized the underlying resistance mechanisms and key knowledge gaps. Bibliographic databases were searched for studies published between January 2010 and December 2023. The review identified 40 studies from 18 of 47 countries in sub-Saharan Africa. Among adults mosquitoes, resistance to dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT) and pyrethroids was reported in multiple studies across West and Central Africa, while resistance to carbamates was also documented in several countries, comparatively fewer studies reported resistance to organophosphates. For larvae 7 of 40 studies assessed susceptibility to temephos, with potential resistance reported in only one study. Molecular investigations identified five kdr mutations including F1534C, V1016I, V410L, V1016G and S989P in 12 countries while metabolic resistance involving cytochrome P450s, carboxylesterases, glutathione S-transferases and other detoxification enzymes was reported in a smaller number of studies and countries. Overall, the evidence base remains geographically uneven and limited for several insecticide classes and resistance mechanisms. This review highlights important knowledge gaps, including the limited assessment of larvicides, emerging adulticide options, resistance intensity and Aedes-targeted vector control interventions, and underscores the need for more systematic and standardized insecticide resistance surveillance across sub-Saharan Africa.

papers.abstract_zh: 由埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,包括寨卡病毒、黄热病,尤其是登革热和基孔肯雅热,是非洲日益严重的公共卫生问题。基于杀虫剂的策略对于预防和控制虫媒病毒 暴发 仍然至关重要。然而,白伊伊蚊对杀虫剂具有抗药性。埃及伊蚊在全球范围内广泛传播,并且似乎在撒哈拉以南非洲地区呈上升趋势。在这里,我们回顾了伊蚊抗药性的分布、表型和分子证据。撒哈拉以南非洲地区的埃及伊蚊,并总结了潜在的抵抗机制和关键知识差距。检索了书目数据库,查找 2010 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间发表的研究。审查确定了来自撒哈拉以南非洲 47 个国家中的 18 个国家的 40 项研究。西非和中非的多项研究报告了成年蚊子对二氯二苯基三氯乙烷 (DDT) 和拟除虫菊酯的抗药性,而一些国家也记录了对氨基甲酸酯的抗药性,相对较少的研究报告了对有机磷酸酯的抗药性。对于幼虫,40 项研究中有 7 项评估了对替美磷的敏感性,只有一项研究报告了潜在的耐药性。分子研究在 12 个国家确定了 5 个 kdr 突变,包括 F1534C、V1016I、V410L、V1016G 和 S989P,而少数研究和国家报告了涉及细胞色素 P450、羧酸酯酶、谷胱甘肽 S-转移酶和其他解毒酶的代谢耐药性。总体而言,对于几种杀虫剂类别和抗性机制而言,证据基础在地理上仍然不均匀且有限。本综述强调了重要的知识差距,包括对杀幼虫剂的有限评估、新出现的杀成虫剂选择、抗性强度和针对伊蚊的 媒介 控制干预措施,并强调撒哈拉以南非洲地区需要更系统和标准化的杀虫剂抗性 媒介。

papers.title: Congenital Arboviruses: A Review.
papers.abstract: Congenital arboviruses represent a significant public health concern because of their ability to cross the placental barrier and adversely affect fetal development. In this review, we delineate the epidemiology, pathogenesis, clinical manifestations, and diagnostic challenges associated with key congenital arboviral infections, including Zika, dengue, chikungunya, yellow fever, Oropouche, and West Nile virus. While vertical transmission mechanisms vary among arboviruses, inflammation, placental disruption, and viral replication within fetal tissues are common pathological features. Early diagnosis is complicated by overlapping clinical symptoms, limited laboratory capacity in endemic areas, and cross-reactivity in serological tests for flaviviruses. In this review, we highlight the need for improved surveillance, targeted diagnostics, and preventive strategies, including vector control and maternal vaccination, to reduce the burden of congenital arboviral diseases. Understanding the maternal-fetal dynamics of arboviral infections is essential for developing effective public health interventions and mitigating long-term outcomes in affected populations.

In this review, we delineate the epidemiology, pathogenesis, clinical manifestations, and diagnostic challenges associated with key congenital arboviral infections, including Zika, dengue, chikungunya, yellow fever, Oropouche, and West Nile virus. While vertical transmission mechanisms vary among arboviruses, inflammation, placental disruption, and viral replication within fetal tissues are common pathological features. Early diagnosis is complicated by overlapping clinical symptoms, limited laboratory capacity in endemic areas, and cross-reactivity in serological tests for flaviviruses. In this review, we highlight the need for improved surveillance, targeted diagnostics, and preventive strategies, including vector control and maternal vaccination, to reduce the burden of congenital arboviral diseases. Understanding the maternal-fetal dynamics of arboviral infections is essential for developing effective public health interventions and mitigating long-term outcomes in affected populations.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on congenital arboviruses, specifically Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and addresses its impact on fetal development, transmission mechanisms, and clinical outcomes. The central question is to understand the epidemiology, pathogenesis, and diagnostic challenges of CHIKV-related congenital infections.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of existing literature on CHIKV and related congenital arboviruses. It includes epidemiological data, clinical case reports, and diagnostic studies, but does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or systematic review methodologies. The review does not specify databases or search dates, and eligibility criteria are not detailed.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that vertical transmission of CHIKV can occur, leading to congenital infections with potential adverse effects on fetal development. It highlights that inflammation, placental disruption, and viral replication in fetal tissues are common pathological features across arboviruses, including CHIKV.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that early diagnosis of CHIKV-related congenital infections is challenging due to overlapping clinical symptoms and limited laboratory capacity in endemic areas. Additionally, cross-reactivity in serological tests for flaviviruses complicates accurate detection. There is a lack of comprehensive data on long-term outcomes and specific maternal-fetal interactions unique to CHIKV.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for improved surveillance systems, targeted diagnostic tools, and preventive strategies such as vector control and maternal vaccination to reduce the burden of congenital CHIKV infections. It also underscores the importance of understanding maternal-fetal dynamics to develop effective public health interventions.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the impact of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) on fetal development, focusing on vertical transmission, pathogenesis, and diagnostic challenges. It highlights the common pathological features among arboviruses, including inflammation and placental disruption, and identifies gaps in understanding long-term outcomes. The review calls for enhanced surveillance, improved diagnostics, and preventive measures like vector control and maternal vaccination to mitigate the burden of congenital CHIKV infections. It also stresses the need for further research into maternal-fetal interactions to inform public health strategies.

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调需要改进 监测 系统、有针对性的诊断工具和 媒介 控制和孕产妇 疫苗接种 等预防策略,以减轻先天性 CHIKV 感染的负担。它还强调了了解母婴动态以制定有效的公共卫生干预措施的重要性。

papers.title: A generalized lineage nomenclature for viral genomic epidemiology.
papers.abstract: Pathogen genomics has become increasingly integrated into outbreak response, with recent virus epidemics better characterized by large numbers of viral genetic sequences. Effective international communication of viral diversity requires a scalable, adaptable nomenclature, and existing systems may not accommodate rapid sequence generation. The Pango lineage nomenclature system was designed to address these problems and has been applied to SARS-CoV-2 since early 2020. Here we generalize the underlying principles into a framework for virus surveillance. Lineages are defined as epidemiologically meaningful clusters on a phylogenetic tree, initiated from founding lineages and expanded across a phylogeny through a hierarchical system of alphanumeric sublineage names. Six years on from the inception of the Pango system, we discuss challenges and considerations for implementation. We present a Pango lineage framework for chikungunya virus, providing an alternative to the geography-based clade system and designating 21 lineages across 8 founding lineages. This generalization provides a foundation for future genomic surveillance of many viruses, including for emerging outbreaks and the surveillance of endemic pathogens.

papers.title: Global Genomic Surveillance.
papers.abstract: Global genomic surveillance has emerged as a foundational pillar of public health in the twenty-first century, enabling real-time tracking of pathogen evolution and informing outbreak response. This chapter examines the strategic architecture of global genomic surveillance, focusing on its application to arboviruses such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV). It explores the integration of genomic data with epidemiological, clinical, and environmental information within a One Health framework, while addressing critical challenges in governance, equity, and interoperability. The discussion covers the entire genomic surveillance workflow, from sample collection and sequencing to bioinformatic analysis and phylogenetic inference, and highlights the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI) in predictive surveillance. By analyzing global initiatives, operational barriers, and emerging technologies, this chapter underscores the necessity of sustainable, equitable, and interoperable genomic systems to proactively address current and future infectious disease threats.

papers.title_zh: 全球 基因组监测。
papers.source_body_en: Global genomic surveillance has emerged as a foundational pillar of public health in the twenty-first century, enabling real-time tracking of pathogen evolution and informing outbreak response. This chapter examines the strategic architecture of global genomic surveillance, focusing on its application to arboviruses such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV). It explores the integration of genomic data with epidemiological, clinical, and environmental information within a One Health framework, while addressing critical challenges in governance, equity, and interoperability. The discussion covers the entire genomic surveillance workflow, from sample collection and sequencing to bioinformatic analysis and phylogenetic inference, and highlights the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI) in predictive surveillance. By analyzing global initiatives, operational barriers, and emerging technologies, this chapter underscores the necessity of sustainable, equitable, and interoperable genomic systems to proactively address current and future infectious disease threats.
papers.abstract_zh: 全球 基因组监测 已成为二十一世纪公共卫生的基本支柱,能够实时跟踪病原体 进化 并告知 暴发 应对措施。本章研究了全球 基因组监测 的战略架构,重点关注其在 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 等虫媒病毒中的应用。它探索了“同一个健康”框架内基因组数据与流行病学、临床和环境信息的整合,同时解决治理、公平性和互操作性方面的关键挑战。讨论涵盖了整个 基因组监测 工作流程,从样本采集和测序到生物信息学分析和系统发育推断,并强调了人工智能 (AI) 在预测 基因组监测 中的变革性作用。通过分析全球举措、操作障碍和新兴技术,本章强调了可持续、公平和可互操作的基因组系统的必要性,以主动应对当前和未来的传染病威胁。

papers.title: Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever Deserves Greater Regional Emphasis in Reviews of Emerging RNA Viruses: A Perspective from Southern Iraq
papers.abstract: Dear Editor, I read with great interest the recent review by Obaid, “Emerging RNA Viruses: Epidemiology, Pathogenesis, and Challenges for Vaccine Development” [1]. The review offers a timely and well-organized synthesis of the structural and epidemiological features that make RNA viruses disproportionately likely to emerge as zoonotic threats, and its discussion of bunyaviruses and viral hemorrhagic fevers as a recognized category of emerging pathogens is a valuable contribution to a readership working across the biomedical and biochemical sciences. I write to suggest that a more prominent, regionally grounded example within this category would further strengthen the review's relevance to its predominantly Iraqi and Middle Eastern readership. Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV), a tick-borne member of the order Bunyavirales, appears only once in the review, in a brief list of viruses relevant to a separate national research agenda, and is absent from both the dedicated case-study section covering Ebola and Chikungunya and the summary table comparing epidemiological trends, pathogenesis, and vaccine status across six major RNA viruses. Yet CCHFV has produced the largest and most sustained outbreak of a viral hemorrhagic fever in Iraq's recorded history over exactly the period during which this review was prepared [2]. Confirmed cases rose from 219 in the first half of 2022, the largest outbreak recorded in the country since 1979, to 587 laboratory-confirmed cases with 83 deaths across all of 2023, an overall case fatality rate of approximately 14% [3]. Notably, this is not a distant epidemiological statistic: Babil governorate accounted for the largest single share of national cases in the initial 2022 outbreak (39.7% of all confirmed cases nationally), and a dedicated retrospective investigation has since documented 290 confirmed cases in Babil province alone across 2022-2023, with a case fatality rate of 15.5% concentrated heavily among housewives and those with occupational animal contact [4]. This regional burden is compounded by the specific vaccine development challenges that CCHFV presents, and which align closely with the review's stated focus: no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral therapy is currently available anywhere in the world, despite the virus's wide endemic distribution across more than 30 countries in Asia, Europe, and Africa and its designation by the World Health Organization as a priority pathogen [2]. A retrospective analysis of the 2022-23 Iraqi outbreaks further identified a plausible mechanistic driver behind the recent surge, namely a reduction in preventive veterinary tick-control activities during the COVID-19 pandemic, coinciding with high Hyalomma tick infestation and seropositivity in domestic animals across southern Iraq [5]. This human-animal-environmental interface is precisely the kind of case study that could illustrate, with immediate local relevance, the review's broader arguments about the ecological and agricultural drivers of RNA virus emergence. I raise this not as a criticism of the review's scope, which necessarily could not cover every emerging RNA virus family in comparable depth, but as a constructive suggestion: given that CCHF is arguably the most consequential emerging RNA viral disease currently active in this region, and given that its case fatality rate, occupational risk pattern, and vaccine-development impasse map so directly onto the review's own framework, a dedicated paragraph or case box on CCHFV would meaningfully increase the review's value to local clinicians, veterinary public health officials, and readers across the wider Middle Eastern region for whom this is an active, ongoing concern rather than a historical example. I thank the author for a stimulating and well-referenced contribution, and I hope this perspective is useful for future work on this important topic.

This human-animal-environmental interface is precisely the kind of case study that could illustrate, with immediate local relevance, the review's broader arguments about the ecological and agricultural drivers of RNA virus emergence. I thank the author for a stimulating and well-referenced contribution, and I hope this perspective is useful for future work on this important topic.

papers.abstract_zh: 亲爱的编辑,我非常感兴趣地阅读了 Obaid 最近的评论,“新兴 RNA 病毒:流行病学、发病机制 和 疫苗 开发的挑战”[1]。这篇综述对 RNA 病毒极有可能成为人畜共患威胁的结构和流行病学特征进行了及时、组织良好的综合,其中对布尼亚病毒和病毒性出血热作为公认的新兴病原体类别的讨论,对生物医学和生物化学领域的读者做出了宝贵的贡献。我写这封信的目的是建议,在这一类别中提供一个更突出的、基于区域的例子将进一步加强该评论与其主要是伊拉克和中东读者群的相关性。克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒 (CCHFV) 是布尼亚病毒目的蜱传成员,在与单独的国家研究议程相关的病毒简短列表中仅在综述中出现一次,并且在涵盖埃博拉和基孔肯雅热的专门案例研究部分以及比较六种主要 RNA 病毒流行病学趋势、发病机制 和 疫苗 状态的汇总表中均未出现。然而,就在撰写本综述的期间,CCHFV 却产生了伊拉克有记录历史上最大规模、最持续的病毒性出血热 暴发 [2]。确诊病例从2022年上半年的219例(该国自1979年以来记录的最大暴发)增加到2023年全年的587例实验室确诊病例,其中83人死亡,总体病死率约为14%[3]。值得注意的是,这并不是一个遥远的流行病学统计数据:巴比伦省在 2022 年最初的 暴发 全国病例中所占比例最大(占全国所有确诊病例的 39.7%),此后一项专门的回顾性调查记录了 2022 年至 2023 年仅巴比伦省就有 290 例确诊病例,病死率为 15.5%,主要集中在家庭主妇和职业病患者中。动物接触[4]。CCHFV 带来的具体 疫苗 开发挑战加剧了这一区域负担,这些挑战与审查所阐述的重点密切相关:尽管该病毒在亚洲、欧洲和非洲 30 多个国家广泛流行,并被世界卫生组织指定为优先病原体,但目前世界各地尚无获得许可的 疫苗 或特定 抗病毒药物 疗法[2]。对 2022-23 伊拉克 暴发 的回顾性分析进一步确定了近期激增背后的一个可能的机制驱动因素,即在 COVID-19 大流行期间预防性兽医蜱控制活动减少,同时伊拉克南部地区家畜中玻璃眼蜱感染率高且血清阳性 [5]。这种人类-动物-环境界面正是这样的案例研究,它可以与当地直接相关,说明该评论关于 RNA 病毒出现的生态和农业驱动因素的更广泛的论点。我提出这一点并不是对审查范围的批评,因为审查范围不一定能在相当的深度上涵盖每个新兴 RNA 病毒家族,而是作为一个建设性建议:鉴于 CCHF 可以说是该地区目前活跃的最重要的新兴 RNA 病毒疾病,并且考虑到其病死率、职业风险模式和 疫苗 发展僵局直接映射到审查本身的框架上,关于 CCHFV 的专门段落或案例框将有意义地增加审查的对当地临床医生、兽医公共卫生官员和整个中东地区的读者来说,这是一个积极、持续的关注,而不是一个历史例子。我感谢作者的令人兴奋且参考文献丰富的贡献,我希望这个观点对未来关于这个重要主题的工作有用。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注新兴 RNA 病毒,特别强调了导致其成为人畜共患威胁的结构和流行病学特征。它包括对布尼亚病毒和病毒性出血热作为公认的新兴病原体类别的讨论。然而,作者建议该评论可以受益于更突出的、具有区域性的例子,例如克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒(CCHFV),以增强其与伊拉克和中东读者的相关性。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述综合了 RNA 病毒的结构和流行病学特征,重点关注布尼亚病毒和病毒性出血热。它包括关于埃博拉和基孔肯雅热的专门案例研究部分,以及比较六种主要 RNA 病毒的流行病学趋势、发病机制 和 疫苗 状态的汇总表。作者指出,这些章节并未充分涵盖 CCHFV。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述强调了RNA病毒的结构和流行病学特征,这些特征使得RNA病毒更有可能成为人畜共患威胁。它还强调了 疫苗 开发这些病毒所面临的挑战。然而,作者认为,CCHFV 在伊拉克具有重要的 暴发 特征,尽管它与该地区相关且与审查框架相一致,但在审查中并未充分解决这一问题。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尽管 CCHFV 在伊拉克具有重要意义,但该审查的案例研究部分或汇总表中并未包括 CCHFV。作者指出,这一遗漏限制了该审查对该地区当地临床医生和公共卫生官员的适用性。此外,该审查并未对 CCHFV 提出的具体 疫苗 开发挑战进行详细分析,而这些挑战与其所声明的重点相关。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 作者建议,关于 CCHFV 的专门段落或案例框将增加该评论对中东地区当地临床医生、兽医公共卫生官员和读者的价值。这将提供直接的当地相关性,并说明 RNA 病毒出现的生态和农业驱动因素,这是该评论论点的核心。

papers.title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the lack of specific antiviral therapies for mosquito-borne arboviruses, including chikungunya virus, by exploring novel compounds from plant sources.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed a bioactivity-guided approach to screen methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species for antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells, with a focus on chikungunya virus.
analysis.methods: The researchers used bioactivity-guided screening, fractionation, and purification techniques to isolate compounds, followed by structural characterization using UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy, and functional assays to assess antiviral activity.

papers.title_zh: 来自茄科植物的螺甾烷皂苷抑制登革病毒复制和病毒蛋白表达,并对多种虫媒病毒具有活性。
papers.source_body_en: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 由蚊子传播的虫媒病毒,包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特定抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用生物活性引导的方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行筛选,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中的DENV-2。五种提取物显著降低了病毒感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过UPLC-DAD-MS和1D/2D NMR光谱法进行了表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制了DENV的复制,表现为病毒RNA水平的显著降低、NS1和NS3蛋白表达的减少以及传染性病毒滴度的下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白加工一致。分子对接分析支持了这些发现,预测了这些化合物与关键病毒酶的有利相互作用,特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其对多种虫媒病毒具有交叉疗效。综上所述,这些发现将螺甾烷皂苷识别为有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

papers.title: Molecular Cloning and Reverse Genetics.
papers.abstract: This chapter describes a detailed molecular biology protocol for introducing specific point mutations into the chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genome using a reverse genetics strategy. The method utilizes an overlapping PCR-based approach to generate a mutated DNA fragment, which is then cloned into a pre-engineered CHIKV infectious clone plasmid. The protocol covers all major steps, from the initial PCRs to create the mutated insert to its digestion and ligation into the vector. It also includes procedures for bacterial transformation, colony screening via PCR and Sanger sequencing to confirm the mutation, and plasmid purification via miniprep. The document is structured with a clear introduction, a list of all required reagents and equipment, and a step-by-step methods section.

papers.title: Exploring the Increased Risk of Vector-Borne Diseases Driven by Climate Change and Proposing Strategic Solutions to Mitigate the Impact. A Narrative Review
papers.abstract: Since the middle of the 20th century, human activity has caused Earth's climate to change. The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change projects that global temperatures will continue rising in the coming decades, leading to significant environmental and health impacts. This traditional narrative review synthesises evidence from previously published literature to determine the epidemiology of vector-borne diseases caused by climate change, their environmental factors, and solutions to address the issues. The vector-borne diseases, such as West Nile virus, malaria, dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika virus, are related to changing climatic conditions that create favorable environments for the transmission of the disease. The climatic factors include rising temperatures, drought, hurricanes, floods, changes in rainfall patterns, higher relative humidity, and shifts in wind patterns. The findings indicate that climate change not only expands the geographical distribution of vectors such as mosquitoes, ticks, and rodents, but also enhances their breeding and survival rates, leading to increased transmission risks. To mitigate these impacts, this review proposes several strategic solutions, including improved surveillance, adaptation measures, disease risk assessments, mitigation, and public health education.

papers.title_zh: 探索气候变化导致的 媒介 传播疾病的风险增加,并提出减轻影响的战略解决方案。叙事评论
papers.source_body_en: Since the middle of the 20th century, human activity has caused Earth's climate to change. The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change projects that global temperatures will continue rising in the coming decades, leading to significant environmental and health impacts. This traditional narrative review synthesises evidence from previously published literature to determine the epidemiology of vector-borne diseases caused by climate change, their environmental factors, and solutions to address the issues. The vector-borne diseases, such as West Nile virus, malaria, dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika virus, are related to changing climatic conditions that create favorable environments for the transmission of the disease. The climatic factors include rising temperatures, drought, hurricanes, floods, changes in rainfall patterns, higher relative humidity, and shifts in wind patterns. The findings indicate that climate change not only expands the geographical distribution of vectors such as mosquitoes, ticks, and rodents, but also enhances their breeding and survival rates, leading to increased transmission risks. To mitigate these impacts, this review proposes several strategic solutions, including improved surveillance, adaptation measures, disease risk assessments, mitigation, and public health education.
papers.abstract_zh: 20世纪中叶以来,人类活动导致地球气候发生变化。政府间气候变化专门委员会预测,未来几十年全球气温将继续上升,从而对环境和健康造成重大影响。这篇传统的叙述性评论综合了以前发表的文献中的证据,以确定由气候变化引起的 媒介 传播疾病的 媒介、其环境因素以及解决这些问题的解决方案。媒介 传播的疾病,如西尼罗河病毒、疟疾、登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡病毒,与气候条件的变化有关,气候条件的变化为疾病的 媒介 创造了有利的环境。气候因素包括气温升高、干旱、飓风、洪水、降雨模式的变化、相对湿度升高以及风型的变化。研究结果表明,气候变化不仅扩大了蚊子、蜱虫和啮齿动物等媒介的地理分布,而且还提高了它们的繁殖和存活率,导致传播风险增加。为了减轻这些影响,本次审查提出了几种战略解决方案,包括改进的 监测、适应措施、疾病风险评估、缓解措施和公共卫生教育。

papers.full_text: A case for eliminating Widal testing for enteric fever, India Enteric fever remains a preventable yet persistent public health challenge in many low- and middle-income countries, particularly in the African and South-East Asia regions. The disease caused by Salmonella enterica serovars Typhi and Paratyphi disproportionately affects children, adolescents and young adults, with an estimated global burden of over 14 million cases and nearly 136 000 deaths annually. India carries a substantial proportion of this burden. Hospital-based surveillance in India reports incidence ranging from 12 to 1622 cases per 100 000 child-years among children and 108 to 970 cases per 100 000 person-years among people older than 15 years, highlighting both high burden and substantial uncertainty in measurement. Despite advances in treatment, vaccination and surveillance, progress towards accurate, accessible diagnostics for enteric fever remains limited. Accurate diagnosis is essential for controlling infectious disease, yet the link between poor diagnostics and antimicrobial resistance remains underappreciated. False-positives lead to unnecessary antibiotic exposure, while false-negatives delay appropriate treatment and encourage the use of broader-spectrum antibiotics without microbiological confirmation. Both scenarios drive drug resistance. This problem is especially acute for enteric fever in endemic settings, where its clinical presentation overlaps with malaria, dengue, scrub typhus, chikungunya, leptospirosis and other viral fevers. Poor diagnostics affect patient care and weaken surveillance by hindering accurate assessment of disease burden and transmission patterns, compromising vaccine policy and investment decisions. Reliable diagnostics are therefore essential for both patient care and evidence-based public health policy-making. Here, we argue that eliminating inaccurate serological tests, particularly the Widal test, is a needed and achievable intervention for containing the emerging resistance. In India, where S. Typhi already shows widespread antibiotic resistance, continued reliance on inaccurate diagnostics is harmful. Of particular concern is the near-global dissemination of multidrug-resistant lineages of S. Typhi, with inappropriate prescribing driven by inaccurate diagnostics further accelerating the emergence and spread of extensively drug-resistant strains. Blood culture remains the benchmark for diagnosis of enteric fever and provides the added benefit of antimicrobial susceptibility data. However, the sensitivity of blood culture is moderate (50–65%) and is affected by prior antibiotic use, the timing of sample collection and blood volume. Uneven distribution of laboratory infrastructure, availability of trained personnel, and quality assurance systems at primary care and district levels further constrain the effectiveness of blood culture. The Widal test is a widely used diagnostic tool for enteric fever. The test detects antibodies against S. Typhi O and H antigens; however, it lacks validated cut-offs for acute disease and shows highly variable sensitivity and specificity in endemic settings. The test’s performance is affected by pre-existing antibodies in the population, cross-reactivity with other infections and inability to distinguish acute infection from past exposure. The Widal test can be performed as a slide agglutination or a tube agglutination test. The slide test is widely used across India, but well-established thresholds for determining a positive result are lacking. As a result, any visible reaction may be interpreted as a positive result, leading to false-positive diagnoses and unnecessary antibiotic treatment. The tube test, more commonly used in tertiary care centres, can provide more useful information when two blood samples taken at different stages of illness are compared to detect a rise in antibody levels. However, when performed on a single blood sample, as is often the case in routine practice, the tube test has limited value for diagnosing acute typhoid. The largest comparative evaluation of typhoid diagnostics to date strengthens support for discontinuing the Widal test. An analysis showed that Widal performs poorly relative to other diagnostics and adds no incremental value when combined with better-performing rapid tests; notably, none of the best-performing diagnostic combinations included Widal. These findings align with a systematic review which concluded that no currently available rapid diagnostic test can reliably replace blood culture. Collectively, the evidence suggests that Widal is both inaccurate and redundant, providing a strong rationale for its phased withdrawal and regulatory restriction. Eliminating Widal would reduce reliance on a poorly performing diagnostic, limit inappropriate antibiotic use resulting from false-positive results and encourage investment in more accurate and reliable typhoid diagnostics. A retrospective audit of 100 febrile children at a New Delhi tertiary hospital found that, among 54 Widal-positive patients, only five (9.3%) were confirmed by blood culture, while 49 (90.7%) were culture-negative. These findings illustrate the potential consequences of widespread reliance on Widal testing in high-volume settings. In a district hospital outpatient department managing about 1000 febrile patients each month, even a modest false-positive rate could result in many patients being misdiagnosed with typhoid and receiving unnecessary antibiotics, while alternative causes of fever may be missed. Across India, such reliance on Widal testing could therefore contribute to misdiagnosis, inaccurate disease surveillance and avoidable antibiotic use. Despite longstanding evidence of poor performance and guidance from the World Health Organization (WHO) emphasizing microbiological confirmation, and the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention recommending against Widal serology, Widal testing remains widespread in endemic settings. In Pakistan, the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province has issued directives to discontinue Widal testing, although enforcement has been inconsistent. Overall, formal regulatory action to restrict Widal testing remains limited, and the test continues to be widely used across many endemic countries, as reliable and affordable diagnostic alternatives remain elusive. India’s National Essential Diagnostics List, developed by the Indian Council of Medical Research in alignment with WHO guidance, promotes diagnostics with proven accuracy and does not include the Widal test. However, exclusion from the list only limits public-sector procurement; Widal remains legally available through India’s Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation licensed channels. Widal is widely used in the private sector, reflecting limited clinician awareness and gaps in state-level procurement practices. Eliminating Widal testing will require additional regulatory action by the organization, alongside procurement reforms, clinician education and enforcement measures. India has previously confronted and successfully addressed a similar challenge by banning serological tests for tuberculosis in 2012. More than 1.5 million tuberculosis serological tests, generating an estimated 15 million United States dollars (US$) market, were done each year before this ban, largely in the private sector. Following WHO’s 2011 recommendation against their use, India issued a legally binding notification under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act prohibiting the manufacture, sale, distribution and use of tuberculosis serology kits. However, the ban alone was insufficient. Success required active enforcement, monitoring against substitution with other inappropriate tests, and parallel roll-out of a WHO-recommended cartridge-based nucleic acid amplification test through India’s national tuberculosis elimination programme. Combined with mandatory notification and the Nikshay surveillance system, this roll-out transformed tuberculosis and rifampicin-resistance detection, improved case notification including in the private sector, reduced inappropriate treatment and advanced public–private integration. The tuberculosis experience shows that eliminating an inaccurate diagnostic requires coordinated normative guidance, regulatory prohibition, validated replacement technology and enforcement even in fragmented health systems. Applying similar principles to enteric fever could yield comparable gains in clinical care, antimicrobial resistance containment and surveillance quality, though unlike for tuberculosis, no rapid, accurate test yet exists to immediately replace Widal. Given the paucity of alternative rapid diagnostic tests, strengthening blood culture capacity at all levels of care is indispensable and has been recommended by the Indian Council of Medical Research. However, such strengthening alone may not suffice, as most febrile patients are managed in peripheral settings with limited access to microbiological testing. What is needed is a diagnostic ecosystem combining culture-based confirmation with validated, affordable point-of-care tools. Several novel diagnostic approaches are under development. Molecular assays, targeting Salmonella Typhi-specific genes, offer high analytical sensitivity but face technical challenges related to low bacterial count in blood, cost and infrastructure requirements. Diagnostics based on host response show promise in differentiating enteric fever from other febrile illness, aligning with syndrome-based diagnostic approaches. IgA-based serological assays against antigens such as hemolysin E have demonstrated improved specificity in endemic populations. Antigen-detection and metabolomic approaches are also being explored for rapid, culture-independent diagnosis suitable for primary care. However, new innovations must be rigorously validated. Many promising diagnostics fail to translate from research to practice due to inadequate evaluation in real-world settings, lack of affordability or poor integration into health systems. Premature deployment of inadequately validated tests generates unnecessary follow-up testing, inappropriate treatments, hospitalizations and referrals. These wasted resources are especially costly where health budgets are limited. The Lancet Commission on Diagnostics frames such diagnostic inefficiencies within a broader diagnostics gap that undermines efficient use of health resources and equity. Policy-makers should recognize the elimination of inaccurate diagnostics for enteric fever as a priority intervention within global antimicrobial resistance and universal health coverage agendas. Six key actions will be helpful in phasing out unreliable tests. First, clear normative guidance from WHO and national authorities explicitly discouraging the use of the Widal slide test and similar poorly performing tests. Second, clear guidance about when and how to perform the Widal tube test correctly, and wide dissemination of this information. Third, regulatory action to restrict manufacture, distribution and procurement of inaccurate diagnostics. Fourth, investment in laboratory systems, including blood-culture capacity and quality assurance. Fifth, support the development of affordable, high-performance tests tailored to endemic settings, alongside rigorous analytical and field evaluation using standardized, scientifically robust protocols. Finally, clinician and public engagement to shift diagnostic practices. The absence of an accurate and affordable point-of-care typhoid diagnostic that can reliably replace blood culture exemplifies the diagnostic neglect surrounding enteric fever. While vaccines, antibiotics and surveillance systems have advanced, diagnostics for diseases endemic in low- and middle-income countries have remained stagnant, often to the detriment of patients and health systems. Continued reliance on inaccurate tests such as the Widal test undermines efforts to control enteric fever and contain antimicrobial resistance. Aligning diagnostic practice with scientific evidence is essential for patient safety, antimicrobial stewardship and credible public health data. India’s experience highlights both the importance of the problem and the feasibility of solutions. Eliminating inaccurate diagnostics is not a technological challenge but a policy choice. papers.title: Screening of Antiviral Agents Against CHIKV Using Reporter Virus.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes a disease characterized by chronic musculoskeletal inflammation for which specific antivirals are not yet available. Currently, a supportive therapy to alleviate fever and pain is used, but it does not limit viral replication or the persistence of chronic arthritis symptoms. Thus, the identification and development of new active molecules against CHIKV is urgently needed. Here, we present a cell-based methodology that enables the implementation of a rapid and cost-effective strategy for high- and medium-throughput screening (HTS) of compounds, including repurposed drugs or novel molecules. This methodology allows for the identification of novel antiviral hits with a good activity and selectivity profile against CHIKV.

This methodology allows for the identification of novel antiviral hits with a good activity and selectivity profile against CHIKV.

papers.title: Epitope Tagging and Coimmunoprecipitation to Identify Viral Protein Interactors.
papers.abstract: Affinity purification-mass spectrometry (AP-MS) is a powerful proteomic approach for dissecting the interaction network between virus and host. Traditional AP-MS employs overexpression of viral proteins as baits to enrich host interactors. However, overexpressed viral proteins may mislocalize to inappropriate cellular compartments and trigger endoplasmic reticulum stress by overwhelming the protein-folding machinery, which leads to false identification of host factors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce an AP-MS strategy based on direct infection with an epitope-tagged chikungunya virus (CHIKV/myc-E2), which we used to successfully uncover two new antiviral factors in CHIKV cellular reservoirs-macrophages. In this protocol, we will describe this technique step by step: (1) design and construction of myc-tagged virus by advanced multi-fragment assembly, (2) in vitro transcription and preparation of infectious myc-tagged virus stocks, and (3) immunoprecipitation of myc-tagged viral protein and its interactome for mass spectrometry analysis. This strategy enables accurate identification of viral interactors in a physiologically relevant context, providing a framework for future proteomic studies using tagged viruses.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a novel AP-MS strategy for identifying chikungunya virus (CHIKV) protein interactors by directly infecting cells with an epitope-tagged CHIKV strain (CHIKV/myc-E2). The findings highlight the importance of using physiologically relevant contexts for accurate identification of viral interactors, which can inform antiviral research. However, the study is limited to an abstract-only description, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of detailed results and statistical analysis.

papers.abstract_zh: 亲和纯化质谱 (AP-MS) 是一种强大的蛋白质组学方法,用于剖析病毒和 宿主 之间的相互作用网络。传统的 AP-MS 采用病毒蛋白的过度表达作为诱饵来丰富 宿主 相互作用子。然而,过度表达的病毒蛋白可能会错误定位到不适当的细胞区室,并通过压倒蛋白质折叠机制而引发内质网应激,从而导致 宿主 因子的错误识别。为了克服这些限制,我们引入了一种基于直接感染表位标记的 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV/myc-E2) 的 AP-MS 策略,我们用它成功地发现了 CHIKV 细胞 储存宿主 巨噬细胞中的两个新的 抗病毒药物 因子。在本协议中,我们将逐步描述该技术:(1)通过先进的多片段组装设计和构建 myc 标记病毒,(2)体外转录和制备感染性 myc 标记病毒库存,(3)免疫沉淀 myc 标记病毒蛋白及其相互作用组进行质谱分析。该策略能够在生理相关背景下准确识别病毒相互作用因子,为未来使用标记病毒的蛋白质组学研究提供框架。

papers.title: A Restriction-Free Cloning Approach for Molecular Engineering of Plasmids.
papers.abstract: Molecular cloning by PCR amplification using a highly processive, high-fidelity DNA polymerase represents a robust and versatile technique for the precise manipulation of nucleic acid sequences. This approach enables the insertion, replacement, or modification of specific DNA fragments within a cloning vector, thereby generating an accurate copy of a gene or viral segment for downstream applications, such as protein expression, site-directed mutagenesis, and structural or functional analyses. The use of processive, high-fidelity polymerases significantly reduces the occurrence of base substitution errors, ensuring sequence integrity throughout the amplification process. Traditionally, restriction enzymes have been employed to facilitate directional cloning; however, alternative methods allow for mutagenesis without the need for unique and specific restriction sites and can be applied to virtually any cloning or seamless DNA assembly strategy. In this chapter, we describe a restriction enzyme-free and ligation-free PCR-based protocol widely applicable to any circular vector. This method enables targeted mutagenesis of the chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genome, offering a fast, efficient, and reliable strategy for generating mutant constructs suitable for virological and molecular studies.

papers.title: The consequence of simultaneous and sequential coinfections of Aedes aegypti with DENV-1, DENV-2, and CHIKV on vector competence
papers.abstract: Vector-borne diseases (VBD) caused by arboviruses represent a major public health threat in tropical regions. According to WHO’s Global Vector Control Response, more than 80% of the global population live in areas at risk for VBD. For instance, Aedes aegypti is the primary vector of dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and its widespread distribution, particularly in Brazil, contributes to the occurrence of outbreaks. During these outbreaks, mosquitoes may acquire either monoinfections or coinfections, which can occur either simultaneously or sequentially, potentially influencing transmission dynamics. In this study, we investigated the effects of simultaneous coinfection with CHIKV and two DENV serotypes (DENV-1 and DENV-2) on the vector competence of Ae. aegypti and described the characteristics of infection and transmission phenotypes following different orders of sequential arbovirus acquisition. Simultaneous coinfection resulted in serotype-dependent outcomes. At 7 days post-infection (dpi), DENV-1 infection rates and viral loads were significantly reduced compared with monoinfections, whereas DENV-2 showed increased viral loads in saliva. At 14 dpi, CHIKV infection rates were significantly reduced in both the CHIKV+DENV-1 (CD1) and CHIKV+DENV-2 (CD2) groups, whereas CHIKV viral loads were reduced only in the CD2 group. In the sequential coinfection experiments, DENV-2 exhibited lower replication levels than DENV-1 in both sequential infection scenarios, regardless of whether DENV was acquired before or after CHIKV. Likewise, DENV-2 showed lower transmission efficiency than DENV-1, and murine transmission assays confirmed reduced viral loads for DENV-2. Overall, our findings demonstrate that CHIKV–DENV coinfection in Ae. aegypti is associated with distinct infection and transmission outcomes depending on the DENV serotype and the infection scenario. In sequentially exposed mosquitoes, distinct phenotypes were observed according to the order of arbovirus acquisition. These results highlight the complexity of arboviral coinfections within this shared vector and emphasize the importance of considering different coinfection scenarios when evaluating vector competence and transmission risk in endemic settings.
authors: Ana Paula Alvim Pereira França Baptista
Alexia Katlen Ribeiro Ramos da Silva

analysis.research_question_and_background: Vector-borne diseases (VBD) caused by arboviruses represent a major public health threat in tropical regions. The study aimed to understand how coinfections with different arboviruses affect the transmission potential of mosquitoes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in Brazil, focusing on Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. It examined the effects of simultaneous and sequential coinfections with DENV-1, DENV-2, and CHIKV on vector competence.
analysis.methods: The researchers used Aedes aegypti mosquitoes to study the effects of coinfections with DENV-1, DENV-2, and CHIKV. They analyzed infection rates, viral loads, and transmission efficiency through experimental exposure and subsequent testing.
analysis.main_results: At 7 days post-infection, DENV-1 infection rates and viral loads were significantly reduced compared with monoinfections, whereas DENV-2 showed increased viral loads in saliva. At 14 dpi, CHIKV infection rates were significantly reduced in both the CHIKV+DENV-1 and CHIKV+DENV-2 groups, with CHIKV viral loads reduced only in the CHIKV+DENV-2 group.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that simultaneous coinfection with CHIKV and DENV serotypes resulted in serotype-dependent outcomes, highlighting the complexity of arboviral interactions in mosquitoes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings emphasize the importance of considering different coinfection scenarios when evaluating vector competence and transmission risk in endemic settings, which can inform more effective surveillance and control strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, which may lack detailed experimental data. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of comprehensive results and statistical analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the effects of simultaneous and sequential coinfections with DENV-1, DENV-2, and CHIKV on the vector competence of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. It highlights that coinfection outcomes are serotype-dependent, with DENV-1 and DENV-2 showing distinct responses to CHIKV. The findings suggest that different coinfection scenarios may influence transmission dynamics, which is important for understanding and managing vector-borne diseases in tropical regions. However, the study is based on abstract-only evidence, limiting the confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由虫媒病毒引起的 媒介 传播疾病 (VBD) 是热带地区的主要公共卫生威胁。该研究旨在了解不同虫媒病毒的双重感染如何影响蚊子的 传播 潜力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在巴西进行,重点关注埃及伊蚊。它检查了同时和顺序同时感染 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 CHIKV 对 媒介 能力的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用埃及伊蚊来研究同时感染 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 CHIKV 的影响。他们通过实验暴露和后续测试分析了感染率、病毒载量和 传播 效率。
elements_zh.main_results: 感染后7天,与单一感染相比,DENV-1感染率和病毒载量显着降低,而DENV-2唾液中的病毒载量增加。14 dpi时,CHIKV+DENV-1和CHIKV+DENV-2组的CHIKV感染率均显着降低,其中仅CHIKV+DENV-2组的CHIKV病毒载量降低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,同时感染 CHIKV 和 DENV 血清型会导致血清型依赖性结果,凸显了蚊子中虫媒病毒相互作用的复杂性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在流行病环境中评估 媒介 能力和 传播 风险时考虑不同合并感染情况的重要性,这可以为更有效的 监测 和控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象证据,可能缺乏详细的实验数据。由于缺乏全面的结果和统计分析,证据的强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 埃及伊蚊同时和相继同时感染 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 CHIKV 对 媒介 能力的影响
papers.source_body_en: Vector-borne diseases (VBD) caused by arboviruses represent a major public health threat in tropical regions. According to WHO’s Global Vector Control Response, more than 80% of the global population live in areas at risk for VBD. For instance, Aedes aegypti is the primary vector of dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and its widespread distribution, particularly in Brazil, contributes to the occurrence of outbreaks. During these outbreaks, mosquitoes may acquire either monoinfections or coinfections, which can occur either simultaneously or sequentially, potentially influencing transmission dynamics. In this study, we investigated the effects of simultaneous coinfection with CHIKV and two DENV serotypes (DENV-1 and DENV-2) on the vector competence of Ae. aegypti and described the characteristics of infection and transmission phenotypes following different orders of sequential arbovirus acquisition. Simultaneous coinfection resulted in serotype-dependent outcomes. At 7 days post-infection (dpi), DENV-1 infection rates and viral loads were significantly reduced compared with monoinfections, whereas DENV-2 showed increased viral loads in saliva. At 14 dpi, CHIKV infection rates were significantly reduced in both the CHIKV+DENV-1 (CD1) and CHIKV+DENV-2 (CD2) groups, whereas CHIKV viral loads were reduced only in the CD2 group. In the sequential coinfection experiments, DENV-2 exhibited lower replication levels than DENV-1 in both sequential infection scenarios, regardless of whether DENV was acquired before or after CHIKV. Likewise, DENV-2 showed lower transmission efficiency than DENV-1, and murine transmission assays confirmed reduced viral loads for DENV-2. Overall, our findings demonstrate that CHIKV–DENV coinfection in Ae. aegypti is associated with distinct infection and transmission outcomes depending on the DENV serotype and the infection scenario. In sequentially exposed mosquitoes, distinct phenotypes were observed according to the order of arbovirus acquisition. These results highlight the complexity of arboviral coinfections within this shared vector and emphasize the importance of considering different coinfection scenarios when evaluating vector competence and transmission risk in endemic settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 由虫媒病毒引起的 媒介 传播疾病 (VBD) 是热带地区的主要公共卫生威胁。根据世界卫生组织的全球 媒介 控制响应,全球 80% 以上的人口生活在有 VBD 风险的地区。例如,埃及伊蚊是登革热病毒 (DENV) 和 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 的主要 媒介,其广泛分布,特别是在巴西,导致了 暴发 的发生。在这些 暴发 期间,蚊子可能会获得单一感染或混合感染,这些感染可以同时或顺序发生,可能会影响 传播 的动态。在本研究中,我们研究了同时感染 CHIKV 和两种 DENV 血清型(DENV-1 和 DENV-2)对伊蚊 媒介 能力的影响。埃及伊蚊并描述了按顺序获得虫媒病毒的不同顺序的感染特征和 传播 表型。同时合并感染导致血清型依赖性结果。感染后 7 天 (dpi),与单一感染相比,DENV-1 感染率和病毒载量显着降低,而 DENV-2 唾液中的病毒载量增加。14 dpi 时,CHIKV+DENV-1 (CD1) 和 CHIKV+DENV-2 (CD2) 组的 CHIKV 感染率均显着降低,而 CHIKV 病毒载量仅在 CD2 组中降低。在连续感染实验中,无论 DENV 是在 CHIKV 之前还是之后获得,DENV-2 在两种连续感染场景中都表现出比 DENV-1 更低的复制水平。同样,DENV-2 显示出比 DENV-1 更低的 传播 效率,并且小鼠 传播 测定证实 DENV-2 的病毒载量降低。总体而言,我们的研究结果表明,白伊蚊中存在 CHIKV-DENV 共感染。埃及伊蚊与不同的感染和 传播 结果相关,具体取决于 DENV 血清型和感染情况。在连续暴露的蚊子中,根据虫媒病毒获得的顺序观察到不同的表型。这些结果突显了该共享 媒介 中虫媒病毒双重感染的复杂性,并强调了在评估流行环境中 媒介 能力和 传播 风险时考虑不同双重感染场景的重要性。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在巴西进行,重点关注埃及伊蚊。它检查了同时和顺序同时感染 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 CHIKV 对 媒介 能力的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用埃及伊蚊来研究同时感染 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 CHIKV 的影响。他们通过实验暴露和后续测试分析了感染率、病毒载量和 传播 效率。

papers.title: Development of a Single Thermal Cycling Multiplex RT-qPCR Assay for Rapid Arbovirus Detection
papers.abstract: Background: The co-circulation of multiple arboviruses with similar clinical presentations poses a significant challenge for public health surveillance. This study aimed to develop and clinically validate a novel multiplex RT-qPCR assay for the simultaneous detection of five arboviruses in three reactions. Methods: A diagnostic accuracy study was conducted in Salvador, Brazil. Evaluation was performed using 254 prospective serum samples and 34 archived positive samples. The primers and probes for the assay were designed in silico, all targeting highly conserved regions of Dengue (DENV), Zika (ZIKV), Chikungunya (CHIKV), Oropouche (OROV), and West Nile (WNV) viruses. The protocol was optimized in three reactions with a single thermal cycle, comprising a tetraplex reaction (DENV, CHIKV, ZIKV, and hRNAseP, an endogenous control) and two singleplex reactions (OROV and WNV). Results: In prospective analysis, the assay identified 45 DENV, 3 CHIKV, and 9 OROV-positive cases. Diagnostic accuracy for DENV and CHIKV was 96% (95% CI: 93.3–98.0%), successfully detecting four DENV cases missed by the reference standard. Furthermore, incorporating OROV enabled the identification of nine cases that conventional triplex protocols would have overlooked. Conclusion: This single-cycling multiplex RT-qPCR assay enhances epidemiological surveillance by expanding detection beyond traditional triplex targets to include OROV and WNV. This operational optimization reduces turnaround times and prevents the underdiagnosis of emerging arboviruses, serving as a robust diagnostic tool for endemic regions.

papers.title_zh: 开发用于快速虫媒病毒检测的单一热循环多重 RT-qPCR 检测方法
papers.source_body_en: Background: The co-circulation of multiple arboviruses with similar clinical presentations poses a significant challenge for public health surveillance. This study aimed to develop and clinically validate a novel multiplex RT-qPCR assay for the simultaneous detection of five arboviruses in three reactions. Methods: A diagnostic accuracy study was conducted in Salvador, Brazil. Evaluation was performed using 254 prospective serum samples and 34 archived positive samples. The primers and probes for the assay were designed in silico, all targeting highly conserved regions of Dengue (DENV), Zika (ZIKV), Chikungunya (CHIKV), Oropouche (OROV), and West Nile (WNV) viruses. The protocol was optimized in three reactions with a single thermal cycle, comprising a tetraplex reaction (DENV, CHIKV, ZIKV, and hRNAseP, an endogenous control) and two singleplex reactions (OROV and WNV). Results: In prospective analysis, the assay identified 45 DENV, 3 CHIKV, and 9 OROV-positive cases. Diagnostic accuracy for DENV and CHIKV was 96% (95% CI: 93.3–98.0%), successfully detecting four DENV cases missed by the reference standard. Furthermore, incorporating OROV enabled the identification of nine cases that conventional triplex protocols would have overlooked. Conclusion: This single-cycling multiplex RT-qPCR assay enhances epidemiological surveillance by expanding detection beyond traditional triplex targets to include OROV and WNV. This operational optimization reduces turnaround times and prevents the underdiagnosis of emerging arboviruses, serving as a robust diagnostic tool for endemic regions.

papers.title: Index
papers.abstract: Raw macro-climatic and epidemiological time series are inherently prone to non-stationary biases and linear seasonal trends, causing spurious correlations that mask genuine environmental teleconnections. This study aimed to evaluate and measure the long-distance relationship between the global Oceanic Niño Index (ONI) and local Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) transmission dynamics in Indonesia from January 2012 to December 2023 (n = 144 months). Methodologically, a quantitative associative time-series design was employed within RStudio. Both datasets exhibited non-normal distributions (p=0.000) and raw non-stationarity via Augmented Dickey-Fuller testing (p>0.05). To eliminate mathematical bias, a first-order differencing transformation was applied, successfully achieving stationarity (p=0.0100). The Cross-Correlation Function (CCF) was then calculated across an interaction window from Lag -6 to Lag +6 months. The results revealed a highly dynamic double-peak epidemiological pattern, peaking in 2013 (15,324 cases) and 2023 (6,049 cases). While no instantaneous correlation occurred at Lag 0 (r=-0.0180), a significant, optimal positive cross-correlation emerged at Lag -6 (r=0.1246). This confirms an asymmetric teleconnection where an increase in the ONI—shifting toward an El Niño phase—preceding the current period by six months directly drives increased Chikungunya outbreaks in Indonesia, providing a vital baseline for climate-based Early Warning Systems.

elements_zh.methods: 在方法论上,RStudio 中采用了定量关联时间序列设计。数据集表现出非正态分布和原始非平稳性,这些问题可以通过一阶差分变换来解决以实现平稳性。然后计算从滞后 -6 个月到滞后 +6 个月的交互窗口内的互相关函数 (CCF)。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果揭示了高度动态的双峰流行病学模式,峰值出现在 2013 年(15,324 例)和 2023 年(6,049 例)。在滞后 -6 (r=0.1246) 时出现了显着的最佳正互相关,证实了不对称遥相关,其中本期之前的 ONI 增加六个月直接驱动印度尼西亚基孔肯雅病 暴发 的增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证实了一种不对称的遥相关,即本期之前六个月的 ONI 增加直接导致印度尼西亚基孔肯雅热 暴发 的增加,为基于气候的早期预警系统提供了重要的基线。这一新发现表明气候指数与基孔肯雅热 传播 之间存在预测关系。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为印度尼西亚开发基于气候的基孔肯雅热 暴发 早期预警系统提供信息,从而加强 监测 和公共卫生准备。结果对风险评估和预防策略具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究设计的局限性包括使用非平稳时间序列数据,这可能会引入偏差。样本量对于研究期间来说是足够的,但对其他地区或时间段的普遍性尚不确定。由于时间序列分析的局限性和需要进一步验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 指数
papers.source_body_en: Raw macro-climatic and epidemiological time series are inherently prone to non-stationary biases and linear seasonal trends, causing spurious correlations that mask genuine environmental teleconnections. This study aimed to evaluate and measure the long-distance relationship between the global Oceanic Niño Index (ONI) and local Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) transmission dynamics in Indonesia from January 2012 to December 2023 (n = 144 months). Methodologically, a quantitative associative time-series design was employed within RStudio. Both datasets exhibited non-normal distributions (p=0.000) and raw non-stationarity via Augmented Dickey-Fuller testing (p>0.05). To eliminate mathematical bias, a first-order differencing transformation was applied, successfully achieving stationarity (p=0.0100). The Cross-Correlation Function (CCF) was then calculated across an interaction window from Lag -6 to Lag +6 months. The results revealed a highly dynamic double-peak epidemiological pattern, peaking in 2013 (15,324 cases) and 2023 (6,049 cases). While no instantaneous correlation occurred at Lag 0 (r=-0.0180), a significant, optimal positive cross-correlation emerged at Lag -6 (r=0.1246). This confirms an asymmetric teleconnection where an increase in the ONI—shifting toward an El Niño phase—preceding the current period by six months directly drives increased Chikungunya outbreaks in Indonesia, providing a vital baseline for climate-based Early Warning Systems.

papers.title: Analysis of Cell Populations from Arbovirus-Infected Tissues by Flow Cytometry.
papers.abstract: Arboviruses still represent a major challenge to public health in many parts of the world. Despite shared epidemiological characteristics, each arboviral disorder displays distinct cellular tropism and activation patterns, progressing to immunopathological outcomes that remain not fully elucidated. A deeper understanding of these processes requires methodologies capable of characterizing the often-complex cellular responses. In this context, flow cytometry emerges as a valuable tool, enabling the characterization of heterogeneous cell populations, the assessment of activation and proliferation markers, the quantification of inflammatory mediators, and the detection of cell death pathways. By integrating these parameters, flow cytometry can enhance our understanding of arbovirus pathogenesis, clarify their cellular tropism, and understand immune responses to infection. This methodological article outlines the main steps for applying the technique to different target tissues infected by chikungunya, dengue, yellow fever, and Zika viruses, emphasizing the most effective strategies.

papers.source_body_en: Arboviruses still represent a major challenge to public health in many parts of the world. Despite shared epidemiological characteristics, each arboviral disorder displays distinct cellular tropism and activation patterns, progressing to immunopathological outcomes that remain not fully elucidated. A deeper understanding of these processes requires methodologies capable of characterizing the often-complex cellular responses. In this context, flow cytometry emerges as a valuable tool, enabling the characterization of heterogeneous cell populations, the assessment of activation and proliferation markers, the quantification of inflammatory mediators, and the detection of cell death pathways. By integrating these parameters, flow cytometry can enhance our understanding of arbovirus pathogenesis, clarify their cellular tropism, and understand immune responses to infection. This methodological article outlines the main steps for applying the technique to different target tissues infected by chikungunya, dengue, yellow fever, and Zika viruses, emphasizing the most effective strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 虫媒病毒仍然是世界许多地区公共卫生的重大挑战。尽管具有共同的流行病学特征,但每种虫媒病毒性疾病都表现出不同的细胞向性和激活模式,并发展为尚未完全阐明的免疫病理学结果。要更深入地了解这些过程,需要能够表征通常复杂的细胞反应的方法。在这种背景下,流式细胞术成为一种有价值的工具,可以表征异质细胞群、评估活化和增殖标记、量化炎症介质以及检测细胞死亡途径。通过整合这些参数,流式细胞术可以增强我们对虫媒病毒发病机制的了解,阐明其细胞向性,并了解免疫应答的感染情况。这篇方法论文章概述了将该技术应用于受基孔肯雅热、登革热、黄热病和寨卡病毒感染的不同目标组织的主要步骤,强调了最有效的策略。

papers.title: Arbovirus circulation in Brazil: a scoping review protocol
papers.abstract: Arboviruses transmitted by Aedes species—predominantly Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus—represent a major public health challenge in Brazil. The co-circulation, re-emergence, and recurring epidemics of Dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), alongside the potential re-urbanization risk of Yellow Fever virus (YFV) over recent decades, have imposed severe health, social, and economic burdens across diverse geographic regions. Despite extensive epidemiological surveillance and research, literature remains fragmented regarding local variations in infection frequency, population susceptibility, diagnostic approaches, and regional disease burdens. A systematic mapping of published evidence—specifically focusing on human infection and exposure evidenced by laboratory detection methods (molecular, serological, or viral isolation)—is necessary to synthesize current knowledge, delineate spatial-temporal patterns, and identify critical evidence gaps in Aedes-borne arboviral research across Brazilian urban and peri-urban environments.

papers.title_zh: 巴西虫媒病毒传播:范围审查协议
papers.source_body_en: Arboviruses transmitted by Aedes species—predominantly Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus—represent a major public health challenge in Brazil. The co-circulation, re-emergence, and recurring epidemics of Dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), alongside the potential re-urbanization risk of Yellow Fever virus (YFV) over recent decades, have imposed severe health, social, and economic burdens across diverse geographic regions. Despite extensive epidemiological surveillance and research, literature remains fragmented regarding local variations in infection frequency, population susceptibility, diagnostic approaches, and regional disease burdens. A systematic mapping of published evidence—specifically focusing on human infection and exposure evidenced by laboratory detection methods (molecular, serological, or viral isolation)—is necessary to synthesize current knowledge, delineate spatial-temporal patterns, and identify critical evidence gaps in Aedes-borne arboviral research across Brazilian urban and peri-urban environments.

papers.title: Retinal manifestations of neglected tropical diseases.
papers.abstract: Purpose of review Neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) are increasingly encountered outside endemic regions due to global migration, international travel, and climate change. This review addresses the timely need for ophthalmologists to recognize the retinal manifestations of NTDs, as these conditions now appear in developed nations where clinicians may have limited prior exposure. Recent findings Modern multimodal imaging has revealed distinct retinal patterns that are frequently seen in NTDs. Dengue and chikungunya present with maculopathy, foveolitis, and retinal hemorrhages. Onchocerciasis causes progressive chorioretinal atrophy and optic nerve involvement leading to vision loss. Neurocysticercosis manifests as subretinal or intravitreal cysts with visible scolices. Schistosomiasis produces chorioretinal granulomas and neuroretinitis. Leishmaniasis presents with posterior uveitis and chorioretinal lesions. African trypanosomiasis demonstrates choroidal infiltrates and retinal vasculitis. Chagas disease shows microvasculopathy with retinal hemorrhages, while leprosy causes chronic uveitis with iris pearls and chorioretinal scarring. Summary Recognition of retinal manifestations is crucial for NTD diagnosis and management. Ophthalmologists must maintain high clinical suspicion based on travel history and systemic symptoms. Collaborative care with infectious disease specialists and utilization of appropriate diagnostic modalities facilitate optimal outcomes and prevent vision loss while addressing broader public health implications.

papers.title_zh: 被忽视的热带病的视网膜表现。
papers.source_body_en: Purpose of review Neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) are increasingly encountered outside endemic regions due to global migration, international travel, and climate change. This review addresses the timely need for ophthalmologists to recognize the retinal manifestations of NTDs, as these conditions now appear in developed nations where clinicians may have limited prior exposure. Recent findings Modern multimodal imaging has revealed distinct retinal patterns that are frequently seen in NTDs. Dengue and chikungunya present with maculopathy, foveolitis, and retinal hemorrhages. Onchocerciasis causes progressive chorioretinal atrophy and optic nerve involvement leading to vision loss. Neurocysticercosis manifests as subretinal or intravitreal cysts with visible scolices. Schistosomiasis produces chorioretinal granulomas and neuroretinitis. Leishmaniasis presents with posterior uveitis and chorioretinal lesions. African trypanosomiasis demonstrates choroidal infiltrates and retinal vasculitis. Chagas disease shows microvasculopathy with retinal hemorrhages, while leprosy causes chronic uveitis with iris pearls and chorioretinal scarring. Summary Recognition of retinal manifestations is crucial for NTD diagnosis and management. Ophthalmologists must maintain high clinical suspicion based on travel history and systemic symptoms. Collaborative care with infectious disease specialists and utilization of appropriate diagnostic modalities facilitate optimal outcomes and prevent vision loss while addressing broader public health implications.
papers.abstract_zh: 审查目的 由于全球移民、国际旅行和气候变化,被忽视的热带病 (NTD) 在流行地区以外越来越多地出现。这篇综述解决了眼科医生及时识别 NTD 视网膜表现的需要,因为这些疾病现在出现在发达国家,而临床医生之前的接触可能有限。最新发现 现代多模态成像揭示了 NTD 中常见的独特视网膜模式。登革热和基孔肯雅热表现为黄斑病、小凹炎和视网膜出血。盘尾丝虫病导致进行性脉络膜视网膜萎缩和视神经受累,导致视力丧失。神经囊尾蚴病表现为视网膜下或玻璃体内囊肿,具有可见的头节。血吸虫病会产生脉络膜视网膜肉芽肿和神经视网膜炎。利什曼病表现为后葡萄膜炎和脉络膜视网膜病变。非洲锥虫病表现为脉络膜浸润和视网膜血管炎。恰加斯病表现为微血管病变并伴有视网膜出血,而麻风病则导致慢性葡萄膜炎,伴有虹膜珍珠和脉络膜视网膜疤痕。摘要 识别视网膜表现对于 NTD 诊断 和治疗至关重要。眼科医生必须根据旅行史和全身症状保持高度的临床怀疑。与传染病专家的协作护理和利用适当的诊断方式可促进最佳结果并防止视力丧失,同时解决更广泛的公共卫生影响。

papers.title: Indigofera suffruticosa as a Source of Anti-Arboviral Phytoconstituents: Bioguided Fractionation, Isolation of 3-O-β-D-Glucosyl-β-Sitosterol, and In Vitro Evaluation Against ZIKV, CHIKV, and MAYV
papers.abstract: Arboviruses transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, including Zika (ZIKV), Chikungunya (CHIKV), and Mayaro (MAYV) viruses, lack approved antiviral therapies. This study evaluated the cytotoxicity and antiviral activity of ethanolic extracts and fractions from stems and leaves of Indigofera suffruticosa Mill. (Fabaceae), and isolated the active principles through bioguided fractionation. Extracts were obtained by cold maceration and partitioned into chloroform, ethyl acetate, and aqueous methanol fractions. Cytotoxicity was assessed by the MTT assay in MRC-5 and Vero cells, and antiviral activity was determined in simultaneous treatment-infection assays in Vero cells. The stem ethanolic extract showed potent anti-ZIKV activity (EC50 = 29.43 ± 1.43 μg/mL; SI > 13.59). The chloroform fraction displayed broad-spectrum efficacy, with EC50 = 89.48 ± 2.70 μg/mL (ZIKV; SI > 4.47), 37.05 ± 2.26 μg/mL (CHIKV; SI > 10.80), and 42.39 ± 3.60 μg/mL (MAYV; SI > 9.44). Bioguided fractionation afforded 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-β-sitosterol, which exhibited selective anti-alphavirus activity against CHIKV (EC50 = 151.76 μM; SI = 2.02) and MAYV (EC50 = 150.35 μM; SI = 2.03), but was inactive against ZIKV, indicating that additional constituents account for the anti-flaviviral effect. Indigofera suffruticosa is a promising source of broad-spectrum anti-arboviral agents, supporting further bioassay-guided isolation and mechanistic studies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,包括寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 和马亚罗病毒 (MAYV),缺乏已获批准的 抗病毒药物 疗法。本研究旨在鉴定靛蓝中潜在的抗虫媒病毒化合物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了靛蓝茎叶乙醇提取物和级分的细胞毒性和 抗病毒药物 活性。该研究是使用 Vero 细胞作为 宿主 在体外进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 MRC-5 和 Vero 细胞中的 MTT 测定评估细胞毒性,并在 Vero 细胞中同时进行 治疗 感染测定来测定 抗病毒药物 活性。通过冷浸渍获得提取物并分配成氯仿、乙酸乙酯和甲醇水溶液级分。使用生物引导分级分离来分离活性成分。
elements_zh.main_results: 茎乙醇提取物显示出有效的抗 ZIKV 活性(EC50 = 29.43 ± 1.43 μg/mL;SI > 13.59)。氯仿馏分显示出广谱功效,EC50 = 89.48 ± 2.70 μg/mL (ZIKV;SI > 4.47)、37.05 ± 2.26 μg/mL (CHIKV;SI > 10.80) 和 42.39 ± 3.60 μg/mL (MAYV;SI > 9.44)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定 3-O-β-D-葡萄糖基-β-谷甾醇是一种对 CHIKV 和 MAYV 具有选择性抗甲病毒活性的化合物,但对 ZIKV 没有,这表明其他成分可能是抗黄病毒作用的原因。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 木蓝是广谱抗虫媒病毒药物的有前景的来源,支持进一步生物测定引导的分离和机制研究以实现潜在的治疗应用。

papers.source_body_en: Arboviruses transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, including Zika (ZIKV), Chikungunya (CHIKV), and Mayaro (MAYV) viruses, lack approved antiviral therapies. This study evaluated the cytotoxicity and antiviral activity of ethanolic extracts and fractions from stems and leaves of Indigofera suffruticosa Mill. (Fabaceae), and isolated the active principles through bioguided fractionation. Extracts were obtained by cold maceration and partitioned into chloroform, ethyl acetate, and aqueous methanol fractions. Cytotoxicity was assessed by the MTT assay in MRC-5 and Vero cells, and antiviral activity was determined in simultaneous treatment-infection assays in Vero cells. The stem ethanolic extract showed potent anti-ZIKV activity (EC50 = 29.43 ± 1.43 μg/mL; SI > 13.59). The chloroform fraction displayed broad-spectrum efficacy, with EC50 = 89.48 ± 2.70 μg/mL (ZIKV; SI > 4.47), 37.05 ± 2.26 μg/mL (CHIKV; SI > 10.80), and 42.39 ± 3.60 μg/mL (MAYV; SI > 9.44). Indigofera suffruticosa is a promising source of broad-spectrum anti-arboviral agents, supporting further bioassay-guided isolation and mechanistic studies.
