papers.title: Microemulsion-based delivery of peppermint essential oil as a sustainable strategy for Aedes aegypti control
papers.abstract: Background Arboviral diseases such as dengue, Zika, and chikungunya remain major public health challenges worldwide. In the absence of broadly effective antiviral therapies and considering the limitations of current vaccination strategies, vector control remains the primary approach for reducing disease transmission. Essential oils have emerged as promising alternatives to synthetic insecticides because of their renewable origin, biodegradability, and multiple mechanisms of action. Nevertheless, their practical application is often limited by poor water solubility and physicochemical instability. This study investigated the chemical composition, larvicidal activity, and microemulsion-based formulation of Mentha piperita L. essential oil against Aedes aegypti larvae. Methods The chemical composition of the essential oil was determined by gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC–MS). Larvicidal activity against third-instar A. aegypti larvae was evaluated by determining mortality rates and the median lethal concentration (LC 50 ). A pseudoternary phase diagram was constructed to identify suitable microemulsion regions, and selected formulations were characterized according to droplet size, polydispersity index (PDI), and short-term physical stability. The larvicidal activity of the resulting microemulsions was subsequently evaluated at different essential-oil concentrations. A blank microemulsion containing the formulation components without M. piperita essential oil was also evaluated as a control. Results GC–MS analysis identified 14 compounds representing nearly 100% of the essential oil composition, with menthol (50.17%) and menthone (23.02%) as the predominant constituents. The free essential oil exhibited concentration-dependent larvicidal activity against A. aegypti , with an LC 50 of 175.7 μg/mL and complete larval mortality at 250 μg/mL. Among the tested formulations, PME-05 was selected as the most promising formulation for further development because it achieved complete larval mortality while containing only 5% peppermint essential oil and exhibited the lowest PDI (0.06 ± 0.007), indicating a highly homogeneous dispersed system. Conclusion The results support the use of microemulsion technology as a suitable delivery system for M. piperita essential oil, facilitating its dispersion and application in aqueous environments while retaining its larvicidal activity. The developed formulation represents a promising platform for the application of botanical larvicides in mosquito control. Further studies are needed to evaluate long-term physicochemical stability, residual activity, effects on non-target organisms, and performance under semi-field and field conditions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热、寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅热等虫媒病毒性疾病仍然是全球重大的公共卫生挑战。在缺乏广泛有效的 抗病毒药物 疗法的情况下,并考虑到当前 疫苗接种 策略的局限性,媒介 控制仍然是减少疾病 传播 的主要方法。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究研究了胡椒薄荷精油的化学成分、杀幼虫活性和微乳液制剂对埃及伊蚊幼虫的作用。游离精油对埃及伊蚊表现出浓度依赖性杀幼虫活性,LC 50 为 175.7 μg/mL,完整幼虫 死亡率 为 250 μg/mL。

papers.title_zh: 基于微乳液的薄荷精油输送作为控制埃及伊蚊的可持续策略
papers.source_body_en: Background Arboviral diseases such as dengue, Zika, and chikungunya remain major public health challenges worldwide. In the absence of broadly effective antiviral therapies and considering the limitations of current vaccination strategies, vector control remains the primary approach for reducing disease transmission. Essential oils have emerged as promising alternatives to synthetic insecticides because of their renewable origin, biodegradability, and multiple mechanisms of action. Nevertheless, their practical application is often limited by poor water solubility and physicochemical instability. This study investigated the chemical composition, larvicidal activity, and microemulsion-based formulation of Mentha piperita L. essential oil against Aedes aegypti larvae. Methods The chemical composition of the essential oil was determined by gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC–MS). Larvicidal activity against third-instar A. aegypti larvae was evaluated by determining mortality rates and the median lethal concentration (LC 50 ). A pseudoternary phase diagram was constructed to identify suitable microemulsion regions, and selected formulations were characterized according to droplet size, polydispersity index (PDI), and short-term physical stability. The larvicidal activity of the resulting microemulsions was subsequently evaluated at different essential-oil concentrations. A blank microemulsion containing the formulation components without M. piperita essential oil was also evaluated as a control. Results GC–MS analysis identified 14 compounds representing nearly 100% of the essential oil composition, with menthol (50.17%) and menthone (23.02%) as the predominant constituents. The free essential oil exhibited concentration-dependent larvicidal activity against A. aegypti , with an LC 50 of 175.7 μg/mL and complete larval mortality at 250 μg/mL. Among the tested formulations, PME-05 was selected as the most promising formulation for further development because it achieved complete larval mortality while containing only 5% peppermint essential oil and exhibited the lowest PDI (0.06 ± 0.007), indicating a highly homogeneous dispersed system. Conclusion The results support the use of microemulsion technology as a suitable delivery system for M. piperita essential oil, facilitating its dispersion and application in aqueous environments while retaining its larvicidal activity. The developed formulation represents a promising platform for the application of botanical larvicides in mosquito control. Further studies are needed to evaluate long-term physicochemical stability, residual activity, effects on non-target organisms, and performance under semi-field and field conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 登革热、寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅热等虫媒病毒性疾病仍然是全球主要的公共卫生挑战。在缺乏广泛有效的 抗病毒药物 疗法的情况下,并考虑到当前 疫苗接种 策略的局限性,媒介 控制仍然是减少疾病 传播 的主要方法。精油因其可再生来源、生物降解性和多种作用机制而成为合成杀虫剂的有前景的替代品。然而,它们的实际应用往往受到水溶性差和物理化学不稳定性的限制。本研究研究了胡椒薄荷精油的化学成分、杀幼虫活性和微乳液制剂对埃及伊蚊幼虫的作用。方法 采用气相色谱-质谱法(GC-MS)测定精油的化学成分。通过测定死亡率率和中位致死浓度(LC 50 )来评估针对三龄埃及伊蚊幼虫的杀幼虫活性。构建了伪三元相图来确定合适的微乳液区域,并根据液滴尺寸、多分散指数 (PDI) 和短期物理稳定性对所选配方进行表征。随后评估了不同精油浓度下所得微乳液的杀幼虫活性。还评估了含有不含胡椒胡椒精油的制剂组分的空白微乳液作为对照。结果 GC-MS 分析鉴定出 14 种化合物,几乎代表了精油成分的 100%,其中薄荷醇 (50.17%) 和薄荷酮 (23.02%) 是主要成分。游离精油对埃及伊蚊表现出浓度依赖性杀幼虫活性,LC 50 为 175.7 μg/mL,完整幼虫 死亡率 为 250 μg/mL。在测试的配方中,PME-05被选为最有希望进一步开发的配方,因为它在仅含有5%薄荷精油的情况下实现了完整的幼虫死亡率,并且表现出最低的PDI(0.06±0.007),表明高度均匀的分散体系。结论 结果支持使用微乳液技术作为胡椒胡椒精油的合适输送系统,促进其在水性环境中的分散和应用,同时保留其杀幼虫活性。所开发的制剂为植物杀幼虫剂在蚊子控制中的应用提供了一个有前途的平台。需要进一步的研究来评估长期理化稳定性、残留活性、对非目标生物的影响以及半田间和田间条件下的性能。

papers.title: B-144 Performance of IgM ELISA and RT-PCR for Oropouche Virus diagnosis: defining the diagnostic window
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The Oropouche virus (OROV), primarily transmitted by the bite of infected Culicoides paraensis midges, has emerged as a significant public health concern in South America due to the substantial increase in the number of cases across several countries since late 2023, including both autochthonous and imported transmission, reflecting the virus's spreading potential. Given that symptoms overlap with other arboviruses, such as dengue and chikungunya, laboratory testing is crucial for differential diagnosis. The diagnostic window varies throughout the clinical course of the disease: RT-PCR detection is most effective during the early stages, whereas IgM serology becomes more valuable in later phases. Aiming for a better understanding of disease progression, this study evaluated the relationship between days post-symptom onset (DPSO), the anti-IgM ratio (ELISA), and RT-PCR results for OROV to provide insights for diagnosis based on clinical evolution. Methods Serum samples (n=180) from patients in Espirito Santo State (Brazil) presenting symptoms consistent with arboviruses were tested. Analysis included an in-house RT-PCR targeting the S gene of OROV and by an indirect IgM ELISA (EUROIMMUN), with results expressed as ratio ( 10 days (n=18). Results Overall, 50.6% (91/180) of samples tested positive for OROV in at least one assay, of these, 14.3% (13/91) were double-positive, 46.2% (42/91) were RT-PCR positive only, and 39.6% (36/91) were IgM positive only. Total positivity was 27.2% (49/180) for RT-PCR and 30.6% (55/180) for IgM ELISA, with 6.7% (12/180) yielding borderline results. Sampling was concentrated in the 5–7 DPSO window, representing 75% (135/180) of the cohort. A shift in the detection sensitivity of each method was observed as DPSO increased. In the 10 days strata, IgM reactivity was 48% (12/25) and 44.4% (8/18), respectively, while RT-PCR positivity was 40% (10/25) and 22.2% (4/18). The higher proportion of IgM-reactive samples suggests greater clinical utility for serology in the later stages of the disease. Conclusion The findings reinforce the temporal complementarity between RT-PCR and IgM ELISA for OROV diagnosis. A significant proportion of RT-PCR positive cases remain IgM negative for up to 7 days, and vice versa, while IgM reactivity increases substantially from 8 days onwards. In clinical scenarios with a longer duration of symptoms, IgM serology provides critical diagnostic value as viral load decreases and RT-PCR sensitivity declines.

papers.title_zh: B-144 Oropouche 病毒 诊断 的 IgM ELISA 和 RT-PCR 性能:定义诊断窗口
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background The Oropouche virus (OROV), primarily transmitted by the bite of infected Culicoides paraensis midges, has emerged as a significant public health concern in South America due to the substantial increase in the number of cases across several countries since late 2023, including both autochthonous and imported transmission, reflecting the virus's spreading potential. Given that symptoms overlap with other arboviruses, such as dengue and chikungunya, laboratory testing is crucial for differential diagnosis. The diagnostic window varies throughout the clinical course of the disease: RT-PCR detection is most effective during the early stages, whereas IgM serology becomes more valuable in later phases. Aiming for a better understanding of disease progression, this study evaluated the relationship between days post-symptom onset (DPSO), the anti-IgM ratio (ELISA), and RT-PCR results for OROV to provide insights for diagnosis based on clinical evolution. Methods Serum samples (n=180) from patients in Espirito Santo State (Brazil) presenting symptoms consistent with arboviruses were tested. Analysis included an in-house RT-PCR targeting the S gene of OROV and by an indirect IgM ELISA (EUROIMMUN), with results expressed as ratio ( 10 days (n=18). Results Overall, 50.6% (91/180) of samples tested positive for OROV in at least one assay, of these, 14.3% (13/91) were double-positive, 46.2% (42/91) were RT-PCR positive only, and 39.6% (36/91) were IgM positive only. Total positivity was 27.2% (49/180) for RT-PCR and 30.6% (55/180) for IgM ELISA, with 6.7% (12/180) yielding borderline results. Sampling was concentrated in the 5–7 DPSO window, representing 75% (135/180) of the cohort. A shift in the detection sensitivity of each method was observed as DPSO increased. In the 10 days strata, IgM reactivity was 48% (12/25) and 44.4% (8/18), respectively, while RT-PCR positivity was 40% (10/25) and 22.2% (4/18). The higher proportion of IgM-reactive samples suggests greater clinical utility for serology in the later stages of the disease. Conclusion The findings reinforce the temporal complementarity between RT-PCR and IgM ELISA for OROV diagnosis. A significant proportion of RT-PCR positive cases remain IgM negative for up to 7 days, and vice versa, while IgM reactivity increases substantially from 8 days onwards. In clinical scenarios with a longer duration of symptoms, IgM serology provides critical diagnostic value as viral load decreases and RT-PCR sensitivity declines.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 Oropouche病毒(OROV)主要通过感染的Culicoides paraensis蚊虫叮咬传播,由于自2023年底以来多个南美国家病例数量显著增加,包括本地和输入性传播,已成为重要的公共卫生问题,反映了该病毒的传播潜力。鉴于其症状与其他虫媒病毒(如登革热和基孔肯雅热)重叠,实验室检测对于鉴别诊断诊断至关重要。诊断窗口在整个疾病临床过程中有所不同:RT-PCR检测在早期阶段最为有效,而IgM 血清学在后期阶段更具价值。本研究旨在更好地了解疾病进展,评估OROV的检测与发病后天数(DPSO)、抗IgM比值(ELISA)和RT-PCR结果之间的关系,以提供基于临床进化的诊断见解。方法 收集了巴西埃皮里托圣托州180份患者血清样本,这些患者表现出与虫媒病毒相符的症状。分析包括针对OROV S基因的内部RT-PCR检测和间接IgM ELISA(EUROIMMUN)检测,结果以比值表示(10天,n=18)。结果 总体而言,180份样本中有50.6%(91/180)在至少一项检测中呈阳性,其中14.3%(13/91)为双阳性,46.2%(42/91)仅RT-PCR阳性,39.6%(36/91)仅IgM阳性。RT-PCR总阳性率为27.2%(49/180),IgM ELISA总阳性率为30.6%(55/180),其中6.7%(12/180)呈现临界结果。采样集中在发病后5-7天的窗口期,占样本总数的75%(135/180)。随着DPSO的增加,每种方法的检测敏感性均出现变化。在10天分组中,IgM反应率为48%(12/25)和44.4%(8/18),而RT-PCR阳性率为40%(10/25)和22.2%(4/18)。IgM反应样本比例较高,表明血清学在疾病后期具有更大的临床价值。结论 研究结果强化了RT-PCR和IgM ELISA在OROV 诊断中的时间互补性。在症状持续7天内,仍有相当比例的RT-PCR阳性病例IgM阴性,反之亦然;而从第8天开始,IgM反应显著增加。在症状持续时间较长的临床情况下,IgM 血清学提供了关键的诊断价值,因为病毒载量下降,RT-PCR的敏感性也随之降低。

news.content_title: CHP Urges Public to Prevent Dengue and Chikungunya as Weather Favors Mosquito Breeding
news.content: Skip to Content Javascript must be enabled for the correct page display CHP Urges Public to Prevent Dengue and Chikungunya as Weather Favors Mosquito Breeding News China Business TECH ENT Sport HK HotTV Asia Pacific Blog HK News China Business TECH ENT Sport HK HotTV Asia Pacific Blog Font Size A A Home HotNews NEWS CHINA BUSINESS TECH ENT SPORT HK ASIA PACIFIC BLOG HK HK CHP Urges Public to Prevent Dengue and Chikungunya as Weather Favors Mosquito Breeding 2026-10-02 17:30 Last Updated At:10-04 15:38 Facebook Weibo Update on mosquito-borne diseases, dengue fever and chikungunya fever The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) of the Department of Health today (October 2) announced the latest situation regarding dengue fever (DF) and chikungunya fever (CF). Although Hong Kong has entered autumn, the weather has yet to cool down and the rainy season has not yet ended, thus favourable for mosquito breeding. Members of the public are reminded to take appropriate measures to prevent mosquito bites and mosquito breeding, both in Hong Kong and when travelling to areas affected by mosquito-borne diseases, in order to prevent mosquito-borne diseases. Dengue fever ---------------- From September 25 to yesterday (October 1), no new cases of DF had been recorded.Hong Kong has recorded 32 DF cases so far this year, comprising 30 imported cases and two local cases. A total of 59 DF cases were recorded last year (2025), all of which were imported cases. In 2024, 161 DF cases were recorded, comprising 156 imported cases and five local cases. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), the global incidence of DF has markedly increased over the past two decades, posing a substantial public health challenge. In 2024, the WHO recorded over 14 million DF cases, which was a record number. In 2025, over five million cases and over 4 000 DF-related deaths were reported in over 90 countries/territories. From January to August 2026, around 2.2 million cases and over 1 000 DF-related deaths have been recorded globally. DF has long been prevalent in many neighbouring tourist destinations. So far this year, Sri Lanka and Vietnam each recorded over 100 000 cases; Bangladesh and Cambodia each recorded over 80 000 cases; Indonesia and Malaysia each recorded over 70 000 cases; and Singapore recorded over 2 500 cases. Meanwhile, according to the Guangdong Provincial Disease Control and Prevention Administration, as of August 31, 2026, Guangdong Province has recorded 431 cases, of which 150 were recorded in August. Detailed information on the latest DF situation in Hong Kong, as well as neighbouring and overseas countries and areas, has been uploaded to the CHP'swebsite. Chikungunya fever ----------------------- From September 25 to yesterday, the CHP recorded one imported CF case, involving a 62-year-old female. The patient had visited Guangdong Province during the incubation period. The CHP considered that she was infected during travel. The case was classified as an imported case. The patient has been admitted to the hospital for treatment in a mosquito-free environment and is in stable condition.She has two household contacts who are currently asymptomatic and under medical surveillance. The CHP's epidemiological investigation is ongoing. The case has been reported to the health authority of Guangdong Province. Hong Kong has recorded four confirmed CF cases so far this year, including three imported cases and one local case. Hong Kong recorded a total of 82 confirmed CF cases last year. Among them, 11 were local cases and the rest were imported cases. According to the WHO, a total of 502 264 CF cases and 186 CF-related deaths were reported in 41 countries/territories last year. Cases were reported in the Americas, Africa, Asia and Europe. According to the Guangdong Provincial Disease Control and Prevention Administration, as of August 31, 2026, Guangdong Province has recorded 739 cases, with 496 recorded in August, a sharp increase from the 36 and 171 cases recorded in June and July respectively. Preventive measures to be taken by the public ---------------------------------------------------- The CHP reminds members of the public to maintain good environmental hygiene, and to take appropriate measures to prevent mosquito bites and mosquito breeding, both in Hong Kong and when travelling to areas affected by mosquito-borne diseases, in order to prevent mosquito-borne diseases. Mosquito-borne diseases such as DF and CF are endemic in various countries worldwide. The risk of importation persists. Members of the public should check the situation at their destinations before travelling abroad, especially when travelling to Southeast Asian countries. Additionally, whether travelling or not, members of the public should use DEET-containing insect repellents or other effective active ingredients properly to prevent mosquito bites, but the following precautions should be taken when using them: read the label instructions carefully first; apply right before entering an area with a risk of mosquito bites; apply on exposed skin and clothing; use DEET of up to 30 per cent for pregnant women and up to 10 per cent for children (for children who travel to countries or areas where mosquito-borne diseases are endemic or epidemic, and where exposure is likely, those aged 2 months or above can use DEET-containing insect repellents with a DEET concentration of up to 30 per cent); apply sunscreen first, then insect repellent; reapply only when needed and follow the instructions; and in addition to DEET, there are other insect repellents available on the market containing different active ingredients, such as IR3535 and picaridin. When using any insect repellent, the public should follow the usage instructions and precautions on the product label. The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD) appeals to members of the public to continue to stay alert and work together to carry out mosquito prevention and control measures early, including inspecting their homes and surroundings to remove potential breeding grounds, changing water in vases and scrubbing their inner surfaces, removing water in saucers under potted plants at least once a week, and properly disposing of containers such as empty cans and lunch boxes. The FEHD also advises members of the public and property management agencies to keep drains free of blockage and level all defective ground surfaces to prevent the accumulation of water. They should also scrub all drains and surface sewers with an alkaline detergent at least once a week to remove any mosquito eggs. The public should call 1823 in case of mosquito problems, and may visit the following pages for more information: the CF page of the CHP and the Travel Health Service, the latest Travel Health News, tips for using insect repellents, and the CHP Facebook Page, Instagram Account and YouTube Channel, and also the Mosquito Prevention and Control dedicated page of the FEHD. The Centre for Health Protection, Photo source: reference image Next Article Hong Kong's 14th Microfilm Production Support Scheme Promotes Creative Collaboration in Advertising, Film, and Music Industries Matching session and kick-off ceremony of 14th Microfilm Production Support Scheme (Music) held Sponsored by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency (CCIDA) under the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and organised by the Hong Kong Association of Interactive Marketing, the 14th Microfilm Production Support Scheme (Music) held its matching session and kick-off ceremony today (October 5), promoting cross-sector collaboration among Hong Kong's advertising, film and television, and music industries. Speaking at the kick-off ceremony, Assistant Commissioner for Cultural and Creative Industries Miss Yvonne Ip noted that since its launch, the scheme has facilitated collaboration between more than 340 advertising production companies and some 290 groups of singers, providing the local film and television, advertising, and music sectors with a valuable creation platform and hands-on opportunities. CCIDA will continue to actively foster cross-sector collaboration in the local creative industries, with a view to promoting the professionalism, industrialisation and internationalisation of the industries. This year's scheme consists of two funding categories, namely the "Advertising Production Start-ups" and the "Professional Advertising Production Houses". The selected creative teams will receive production funding as well as professional training and mentoring opportunities to produce original microfilms. At the kick-off ceremony, 10 start-up advertising production companies under the category of "Advertising Production Start-ups" were paired with singers, while the five teams under the category of "Professional Advertising Production Houses" were formed by directors, scriptwriters, singers and advertising production companies individually. The microfilms will premiere online in January next year and will be showcased to the industry at the Hong Kong International Film and TV Market (FILMART) in March next year. Launched in 2013, the Microfilm Production Support Scheme (Music) is a cross-sector collaboration initiative that brings together advertising and film production with music creation. It aims to enable local emerging directors and their creative teams to collaborate with local singers in producing original microfilms, thereby promoting the development of Hong Kong’s creative industry ecosystem. For more information about the 14th Microfilm Production Support Scheme (Music), please visit www.hkmfa.hk (Chinese only). news.content_zh: 香港卫生防护中心(CHP)发布公共卫生警告,呼吁居民采取预防措施,防止登革热(DF)和基孔肯雅热(CF)的传播,因为天气条件有利于蚊虫繁殖。报告指出,DF和CF是蚊媒疾病,仍广泛流行于许多国家,过去二十年全球登革热病例显著增加。截至2026年8月31日,广东省报告了739例基孔肯雅热病例,其中仅8月就出现了496例。CHP报告了一例涉及62岁女性的输入性基孔肯雅热病例,该患者在潜伏期内曾到访广东省。患者目前病情稳定,其两名无症状的家庭接触者正在接受医疗监测。CHP正在进行持续的流行病学调查,并强调公众需提高警惕,防止蚊虫繁殖和叮咬。预防措施包括保持环境卫生、使用含DEET的驱蚊剂,并向食物及环境卫生署(FEHD)报告蚊虫问题。
news.summary_zh: 香港卫生防护中心(CHP)发布公共卫生警告,呼吁居民采取预防措施,防止登革热(DF)和基孔肯雅热(CF)的传播,因为天气条件有利于蚊虫繁殖。报告指出,DF和CF是蚊媒疾病,仍广泛流行于许多国家,过去二十年全球登革热病例显著增加。截至2026年8月31日,广东省报告了739例基孔肯雅热病例,其中仅8月就出现了496例。CHP报告了一例涉及62岁女性的输入性基孔肯雅热病例,该患者在潜伏期内曾到访广东省。患者目前病情稳定,其两名无症状的家庭接触者正在接受医疗监测。CHP正在进行持续的流行病学调查,并强调公众需提高警惕,防止蚊虫繁殖和叮咬。预防措施包括保持环境卫生、使用含DEET的驱蚊剂,并向食物及环境卫生署(FEHD)报告蚊虫问题。

analysis_zh.time: 该报告于2026年10月2日发布,于2026年10月4日最后更新。事件日期范围为2026年9月25日至2026年10月1日。
analysis_zh.location_and_population: 该报告关注香港及其周边地区,包括广东省,并提及了包括斯里兰卡、越南、孟加拉国、柬埔寨、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡等国家和地区的病例。这些国家和地区分布在美洲、非洲、亚洲和欧洲。
analysis_zh.event: 香港卫生防护中心(CHP)报告了一例输入性基孔肯雅热(CF)病例,涉及一名62岁的女性,她在潜伏期内曾到访广东省。该病例被归类为输入性病例,患者目前病情稳定,其两名无症状的家庭接触者正在接受医疗监测。
analysis_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: As of August 31, 2026, Guangdong Province recorded 739 CF cases, with 496 in August. Globally, over 2.2 million DF cases and over 1,000 DF-related deaths were reported from January to August 2026. The CHP noted the risk of importation persists, and DF and CF are endemic in many countries worldwide.
analysis_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: CHP正在进行持续的流行病学调查。预防措施包括保持环境卫生、清除潜在蚊虫繁殖地、使用驱蚊剂,并向食物及环境卫生署(FEHD)报告蚊虫问题。

5 October 2026 • In Focus Is Bangladesh prepared for the next food shock? 4 October 2026 • Big Picture Can Bangladesh capitalise on the Bay of Bengal’s strategic rise? 4 October 2026 • Geopolitical Insights Chikungunya resurfaces, adds to health woes IEDCR detects 337 suspected cases in January-May Updated : 19 June 2025, 05:59 • BANGLADESH SHARE Tuhin Shubhra Adhikary Helemul Alam Tuhin Shubhra Adhikary and Helemul Alam Chikungunya is feared to be a potential future pandemic threat as climate change pushes the mosquitoes that spread it into new areas. Photo: AFP file As the country grapples with rising cases of coronavirus and mosquito-borne dengue, there has been a resurgence of another mosquito-borne disease, Chikungunya, in Dhaka. From January 1 to May 28, at least 337 suspected Chikungunya cases were reported. Of these, 153 cases were confirmed by RT-PCR tests, says a recent report of the Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR). Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source The viral disease, transmitted by virus-bearing Aedes mosquitoes, causes sudden fever, severe joint pain, intense headache, muscle pain, and rash. Since the numbers of dengue and Covid-19 cases have been rising for weeks, more Chikungunya cases could place a significant burden on the healthcare system, public health experts warn. IEDCR, in its report published early this month, said: "A notable increase in both suspected and confirmed cases has been recorded since the second week of April, indicating rising transmission in multiple urban areas." The affected areas are: Mohakhali, Tejgaon, Nakhalpara, Khilkhet, Niketon, Mohammadpur, Dhanmondi, Uttara, Lalbag, Azimpur, Hazaribag, Shantinagar, Malibagh, Khilgaon, Mugda, Goran, Rampura and Shahjahanpur. "Cases have been reported from both Dhaka North and South City Corporations, reflecting widespread urban transmission," reads the report. Given the absence of a routine national surveillance system for Chikungunya, limited diagnostic capacity, and the clinical overlap with dengue, the reported numbers likely underestimate the scale of infections, it adds. Thousands of people travelled across the country during the Eid vacation and that may end up further spreading the disease, it reads. The IEDCR recommends that healthcare providers remain watchful for Chikungunya symptoms and prioritise testing for the disease. It also calls for intensifying public awareness campaigns on mosquito control and personal protection measures, expanding surveillance activities to identify new hotspots, and taking preventive measures to avoid mosquito bites. The first confirmed cases of Chikungunya were reported in Rajshahi and Chapainawabganj in 2008. In 2011, some cases were reported in Dhaka's Dohar upazila; and in 2017, a major outbreak occurred, affecting Dhaka and 16 other districts, according to IEDCR data. Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya are transmitted by the same Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, and symptoms of these diseases are often similar, it says. The mosquitoes typically breed in clear, stagnant water, putting people living near such breeding spots at greater risks. IEDCR Director Prof Tahmina Shirin said an outbreak of such a disease was usually likely to recur after a gap. "Last year, only a few cases were reported in October, but this time, significant numbers are being observed. The current trend indicates that the numbers may increase further," she told The Daily Star yesterday. HM Nazmul Ahsan, an associate professor at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, said, Covid-19 patients often report loss of smell and mild diarrhoea along with fever and cold while a fever without cold may mean dengue or Chikungunya. "Since most Chikungunya patients do not require hospitalisation, these cases often go undetected," he added. Chikungunya symptoms include joint pain that can last for a week. It may leave patients unable to stand, he said. In contrast, dengue typically causes muscle pain that subsides within seven days. Since Chikungunya testing is not widely available, patients who test negative for dengue are observed for several days. If symptoms persist, physicians may treat them as Chikungunya patients. For all latest news, follow The Daily Star's Google News channel. "Anyone with a fever should see a doctor immediately and stay hydrated. Coconut water, saline, and fresh fruit juices may help," Nazmul said. According to public health expert Mushtuq Hussain, the authorities should launch a tiered healthcare system comprising clear primary, secondary, and tertiary care levels. "A stronger primary healthcare network is crucial. Many people, particularly in underprivileged areas, avoid dengue testing due to lack of access to local facilities, which leads to delayed diagnoses," he said. He proposed expansion of blood sample collection centres and secondary care units to manage moderate cases, allowing medical college hospitals to focus on critical patients. Serious cases should be transferred from secondary to tertiary hospitals as needed, Mushtuq said. According to the IEDCR, there is no specific cure for Chikungunya. Infected individuals are advised to take rest, and take medication prescribed by a doctor, it said. Photo: AFP file As the country grapples with rising cases of coronavirus and mosquito-borne dengue, there has been a resurgence of another mosquito-borne disease, Chikungunya, in Dhaka. From January 1 to May 28, at least 337 suspected Chikungunya cases were reported. Of these, 153 cases were confirmed by RT-PCR tests, says a recent report of the Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR). Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source The viral disease, transmitted by virus-bearing Aedes mosquitoes, causes sudden fever, severe joint pain, intense headache, muscle pain, and rash. Since the numbers of dengue and Covid-19 cases have been rising for weeks, more Chikungunya cases could place a significant burden on the healthcare system, public health experts warn. IEDCR, in its report published early this month, said: "A notable increase in both suspected and confirmed cases has been recorded since the second week of April, indicating rising transmission in multiple urban areas." The affected areas are: Mohakhali, Tejgaon, Nakhalpara, Khilkhet, Niketon, Mohammadpur, Dhanmondi, Uttara, Lalbag, Azimpur, Hazaribag, Shantinagar, Malibagh, Khilgaon, Mugda, Goran, Rampura and Shahjahanpur. "Cases have been reported from both Dhaka North and South City Corporations, reflecting widespread urban transmission," reads the report. Given the absence of a routine national surveillance system for Chikungunya, limited diagnostic capacity, and the clinical overlap with dengue, the reported numbers likely underestimate the scale of infections, it adds. Thousands of people travelled across the country during the Eid vacation and that may end up further spreading the disease, it reads. The IEDCR recommends that healthcare providers remain watchful for Chikungunya symptoms and prioritise testing for the disease. It also calls for intensifying public awareness campaigns on mosquito control and personal protection measures, expanding surveillance activities to identify new hotspots, and taking preventive measures to avoid mosquito bites. The first confirmed cases of Chikungunya were reported in Rajshahi and Chapainawabganj in 2008. In 2011, some cases were reported in Dhaka's Dohar upazila; and in 2017, a major outbreak occurred, affecting Dhaka and 16 other districts, according to IEDCR data. Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya are transmitted by the same Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, and symptoms of these diseases are often similar, it says. The mosquitoes typically breed in clear, stagnant water, putting people living near such breeding spots at greater risks. IEDCR Director Prof Tahmina Shirin said an outbreak of such a disease was usually likely to recur after a gap. "Last year, only a few cases were reported in October, but this time, significant numbers are being observed. The current trend indicates that the numbers may increase further," she told The Daily Star yesterday. HM Nazmul Ahsan, an associate professor at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, said, Covid-19 patients often report loss of smell and mild diarrhoea along with fever and cold while a fever without cold may mean dengue or Chikungunya. "Since most Chikungunya patients do not require hospitalisation, these cases often go undetected," he added. Chikungunya symptoms include joint pain that can last for a week. It may leave patients unable to stand, he said. In contrast, dengue typically causes muscle pain that subsides within seven days. Since Chikungunya testing is not widely available, patients who test negative for dengue are observed for several days. If symptoms persist, physicians may treat them as Chikungunya patients. For all latest news, follow The Daily Star's Google News channel. "Anyone with a fever should see a doctor immediately and stay hydrated. Coconut water, saline, and fresh fruit juices may help," Nazmul said. According to public health expert Mushtuq Hussain, the authorities should launch a tiered healthcare system comprising clear primary, secondary, and tertiary care levels. "A stronger primary healthcare network is crucial. Many people, particularly in underprivileged areas, avoid dengue testing due to lack of access to local facilities, which leads to delayed diagnoses," he said. He proposed expansion of blood sample collection centres and secondary care units to manage moderate cases, allowing medical college hospitals to focus on critical patients. Serious cases should be transferred from secondary to tertiary hospitals as needed, Mushtuq said. According to the IEDCR, there is no specific cure for Chikungunya. Infected individuals are advised to take rest, and take medication prescribed by a doctor, it said. news.content_zh: 基孔肯雅热在孟加拉国再度爆发,加剧了现有的健康挑战。2026年1月1日至5月28日,至少报告了337例疑似病例,其中153例通过RT-PCR检测确认。孟加拉国疾病控制与研究中心(IEDCR)指出,自2026年4月起,该疾病已在多个城市地区传播,包括达卡的北达卡市和南达卡市。公共卫生专家警告称,缺乏全国性的监测系统和有限的诊断能力可能导致病例漏报。该疾病的症状包括突发高热、严重关节痛和皮疹,常与登革热重叠,使得诊断变得复杂。IEDCR建议扩大监测,加强公众对蚊虫控制的意识,并实施分级医疗体系以有效管理病例。此次再度爆发被认为与气候变化和蚊虫活动增加有关,同时存在未来可能引发大流行的风险。目前情况仍在调查中,呼吁采取预防措施以避免蚊虫叮咬。

Los casos se distribuyen en seis regiones: Hérault (1 caso), Var (1 caso), Gard (1 caso), Drôme (1 caso), Bouches-du-Rhône (2 casos) y Corse-du-Sud (2 casos). Todos los brotes están activos. 🔄 Hemos actualizado [...] Leptospirosis en Ecuador Se observa un incremento de casos de leptospirosis en Ecuador durante 2025. A nivel nacional, se han registrado 771 casos, la cifra más alta de los últimos cinco años. La provincia del Guayas lidera en contagios, seguida por Zamora Chinchipe, con 75 casos en las primeras 23 semanas del año, y Loja, con 15 casos. [...] Meningitis en África – Semana 23 de 2025 (OMS / WHO AFRO) Durante la primera semana de junio (semana epidemiológica 23), se notificaron 256 casos sospechosos de meningitis y 13 muertes en la región africana, con una tasa de letalidad del 5,1%. Aunque ningún distrito está actualmente en situación de epidemia, sí se mantienen varios en fase de alerta, especialmente en Níger, República Democrática del Congo (RDC) [...] Alerta por Chikungunya para viajeros a Sri Lanka El 18 de marzo de 2025 se notificó un caso de infección por virus chikungunya en una viajera alemana tras su regreso de Sri Lanka. Previemente autoridades locales habían alertado de aumento de casos en el país. La paciente presentó fiebre alta y artralgias persistentes, síntomas característicos de esta enfermedad viral transmitida por mosquitos. Este [...] Brote de Chikungunya en isla Reunión Aumento significativo de casos de Chikungunya en isla Reunión (Francia) con 1766 nuevos casos la semana pasada, un 18% más que la semana anterior. En total, se han registrado 5041 casos en 2025. El 72% de los casos desde agosto de 2024 se concentran en los municipios del sur. El chikungunya es una enfermedad viral transmitida por mosquitos Aedes infectados, que provoca síntomas [...] Recomendación para viajeros: Brote de sarampión en Texas, EE.UU. El Departamento de Servicios de Salud del Estado de Texas, EEUU, reporta un brote de sarampión en la región de South Plains, Texas. Desde finales de enero se han identificado 223 casos, 29 de los cuales han requerido hospitalización. Se ha registrado una muerte en un niño en edad escolar no vacunado. Debido a la alta contagiosidad del sarampión, se esperan [...]

analysis.event: Chikungunya virus outbreaks were reported in France continental, with eight locally acquired cases from 2025. A significant increase in cases was observed in the island of Reunión (France) with 1766 new cases reported the previous week (N1, N11).

analysis.brief_en: The news report highlights the ongoing Chikungunya virus outbreaks in France continental, with eight locally acquired cases reported from the beginning of 2025 to June 25, 2025. The virus is active in multiple regions, including Hérault, Var, Gard, Drôme, Bouches-du-Rhône, and Corse-du-Sud. A significant surge in cases was observed in the island of Reunión (France), where 1766 new cases were reported the previous week, marking an 18% increase compared to the prior week. As of 2025, a total of 5041 cases have been documented in France, with 72% concentrated in southern municipalities. The report also mentions a German traveler who contracted Chikungunya in Sri Lanka, presenting with high fever and persistent arthritis. While no districts are in an epidemic state, several are under alert, particularly in Niger and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak is linked to the virus being transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, and authorities have issued warnings for travelers. No specific response measures are detailed in the evidence.

Ski de randonnée Plans des pistes Cols mythiques Bulletin neige Code promo Intersport Code promo Ekosport Code promo sport & loisirs Mentions légales A propos de l'auteur NEWSLETTER SPORTS-INFOS.FR · L'essentiel du sport, chaque semaine. · ⛷️ SKI 🎯 BIATHLON 🎾 TENNIS 🏃 RUNNING 🌲 TRAIL 🚴 CYCLISME · 📩 S'INSCRIRE ✕ NEWSLETTER SPORTS-INFOS.FR · L'essentiel du sport, chaque semaine. · ⛷️ SKI 🎯 BIATHLON 🎾 TENNIS 🏃 RUNNING 🌲 TRAIL 🚴 CYCLISME 📩 S'INSCRIRE ✕ Menu principal Biathlon Ski Alpin Ski de Fond Stations Tennis Football Autres Sports Outdoor Randonnée Portraits Webcams Guides d'achat Résultats (LIVE) Codes promo Photo : Agence Zoom Sofia Goggia très affaiblie par le virus du chikungunya Par Mirko Hominal✅ le 04/10/2026 Partager Ad ⛷️ Ski Alpin·Italie — Sofia Goggia Sofia Goggia ne sait pas encore quand elle pourra lancer sa saison de Coupe du monde. Numéro 1 mondiale du super-G l'hiver dernier, l'Italienne a vu sa préparation sérieusement perturbée par deux virus, dont le chikungunya, comme elle l'a expliqué samedi soir lors d'un événement organisé par la Gazzetta dello Sport. -40% ⚡ Vente Flash SKI 2026-27 Jusqu'au 18 Octobre Séjours Ski Tout Compris : jusqu'à -40% Profitez de l'offre flash de la saison : Matériel de ski à 1€ (dès 4 nuits), formule All Inclusive et paiement en 3x sans frais. « Je ne peux pas faire de plan » Quadruple lauréate de la Coupe du monde de descente, médaillée de bronze de la descente des Jeux de Milano-Cortina, Goggia avait dû écourter cet été son stage d'entraînement en Amérique du Sud pour rentrer en Italie. Elle reste aujourd'hui dans l'incertitude quant à son calendrier. « Je ne peux pas faire de plan, car j'ai besoin de temps pour sortir des conséquences des virus. » Sofia Goggia Des douleurs articulaires « étranges » en Argentine La championne olympique de descente 2018 est revenue sur l'apparition des symptômes. Elle a d'abord ressenti de fortes douleurs articulaires, inhabituelles, avant que les médecins, à son retour en Italie, ne finissent par identifier une piqûre de moustique infecté. « J'ai commencé à ressentir des douleurs articulaires particulièrement fortes, intenses et étranges (...) Je n'arrivais pas à monter les escaliers. » — Sofia Goggia 🏃 MATÉRIEL RUNNING & TRAIL⏳ jusqu'au 11/10 -10% EXTRA sur TOUT LE SITE EKOSPORT Préparez vos prochaines courses et profitez de réductions exceptionnelles sur les chaussures de running, le trail et l'équipement outdoor. CODE PROMO EKO10📋 J'en profite Chikungunya, puis parvovirus B19 Les examens ont révélé que Goggia avait contracté le chikungunya, suivi, dans son sillage, d'une infection au parvovirus B19, un virus rare chez l'adulte qui touche habituellement de jeunes enfants. « J'ai contracté le virus du chikungunya, et dans le sillage de ce virus, j'ai aussi contracté le parvovirus B19, qui est un virus vraiment peu courant chez les adultes, parce qu'en général il n'atteint que les jeunes enfants, mais il provoque tous ces symptômes neurologiques et ces fortes douleurs articulaires, cette sensation de grande fatigue. » Sofia Goggia « Je dois laisser le temps au temps » Sans traitement disponible, la skieuse aux 29 victoires en Coupe du monde dit avoir dépassé la phase aiguë mais subir encore de nombreuses séquelles, avec des journées qui alternent entre mieux-être et grande fatigue. « Il n'y a pas de traitement, j'attends que ça passe. J'ai dépassé la phase aiguë, je suis dans la phase résiduelle mais cela me laisse beaucoup de séquelles. Il y a des jours où je vais mieux, et d'autres où je me lève et je me sens complètement à plat. Je dois laisser le temps au temps. » — Sofia Goggia 📖 À lire aussi Lire une carte IGN : courbes de niveau, échelle, symboles03/10/2026 Hypothermie en montagne : signes, gestes et prévention03/10/2026 Randonner avec des enfants en montagne : nos conseils03/10/2026 Batons de randonnée : bien les choisir et les régler02/10/2026 Echauffement spécifique avant le ski : début de saison01/10/2026 Randonnée à la journée : que mettre dans son sac à dos ?30/09/2026 Crampes musculaires : causes réelles et prévention30/09/2026 Alerter les secours en montagne : les bons réflexes29/09/2026 --> Hold inne ctrl-tasten og trykk + for å skalere opp, - for å skalere ned

news.content_zh: 意大利高山滑雪运动员索菲亚·戈奇亚(Sofia Goggia)因基孔肯雅病毒而显著虚弱,据ski-nordique.net于2026年03月10日报道。该病毒是在她2026年9月下旬在南美洲训练期间感染的,导致严重的关节痛、神经症状和疲劳。她表示,感染给她留下了许多后遗症,每天都在感觉好转和经历剧烈疲劳之间交替。此前排名世界超级大回转项目第一的戈奇亚不得不缩短训练时间,且不确定她即将参加的赛季能否继续。此外,还检测出副黏病毒B19作为继发感染,这种病毒在成人中较为罕见。目前尚无针对基孔肯雅病毒的可用治疗,她正在等待症状缓解。该报告突出了该病毒对她的运动表现和健康的影响,但未提供具体病例或死亡人数的数据。

Sofia Goggia, 33 anni Two viruses and a condition that varies from day to day, due to the aftermath of the infections: Sofia Goggia , a guest at the Trento Sports Festival a few weeks before the start of the World Cup, explained what's been happening to her in recent weeks, which forced her to return early from Argentina. Goggia, still weakened, can't plan her days precisely: "In Ushuaia, Argentina, I started experiencing strong and strange joint pain, weakness in my legs, and tremors. I couldn't climb stairs, and I felt abnormally tired and exhausted. I realized something was wrong when walking. I hadn't felt well since July, and I thought it was the heat this summer, combined with the overload," she said. It wasn't like that: "When I returned to Italy, they diagnosed me with the chikungunya virus , and on the tail end of that virus I also contracted parvovirus B19 , which is uncommon in adults and causes all the neurological symptoms, including severe joint pain and a feeling of exhaustion. Everything I've had coincides with these two viruses." And now? "I've gotten over the acute phase, but the tail end is leaving me with a lot of after-effects. I have no control over it; I have to wait for it to pass." Continua a leggere tutte le notizie di sport su

news.title_zh: 博尔戈马诺本地人已从基孔肯雅热和细小病毒B19中康复:"这是一个我无法控制的情况,我仍然有很多后遗症。" 戈奇亚行动缓慢:"我难以爬楼梯。" - 《每日体育报》
news.source_body_en: The article reports on Sofia Goggia, a 33-year-old native of Bergamo, Italy, who has recovered from chikungunya and parvovirus B19. She described her experience with the after-effects of these infections, including joint pain, weakness, and exhaustion, which have made it difficult for her to plan her days. Goggia mentioned that she first noticed symptoms while in Argentina, where she was a guest at the Trento Sports Festival. She explained that she had not felt well since July, initially attributing it to the heat and workload. However, upon returning to Italy, she was diagnosed with chikungunya virus, and later contracted parvovirus B19, which is uncommon in adults and causes neurological symptoms. Goggia stated that she has overcome the acute phase but is still dealing with lingering effects that she cannot control. The report does not provide any public health data or statistics related to the spread or impact of these viruses.
news.content_zh: 本文报道了意大利博尔戈马诺本地人索菲亚·戈奇亚(33岁)已从基孔肯雅热和细小病毒B19中康复。她描述了这两种感染后的后遗症,包括关节痛、乏力和极度疲劳,这些症状使她难以规划自己的日常生活。戈奇亚提到,她最初在阿根廷参加特伦托体育节期间注意到症状。她解释说,自7月以来她一直感觉不适,最初归咎于炎热和工作量。然而,回到意大利后,她被诊断出患有基孔肯雅病毒,并随后感染了细小病毒B19,这种病毒在成人中较为罕见,会引起神经系统症状。戈奇亚表示,她已经度过了急性期,但仍面临无法控制的后遗症。该报告未提供与这两种病毒传播或影响相关的任何公共卫生数据或统计信息。

chikungunya outbreaks in Reunion Island and Paraguay: a mathematical modelling study 【字体: 大 中 小 】 时间:2026年10月04日 来源:The Lancet Planetary Health 20.5 编辑推荐: 背景:细空间尺度下个体对伊蚊(Aedes)暴露风险存在显著异质性,但虫媒病毒(arbovirus)传播模型常忽略该特征,尤其不利于实时预测。研究人员旨在评估在传播模型中纳入蚊媒暴露异质性,是否能更好复现历史基孔肯雅热(chikungunya)暴发并提升正在进行 瑞孚迪自动化解决方案>> 为了促进科学的传播,生物通采集了这篇文章 订阅BioHot点这里解锁原文链接推送! “畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接 Open access 背景:细空间尺度下个体对伊蚊(Aedes)暴露风险存在显著异质性,但虫媒病毒(arbovirus)传播模型常忽略该特征,尤其不利于实时预测。研究人员旨在评估在传播模型中纳入蚊媒暴露异质性,是否能更好复现历史基孔肯雅热(chikungunya)暴发并提升正在进行暴发的实时预测能力。 方法:研究人员在原有含季节性因素的登革热预测模型基础上,加入蚊媒暴露异质性,相对个体暴露服从对数正态 LN(μlog=1, σlog) 分布;比较该模型与同质暴露模型对2005–06年留尼汪岛(Reunion Island)暴发、2023年巴拉圭Metropolitana次区域暴发的拟合能力,并用异质性模型对2025年留尼汪岛暴发进行实时预测。 结果:在2005–06年留尼汪岛暴发中,同质模型终末血清阳性率(seroprevalence)约80%,而观察值为38%;干预模型虽可拟合,但需R0下降约50%,难以解释。异质性模型估计σlog≈1.2,可准确复现暴发规模。该异质性水平迁移至Metropolitana暴发时,准确预测流行曲线与终末血清阳性率约40%,而同质模型约75%。2025年留尼汪岛暴发中,异质性模型提前近两个月预测急诊就诊峰值约400例/周、峰期在4月;事后血清调查示观察血清阳性率61.6%,异质性模型低估为46.1%,同质模型高估为78.5%,提示2025年暴露异质性可能低于2005–06年。 结论:将细尺度蚊媒暴露异质性纳入虫媒病毒传播模型,可改善基孔肯雅热暴发规模与时机预测,对气候季节性地区公共卫生预警具有重要价值。 研究背景方面,基孔肯雅热由基孔肯雅病毒(chikungunya virus, CHIKV)引起,经伊蚊(Aedes)传播,可造成发热、关节痛及慢性后遗症。虫媒病毒(arbovirus)传播受气候、环境和宿主行为共同影响,而在相邻社区甚至邻里之间,蚊媒叮咬暴露存在很强异质性,这种细空间尺度风险差异常由住房条件、户外暴露、驱避剂使用、纱窗安装和风险意识等行为与环境结构因素塑造。现有多数数学模型采用大尺度斑块(patch)结构或同质混合假设,忽视个体级暴露异质性,导致对最终感染规模、基本再生数(basic reproduction number, R0)和干预效果的误判,也不利于在报告不全情况下的实时预测。随着气候变化使伊蚊栖息地扩张、卫生不平等持续存在,亟需一种简洁、可迁移、适合实时决策的框架来提高基孔肯雅热及其他虫媒病毒暴发预测能力。 欢迎领取“抗体偶联药物前沿研发方案”领 取 研究人员在原有用于留尼汪岛登革热预测的气候驱动SIR类模型基础上,构建了异质性模型:人群按相对蚊媒暴露分为10个等规模组,相对暴露服从对数正态分布 LN(μlog=1, σlog),由分位数确定各组被蚊媒叮咬比例,并通过矩阵 Cjj’=pjpj’ 刻画风险组间传播。研究人员用该框架复现2005–06年留尼汪岛暴发、回顾性验证2023年巴拉圭Metropolitana次区域暴发,并对2025年留尼汪岛暴发做实时预测。论文发表于《The Lancet Planetary Health》。 主要关键技术方法上,研究人员使用留尼汪岛2005–06年每周病例与终末血清调查、2025年急诊就诊和哨点医生估算及事后血清调查,以及巴拉圭Metropolitana血液供体血清调查与周病例数据;以温度或温湿气候标度函数驱动传播,设生成时间(generation time, GT)为10、15、20天,R0=β0GT;用Poisson和Binomial似然校准,马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛(MCMC)估计参数,odin/R实现,并以不同报告比例情景处理监测不确定性。 研究结果部分,2005–06年和2025年留尼汪岛暴发研究显示,同质模型把终末血清阳性率估到约80%,与观察值38%严重偏离;干预模型虽拟合终末血清阳性率,却要求R0降至R0intervention约1,降幅约50%–60%,在实地病媒控制强度下难以置信。异质性模型估计σlog约1.2,各暴露组终末感染率从低于10%到高于90%不等,与IRIS级细尺度血清阳性率差异吻合。 Metropolitana暴发研究中,直接移植σlog=1.2的异质性模型准确预测峰期和终末血清阳性率约40%;同质模型则高估峰规模并将峰值推到2月中下旬。用全部数据拟合该地数据得到σlog=1.04(95% CrI 0.74–1.30),与留尼汪岛估计相近,报告比例约10.3%。 2025年留尼汪岛暴发预测研究中,截至3月初,异质性模型预测全岛急诊峰值约400例/周、峰期在4月第16周,结果对报告比例假设稳健;同质模型仅在报告比例25%时勉强合理,高报告比例下峰值可估至约1250例/周。事后全岛观察血清阳性率为61.6%(95% CI 59.3–64.0),次区域为北部53.5%、西部68.7%、南部64.6%、东部55.5%;异质性模型低估终末血清阳性率,同质模型高估至78.5%。亚区域模型显示南部更早达峰,其他次区域约4月中旬达峰,汇总后与全岛模型动态一致但可信区间更宽。事后校准显示2025年σlog低于1.2且次区域间不一,说明当年暴露异质性减弱但未消失。 讨论部分总结,细尺度蚊媒暴露异质性是复现和预测基孔肯雅热暴发的关键;σlog可概括本地邻里级风险差异,与伊蚊短距离扩散一致。2005–06年留尼汪岛估计的σlog=1.2能跨环境迁移至Metropolitana,说明某些环境中个体级暴露异质性可能存在稳定结构。2025年异质性下降可能源于白纹伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)扩散、住房与病媒控制改善,或既往高暴露人群已被选择性感染从而改变免疫结构。气候标度函数虽能捕捉季节驱动,但因温度与降水信号平滑且高度相关,不能据此断言单一气候因子作用。急诊数据时效最好,多元监测对实时建模至关重要。局限包括异质性水平跨时段固定、病例数据下σlog与报告比例不可完全辨识、模型不区分异质性具体机制、短时序参数不确定,以及2025年血清调查可能存在就医者过代表征。 结论部分译为:本研究显示,在细空间尺度纳入蚊媒暴露异质性可改进基孔肯雅热暴发建模与预测。该异质性对复现2005–06年留尼汪岛暴发至关重要,其估计水平成功迁移至Metropolitana暴发,并在约两个月前预测出2025年留尼汪岛暴发的峰期与规模,尽管终末血清阳性率被低估。随着虫媒病毒传播在气候变化与健康不平等背景下扩张,这类工具对支持高危地区公共卫生决策将愈发重要。 打赏 展开全文 开通VIP “畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接 Open access 背景:细空间尺度下个体对伊蚊(Aedes)暴露风险存在显著异质性,但虫媒病毒(arbovirus)传播模型常忽略该特征,尤其不利于实时预测。研究人员旨在评估在传播模型中纳入蚊媒暴露异质性,是否能更好复现历史基孔肯雅热(chikungunya)暴发并提升正在进行暴发的实时预测能力。 方法:研究人员在原有含季节性因素的登革热预测模型基础上,加入蚊媒暴露异质性,相对个体暴露服从对数正态 LN(μlog=1, σlog) 分布;比较该模型与同质暴露模型对2005–06年留尼汪岛(Reunion Island)暴发、2023年巴拉圭Metropolitana次区域暴发的拟合能力,并用异质性模型对2025年留尼汪岛暴发进行实时预测。 结果:在2005–06年留尼汪岛暴发中,同质模型终末血清阳性率(seroprevalence)约80%,而观察值为38%;干预模型虽可拟合,但需R0下降约50%,难以解释。异质性模型估计σlog≈1.2,可准确复现暴发规模。该异质性水平迁移至Metropolitana暴发时,准确预测流行曲线与终末血清阳性率约40%,而同质模型约75%。2025年留尼汪岛暴发中,异质性模型提前近两个月预测急诊就诊峰值约400例/周、峰期在4月;事后血清调查示观察血清阳性率61.6%,异质性模型低估为46.1%,同质模型高估为78.5%,提示2025年暴露异质性可能低于2005–06年。 结论:将细尺度蚊媒暴露异质性纳入虫媒病毒传播模型,可改善基孔肯雅热暴发规模与时机预测,对气候季节性地区公共卫生预警具有重要价值。 研究背景方面,基孔肯雅热由基孔肯雅病毒(chikungunya virus, CHIKV)引起,经伊蚊(Aedes)传播,可造成发热、关节痛及慢性后遗症。虫媒病毒(arbovirus)传播受气候、环境和宿主行为共同影响,而在相邻社区甚至邻里之间,蚊媒叮咬暴露存在很强异质性,这种细空间尺度风险差异常由住房条件、户外暴露、驱避剂使用、纱窗安装和风险意识等行为与环境结构因素塑造。现有多数数学模型采用大尺度斑块(patch)结构或同质混合假设,忽视个体级暴露异质性,导致对最终感染规模、基本再生数(basic reproduction number, R0)和干预效果的误判,也不利于在报告不全情况下的实时预测。随着气候变化使伊蚊栖息地扩张、卫生不平等持续存在,亟需一种简洁、可迁移、适合实时决策的框架来提高基孔肯雅热及其他虫媒病毒暴发预测能力。 欢迎领取“抗体偶联药物前沿研发方案”领 取 研究人员在原有用于留尼汪岛登革热预测的气候驱动SIR类模型基础上,构建了异质性模型:人群按相对蚊媒暴露分为10个等规模组,相对暴露服从对数正态分布 LN(μlog=1, σlog),由分位数确定各组被蚊媒叮咬比例,并通过矩阵 Cjj’=pjpj’ 刻画风险组间传播。研究人员用该框架复现2005–06年留尼汪岛暴发、回顾性验证2023年巴拉圭Metropolitana次区域暴发,并对2025年留尼汪岛暴发做实时预测。论文发表于《The Lancet Planetary Health》。 主要关键技术方法上,研究人员使用留尼汪岛2005–06年每周病例与终末血清调查、2025年急诊就诊和哨点医生估算及事后血清调查,以及巴拉圭Metropolitana血液供体血清调查与周病例数据;以温度或温湿气候标度函数驱动传播,设生成时间(generation time, GT)为10、15、20天,R0=β0GT;用Poisson和Binomial似然校准,马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛(MCMC)估计参数,odin/R实现,并以不同报告比例情景处理监测不确定性。 研究结果部分,2005–06年和2025年留尼汪岛暴发研究显示,同质模型把终末血清阳性率估到约80%,与观察值38%严重偏离;干预模型虽拟合终末血清阳性率,却要求R0降至R0intervention约1,降幅约50%–60%,在实地病媒控制强度下难以置信。异质性模型估计σlog约1.2,各暴露组终末感染率从低于10%到高于90%不等,与IRIS级细尺度血清阳性率差异吻合。 Metropolitana暴发研究中,直接移植σlog=1.2的异质性模型准确预测峰期和终末血清阳性率约40%;同质模型则高估峰规模并将峰值推到2月中下旬。用全部数据拟合该地数据得到σlog=1.04(95% CrI 0.74–1.30),与留尼汪岛估计相近,报告比例约10.3%。 2025年留尼汪岛暴发预测研究中,截至3月初,异质性模型预测全岛急诊峰值约400例/周、峰期在4月第16周,结果对报告比例假设稳健;同质模型仅在报告比例25%时勉强合理,高报告比例下峰值可估至约1250例/周。事后全岛观察血清阳性率为61.6%(95% CI 59.3–64.0),次区域为北部53.5%、西部68.7%、南部64.6%、东部55.5%;异质性模型低估终末血清阳性率,同质模型高估至78.5%。亚区域模型显示南部更早达峰,其他次区域约4月中旬达峰,汇总后与全岛模型动态一致但可信区间更宽。事后校准显示2025年σlog低于1.2且次区域间不一,说明当年暴露异质性减弱但未消失。 analysis.location_and_population: Reunion Island and Paraguay (Metropolitana sub-region), with focus on 2005–06 and 2025 outbreaks.
analysis.event: A mathematical modeling study was conducted to assess the impact of mosquito exposure heterogeneity on chikungunya outbreaks in Reunion Island and Paraguay. The study compared homogeneous and heterogeneous exposure models to predict outbreak dynamics.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: In the 2005–06 Reunion Island outbreak, the homogeneous model overestimated seroprevalence at 80% compared to the observed 38%. In the 2023 Paraguay Metropolitana outbreak, the heterogeneous model accurately predicted the peak and seroprevalence of ~40%, while the homogeneous model overestimated the peak scale. For the 2025 Reunion Island outbreak, the heterogeneous model predicted an emergency department peak of ~400 cases/week, with a peak in April, but underestimated the final seroprevalence at 46.1% compared to the observed 61.6%.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study was published in The Lancet Planetary Health. The heterogeneous model was used to predict the 2025 outbreak, and the results were validated with post-outbreak seroprevalence data. However, the study acknowledges limitations, including fixed heterogeneity levels across time, uncertainty in distinguishing heterogeneity mechanisms, and potential biases in reporting.

analysis.brief_en: This study, published in The Lancet Planetary Health on October 4, 2026, explores the role of mosquito exposure heterogeneity in predicting chikungunya outbreaks. Researchers developed a mathematical model that incorporates fine-scale exposure differences, using data from Reunion Island and Paraguay's Metropolitana sub-region. The model was tested against historical outbreaks, including the 2005–06 Reunion Island and 2023 Paraguay Metropolitana events. In the 2005–06 outbreak, the homogeneous model overestimated seroprevalence at 80%, while the heterogeneous model accurately captured the observed 38%. For the 2025 Reunion Island outbreak, the heterogeneous model predicted an emergency department peak of ~400 cases/week in April, but underestimated the final seroprevalence at 46.1% compared to the observed 61.6%. The study highlights the importance of incorporating fine-scale exposure patterns into outbreak prediction models, especially in climate-sensitive regions. However, it notes limitations such as fixed heterogeneity assumptions and potential reporting biases.

news.title_zh: 蚊媒暴露异质性驱动下的基孔肯雅热暴发预测:留尼汪岛与巴拉圭数学模型研究 - 生物通
news.source_body_en: This study, published in The Lancet Planetary Health on October 4, 2026, explores the role of mosquito exposure heterogeneity in predicting chikungunya outbreaks. Researchers developed a mathematical model that incorporates fine-scale exposure differences, using data from Reunion Island and Paraguay's Metropolitana sub-region. The model was tested against historical outbreaks, including the 2005–06 Reunion Island and 2023 Paraguay Metropolitana events. In the 2005–06 outbreak, the homogeneous model overestimated seroprevalence at 80%, while the heterogeneous model accurately captured the observed 38%. For the 2025 Reunion Island outbreak, the heterogeneous model predicted an emergency department peak of ~400 cases/week in April, but underestimated the final seroprevalence at 46.1% compared to the observed 61.6%. The study highlights the importance of incorporating fine-scale exposure patterns into outbreak prediction models, especially in climate-sensitive regions. However, it notes limitations such as fixed heterogeneity assumptions and potential reporting biases.
news.content_zh: 这项研究于2026年10月4日发表在《柳叶刀·行星健康》上,探讨了蚊虫暴露异质性在预测基孔肯雅热暴发中的作用。研究人员开发了一个数学模型,该模型结合了细尺度暴露差异,使用了留尼汪岛和巴拉圭的Metropolitana次区域的数据。该模型被测试用于历史暴发数据,包括2005–06年留尼汪岛和2023年巴拉圭Metropolitana次区域的事件。在2005–06年留尼汪岛的暴发中,同质模型对发病率的预测高估了80%,而异质模型准确捕捉了观察到的38%。对于2025年留尼汪岛的暴发,异质模型预测了4月急诊部门病例数的峰值约为每周400例,但对最终发病率低估了46.1%,与观察到的61.6%相比。该研究强调了在气候敏感地区,将细尺度暴露模式纳入暴发预测模型的重要性。然而,它也指出了一些局限性,例如异质性的固定假设以及潜在的报告偏差。

Across the Hawaiian Islands, where the species has become firmly established, public health planners are increasingly looking toward biological control strategies that exploit a common bacterial symbiont called Wolbachia. A new study published in the journal Parasites & Vectors has now provided the most detailed picture yet of how Wolbachia naturally infects Aedes albopictus populations on two Hawaiian islands, and the results reveal patterns that are more complicated than researchers expected. Wolbachia is an intracellular bacterium that manipulates the reproduction of its insect hosts, most famously through a phenomenon known as cytoplasmic incompatibility. When males carrying a particular Wolbachia strain mate with females that either lack that strain or carry a different one, their fertilized eggs fail to hatch. This quirk of reproductive biology has become the foundation of several mosquito control approaches, including the incompatible insect technique, in which large numbers of Wolbachia-carrying male mosquitoes are released to mate with wild females and crash the population. Wolbachia also has pathogen-blocking properties, meaning it can interfere with the ability of mosquitoes to transmit viruses such as dengue, which underlies replacement strategies that spread virus-resistant Wolbachia strains through wild populations. Unlike Aedes aegypti, the yellow fever mosquito, which does not naturally harbor Wolbachia, Aedes albopictus carries two native strains of the bacterium, designated wAlbA and wAlbB. In most populations studied elsewhere, individuals are superinfected, meaning they carry both strains simultaneously. This natural dual infection matters enormously for control programs because the outcome of any cytoplasmic incompatibility-based intervention depends on which strains are already circulating in the target population. If wild mosquitoes carry unexpected combinations of strains, or if the density of the bacteria in their tissues varies in unanticipated ways, releases of incompatible males may fail to suppress reproduction as intended. Discover more Parasites & Parasitic Diseases Infectious Diseases Pest Control Graphic Design Visual Art & Design Despite the global importance of these questions, the infection status of Hawaiian Aedes albopictus had remained poorly characterized. A research team led by Sangwoo Seok and senior authors Eric P. Caragata and Yoosook Lee of the Florida Medical Entomology Laboratory at the University of Florida, working with collaborators from state and federal agencies in Hawaiʻi and the University of California, set out to fill this gap. Using quantitative PCR, a laboratory technique that can detect and precisely quantify the amount of bacterial DNA in an individual mosquito, the team characterized Wolbachia infections in 399 specimens collected from two islands: Oʻahu and the Island of Hawaiʻi. The headline finding was that Wolbachia is nearly universal in these populations: 98.5 percent of the mosquitoes tested were infected. However, the composition of those infections was strikingly lopsided. Every infected specimen carried wAlbB, but only 28.6 percent were superinfected with wAlbA. In other words, the vast majority of Hawaiian Aedes albopictus carry only a single Wolbachia strain, a pattern that departs from the double infection typically assumed for this species. This lower-than-expected prevalence of wAlbA establishes an important baseline for any future biocontrol effort in the region, because it means the resident bacterial landscape is not uniform across individuals. The study also revealed that infection dynamics are strongly shaped by the sex of the mosquito. Females were significantly more likely than males to harbor wAlbA, and bacterial density, the quantity of Wolbachia per individual, was significantly higher in females for both strains. This sex bias has practical implications because only female mosquitoes bite and transmit viruses, and because cytoplasmic incompatibility manifests through the interaction between infected males and uninfected or differently infected females. A sex-skewed distribution of native strains therefore changes the arithmetic of any release program designed around mating incompatibility. Environmental factors also left their mark on the bacterial communities. The prevalence of wAlbA was associated with the island of collection and with precipitation at the collection site, suggesting that local climate and geography influence which mosquitoes carry the second strain. By contrast, the prevalence of wAlbB did not vary significantly with sex, island, temperature, or precipitation, indicating that the two native strains respond to different ecological pressures. Temperature is known from laboratory studies to affect Wolbachia density, and rainfall shapes breeding habitat availability, so these field associations provide a real-world counterpart to experimental work on how environmental conditions modulate symbiont infections. Discover more Biological Sciences Dictionaries & Encyclopedias infections Health Conditions infection Perhaps the most technically intriguing results concern the interactions between the two strains when they coexist in the same mosquito. In superinfected individuals, wAlbB consistently exhibited higher density than wAlbA, and wAlbB density was higher in superinfected mosquitoes than in those carrying wAlbB alone. Both strains reached higher densities in females than in males. In females, the densities of the two strains were positively correlated, meaning mosquitoes with more wAlbA also tended to have more wAlbB, whereas no such correlation existed in males. These sex-specific microbe-microbe dynamics suggest that the two symbionts do not simply compete for host resources; their relationship differs fundamentally between the sexes, possibly reflecting differences in tissue tropism, vertical transmission requirements, or host physiology. For the design of Wolbachia-based control in Hawaiʻi, these findings carry a clear warning. Population suppression projects that rely on cytoplasmic incompatibility depend on predictable mating outcomes between released and wild mosquitoes. If a substantial fraction of wild females carry only wAlbB while released males carry both strains or a different combination, the strength of incompatibility may vary across the population, diluting the effectiveness of releases. Similarly, the sex and site-specific variation in bacterial density could influence how faithfully the released strains are transmitted to the next generation. The authors emphasize that future projects in the region must account for these varying patterns of infection before strategies are developed and implemented, rather than assuming a uniform superinfection across the archipelago. The study, funded in part by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s Science to Achieve Results program, the USDA National Institute of Food and Agriculture, and the National Institutes of Health, and conducted with permits from Hawaiʻi’s national parks, demonstrates the value of baseline surveillance before intervention. As Hawaiʻi confronts recurring outbreaks of dengue and the expanding range of mosquito vectors in a warming climate, understanding the invisible bacterial passengers of its mosquitoes has become a practical necessity. The nearly universal presence of wAlbB, the patchy distribution of wAlbA, and the complex density relationships between the strains together form a map of the biological terrain on which any future Wolbachia campaign will be fought, and this research provides the first careful survey of that terrain across the Hawaiian Islands. analysis.time: The study was published on October 4, 2026. The research was conducted with specimens collected from two Hawaiian islands, and the findings were reported in the same date.
analysis.location_and_population: The study focused on Aedes albopictus mosquitoes collected from Oʻahu and the Island of Hawaiʻi. The population studied is the invasive Asian tiger mosquito species in the Hawaiian Islands.
analysis.event: A new study published in the journal Parasites & Vectors revealed detailed patterns of Wolbachia infection in Aedes albopictus mosquitoes on two Hawaiian islands. The study found that Wolbachia is nearly universal in these populations, with a strikingly lopsided composition favoring wAlbB over wAlbA.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The study found that 98.5% of the mosquitoes tested were infected with Wolbachia, but only 28.6% were superinfected with both wAlbA and wAlbB. The findings highlight the importance of understanding Wolbachia strain composition for future biocontrol efforts, as the current patterns may affect the effectiveness of cytoplasmic incompatibility-based interventions.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study was conducted using quantitative PCR and provided detailed findings on Wolbachia infection patterns. The research was funded by multiple U.S. agencies and conducted with permits from Hawaiʻi’s national parks. The results are based on empirical data and are not speculative, though they are implications for future control strategies.

analysis.brief_en: A new study published in the journal Parasites & Vectors has uncovered detailed patterns of Wolbachia infection in Aedes albopictus mosquitoes on Oʻahu and the Island of Hawaiʻi. The research, conducted by a team led by Sangwoo Seok and colleagues, found that Wolbachia is nearly universal in these populations, with 98.5% of the mosquitoes tested being infected. However, the composition of these infections is strikingly lopsided, as every infected specimen carried wAlbB, while only 28.6% were superinfected with wAlbA. This finding is significant for future biocontrol efforts, as it indicates that the bacterial landscape is not uniform across individuals, which could affect the effectiveness of cytoplasmic incompatibility-based interventions. The study also revealed that infection dynamics are strongly influenced by the sex of the mosquito, with females more likely to carry wAlbA and both strains showing higher bacterial density in females. Environmental factors, such as island location and precipitation, were also linked to the prevalence of wAlbA. These results highlight the need for baseline surveillance before implementing Wolbachia-based mosquito control strategies, as the sex-specific and site-specific variations in bacterial density could influence the success of such programs. The research was funded by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, USDA National Institute of Food and Agriculture, and the National Institutes of Health, and was conducted with permits from Hawaiʻi’s national parks.

analysis_en.scale_impact_and_risk: The study found that 98.5% of the mosquitoes tested were infected with Wolbachia, but only 28.6% were superinfected with both wAlbA and wAlbB. The findings highlight the importance of understanding Wolbachia strain composition for future biocontrol efforts, as the current patterns may affect the effectiveness of cytoplasmic incompatibility-based interventions.
analysis_en.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study was conducted using quantitative PCR and provided detailed findings on Wolbachia infection patterns. The research was funded by multiple U.S. agencies and conducted with permits from Hawaiʻi’s national parks. The results are based on empirical data and are not speculative, though they are implications for future control strategies.

news.title_zh: 夏威夷蚊子中的隐性沃尔巴克氏体模式可能影响未来病毒控制 - Bioengineer.org
news.source_body_en: A new study published in the journal Parasites & Vectors has uncovered detailed patterns of Wolbachia infection in Aedes albopictus mosquitoes on Oʻahu and the Island of Hawaiʻi. The research, conducted by a team led by Sangwoo Seok and colleagues, found that Wolbachia is nearly universal in these populations, with 98.5% of the mosquitoes tested being infected. However, the composition of these infections is strikingly lopsided, as every infected specimen carried wAlbB, while only 28.6% were superinfected with wAlbA. This finding is significant for future biocontrol efforts, as it indicates that the bacterial landscape is not uniform across individuals, which could affect the effectiveness of cytoplasmic incompatibility-based interventions. The study also revealed that infection dynamics are strongly influenced by the sex of the mosquito, with females more likely to carry wAlbA and both strains showing higher bacterial density in females. Environmental factors, such as island location and precipitation, were also linked to the prevalence of wAlbA. These results highlight the need for baseline surveillance before implementing Wolbachia-based mosquito control strategies, as the sex-specific and site-specific variations in bacterial density could influence the success of such programs. The research was funded by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, USDA National Institute of Food and Agriculture, and the National Institutes of Health, and was conducted with permits from Hawaiʻi’s national parks.
news.content_zh: 一项发表在《寄生虫与媒介》期刊上的新研究揭示了夏威夷欧胡岛和火奴鲁鲁岛上的埃及伊蚊中沃尔巴克氏体感染的详细模式。由Sangwoo Seok及其同事领导的研究团队发现,这些种群中的沃尔巴克氏体感染几乎普遍存在,98.5%的测试蚊子被感染。然而,这些感染的组成却呈现出显著的不平衡,因为每只被感染的蚊子都携带wAlbB,而仅有28.6%的蚊子同时被wAlbA超感染。这一发现对未来生物控制措施具有重要意义,因为它表明个体之间的沃尔巴克氏体景观并不一致,这可能会影响基于细胞质不相容性的干预措施的效果。研究还发现,感染动态强烈受到蚊子性别的影响,雌蚊更可能携带wAlbA,且两种菌株在雌蚊中的细菌密度均较高。环境因素,如岛屿位置和降水量,也被与wAlbA的患病率相关联。这些结果强调了在实施基于沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子控制策略之前进行基线监测的重要性,因为细菌密度的性别特异性及地点特异性变化可能影响此类计划的成功率。该研究由美国环境保护署、美国农业部国家食品与农业研究所和美国国立卫生研究院资助,并获得了夏威夷国家公园的许可。

Policy 1 min read Keralam to strengthen communicable disease prevention amid concerns over spread The committees will focus on preventing diseases such as dengue and chikungunya, while ward-level committees comprising councillors or panchayat members, representatives of residents' associations and concerned health workers will also be formed. PTI Published On Sep 30, 2026 at 07:37 AM IST Select ETHealthworld as Preferred Choice on Google Copy Link Share on WhatsApp Share on Linkedin Share on X Share on Telegram Share on Facebook Thiruvananthapuram: Amid concerns over the spread of communicable diseases, the Keralam government has decided to form coordination committees headed by district collectors to strengthen prevention measures at the local level. State Health Minister K Muraleedharan directed the Health Department Principal Secretary to take necessary steps in this regard. The decision was taken during a communicable disease review meeting chaired by the minister on Monday, according to a statement. The committees will focus on preventing diseases such as dengue and chikungunya, while ward-level committees comprising councillors or panchayat members, representatives of residents' associations and concerned health workers will also be formed. Advt Dengue hotspots will be identified and mosquito-control measures, including source reduction, will be intensified, the Minister said. In view of intermittent rains and the possibility of water stagnation leading to mosquito breeding, "Dry Day" activities will be observed on Fridays at educational institutions, Saturdays at workplaces and Sundays at homes by destroying potential mosquito-breeding sources. An action plan for the Dry Day campaign will be prepared in consultation with the Local Self-Government Department minister, Muraleedharan said. The meeting also directed that preventive measures be intensified in accordance with the epidemic calendar and fever clinics in affected areas be strengthened. New fever clinics will also be started wherever necessary. The minister said meetings of district medical officers and district programme managers would be convened to review daily activities at the grassroots level in the coming days. Health Department Principal Secretary Dr Sharmila Mary Joseph, Health Department High Power Committee Chairman Dr S S Lal and Health Department Director Dr V Meenakshi, among others, attended the meeting. Policy 1 min read Keralam to strengthen communicable disease prevention amid concerns over spread The committees will focus on preventing diseases such as dengue and chikungunya, while ward-level committees comprising councillors or panchayat members, representatives of residents' associations and concerned health workers will also be formed. PTI Published On Sep 30, 2026 at 07:37 AM IST Select ETHealthworld as Preferred Choice on Google Copy Link Share on WhatsApp Share on Linkedin Share on X Share on Telegram Share on Facebook Thiruvananthapuram: Amid concerns over the spread of communicable diseases, the Keralam government has decided to form coordination committees headed by district collectors to strengthen prevention measures at the local level. State Health Minister K Muraleedharan directed the Health Department Principal Secretary to take necessary steps in this regard. The decision was taken during a communicable disease review meeting chaired by the minister on Monday, according to a statement. The committees will focus on preventing diseases such as dengue and chikungunya, while ward-level committees comprising councillors or panchayat members, representatives of residents' associations and concerned health workers will also be formed. Advt Dengue hotspots will be identified and mosquito-control measures, including source reduction, will be intensified, the Minister said. In view of intermittent rains and the possibility of water stagnation leading to mosquito breeding, "Dry Day" activities will be observed on Fridays at educational institutions, Saturdays at workplaces and Sundays at homes by destroying potential mosquito-breeding sources. An action plan for the Dry Day campaign will be prepared in consultation with the Local Self-Government Department minister, Muraleedharan said. The meeting also directed that preventive measures be intensified in accordance with the epidemic calendar and fever clinics in affected areas be strengthened. New fever clinics will also be started wherever necessary. The minister said meetings of district medical officers and district programme managers would be convened to review daily activities at the grassroots level in the coming days. Health Department Principal Secretary Dr Sharmila Mary Joseph, Health Department High Power Committee Chairman Dr S S Lal and Health Department Director Dr V Meenakshi, among others, attended the meeting. news.content_zh: 凯拉拉邦政府宣布计划加强传染病预防措施,以应对登革热和基孔肯雅热等疾病传播的担忧。该决定是在2026年9月30日星期一由邦卫生部长K Muraleedharan主持的审查会议上做出的。政府将在各地区设立由地区收税官领导的协调委员会,以实施本地预防策略。这些委员会还将包括区级小组,由议员、村民代表和卫生工作者组成。预防措施包括加强蚊虫控制,如源头削减,并在受影响地区设立新的发热诊所。政府还指示预防措施应与疫情日历相协调。此外,星期五、星期六和星期日将举行‘干日’活动,以消除潜在的蚊虫繁殖源。应对措施仍在进行中,计划进一步召开会议以审查基层活动。该行动基于政府确认的声明,不涉及任何严格排除或相关实体。
